skills install review fixes: an install records a consent sheet only when the request proves one was shown, one-click also sends any script-looking file to the sheet, a legacy Codex root uninstalls into its own trash without creating ~/.agents, a rolled-back install removes the empty skills folder it created, and project checks know the legacy global root
stop a pytest-asyncio deprecation flood from stalling the parallel test pass after junit is written

changes.details: the archive screen used to attach a document-level keydown handler once, at first open, and never remove it - only an active-class check inside the handler kept it quiet off-screen. show()/hide() now attach and detach it explicitly, wired into App.hideAllScreens().
changes.summary: stop the archive screen's keydown listener from outliving the screen

changes.details: Backfilled 2026-09-28 by the changelog audit. The other operator's commit 8bddc0b6d0, no issue filed; the foot bar's later same-day iterations (collapse to 3 cells, effort colours, etc.) each carry their own entry.
changes.summary: terminal foot bar: desktop shows model, context, 5-hour and weekly limits, and tokens
the 5h and weekly limits show again when claude code is signed in: the ledger reads the keychain item claude code actually keeps, and the refresh nudge finds claude under launchd

the catalog card shows one chip per installed scope and an add split button that installs to global or this project in one click (a sheet still opens when the server needs consent); the detail pane shows the estimated context cost, where the skill is installed, and how often it fired on this mac (GET /skill-fires/usage)

the catalog pane now shows trust facts and compatibility, try it starts a scratch session (and works on an installed item), and the list gains sort, a packs shelf, keyboard shortcuts and #catalog/<handle>/<name> deep links

the closed drawer's mini rail shows a Layout's aggregate status light in its layouts flyout, mirrors the drawer footer's settings, help, layout-editor, version and sign-out controls stacked at the bottom, and adds three unlabelled usage bars for the focused session's context, 5h and 7d account usage

changes.details: Option A, meters first (the owner picked it): ctx, 5h and 7d lead as one group of equal bars, the model and the work segments sit on the right, and tokens move to the grown bar only. Pieces are admitted by priority from measured widths. The control center and the work segments now say agents, shells and timers (short "ag 2 sh 3").
changes.summary: the collapsed foot bar leads with the three limits and names agents, shells and timers one way everywhere
the drawer foot bar's gear now opens settings synchronously, so it never leaves the drawer on the menu tab with the settings page not actually shown
the drawer menu's widgets row opens the widgets manager page instead of the arrange popover

the drawer's data, stores and controller moved into the compiled app and the svelte shell is now the only way the list is drawn (the layouts band excepted); the per-browser switch back to the old list is gone

changes.details: Background shells are counted from the claude process's live tool shells, cross-checked with the background launches recorded in the conversation and its sub-agents, so a sub-agent's shell and a launch far back in a long transcript both count. The expanded bar no longer covers the bg and clock segments or takes their clicks.
changes.summary: the foot bar's bg count now matches claude's own shell count, and the bg and clock segments stay visible and clickable when the bar is expanded

the hosted catalog lets an email account claim a publisher handle (pending until its first submission is approved), lists your own submissions and their states, and accepts a newer version of your own item; the admin queue shows a pending handle

the layout search and prompt bar is right-justified at half width and grows downward for long text, shows the search glass and the > side by side (the active one bright, the other dim), and has a softer focus outline
the project kebab's new agent now opens the select-provider picker instead of launching instantly, and the whole new-agent flow is restyled Military Terminal
the sessions and projects views join the other menu pages: they cover the screen behind them, close any other page, and mark their drawer row
the sessions menu row and a bare /session open the sessions view instead of an empty terminal page with a stray header

the sidebar row icons settings grid gained three more toggles - the keep-awake cup, the pin and the kebab - so a row can hide any of them without losing what they control: keep-awake and pinning stay reachable from the row menu, and a hidden kebab still opens on right click, long press or Shift+F10 and never hides the green update-ready icon
the skills catalog now warns when a skill edits your CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, with a mark on the card and a line on the install sheet, instead of treating it as a blocked settings edit

the skills manager gains a census tab listing every skill with how often it fired in 7, 30 and 90 days and its estimated cost, and a diet tab that previews the skills a project has not used for 30 days and switches the chosen ones off or to compact in that project's local settings

the skills page shows every state of a skill: where it lives, usage and cost, health (drift, tripwire, autopsy), provenance and trust, and contents, with drifted, flagged and unused 30 d marks on the list (issue #1099)
the terminal bar keeps its most useful figures as it narrows, and grows into a session control center that lists and stops background processes, subagents and the session's turn

the terminal bar's context meter is a readable colored gauge again, and the bar counts running subagents and background shells, unfolds them, and can stop a hung background process; a clock shows the session's timers

the terminal bar's context, 5h and 7d progress bars are all one readable size instead of a big context gauge beside two slivers; a reset countdown reads as a recycle icon plus a bare duration ('4d 3h', never a date) instead of the words 'reset in'; and when a window's bar is too narrow to show, its label and percent take on the bar's own colour instead of disappearing

the terminal's session skills entry now slides a drawer out of the right edge of that terminal, showing the skills in use, their state and recent use, and the skill chip on session rows and cells is gone

tighten the row's icon cluster spacing, split the subagent icon into agents/shells/timers with a per-density visibility setting, and turn the kebab green with an update-and-restart shortcut when a session's claude is out of date
visual QA of the sidebar row cluster across drawer densities (issue 1061): reference screenshots and a reproducible capture script

changes.details: Backfilled 2026-09-28 by the changelog audit (the owner). Commit 9baebd561e, follow-up to issue #1062.
changes.summary: wrappers page: groups wrappers by family, including a family with zero wrappers
Add configurable Home analytics with default-on metadata-only minute history, estimated costs, activity, quota observations and rule-change comparisons.

Collect recent Claude and Codex usage fairly, ignore nonusage synthetic markers, price observed GPT and Sonnet 5.5 models explicitly, support backfill on local-network HTTP, and show cache breakdowns, activity, rankings and quota history on Home.

Four more analytics widgets: flow (a Sankey of spend or tokens from account to model to agent kind to project), outlier hunter (one dot per conversation, duration against cost, sized by tokens; a live one opens its session), change impact (a metric before and after a marker with medians, a confidence range and a model-mix warning, worded as correlation only) and collector health (last pass, backlog, missing sources, database size).
Home analytics cards keep their last known values while they refresh instead of flashing unknown, and a failed refresh no longer blanks a card.
Make Home analytics easy to scan with clear values, aligned readable charts and analysis tools behind Details instead of overlapping labels and controls.
Show default analytics charts in existing saved Home layouts and keep shared controls with the charts, preserving customized widgets and later hide/remove choices.

Skill Tripwire and Autopsy now judge subagent work and SKILL.md dynamic commands, run off the watcher cycle, attribute by install location, ignore grep patterns, keep the keep-as-fork mark in the install ledger (fail closed), and restoring a script-bearing version asks for consent.

Three live ops widgets in the analytics gallery: vitals (live sessions by state, subagents, tokens per minute and estimated dollars per hour with a trend word, cache hit), top for agents (the busiest conversations of the last 15 minutes, a row opens its live session) and an event ticker (session, account, model and tripwire events merged with markers, newest first).

Three more live ops widgets in the analytics gallery: fleet (a rack of every live session with its status light, project, model, context fill and subagents, a click opens it), quota runway (per account, when the quota window runs out against when it resets) and agent swimlanes (working, waiting and idle blocks per conversation). Top for agents now opens the session whose conversation id is exactly the row's; the listing carries that id as claude_session_uuid.

a blueprint member can be created on a paired Mac (host_key), through the same forward as any new session there; a down or unknown Mac, a worktree or a skill fails that member by name and never the launch
a blueprint member placed on a paired mac is no longer refused as if its host key were a credential
a column divider's line now runs the full height of its edge, and a divider beside a widget spanning several rows lights as one continuous line when you hover, press or focus any part of it (#1141)
a dev server's port is now filed under the session whose terminal owns it, not whichever session happened to be in focus when the port was printed
a drawer row now shows a small pulsing blue workflow mark while that session has a Workflow run in flight, at every density, so a session using workflows is recognisable at a glance
a layout that holds a paired Mac's session keeps that session awake on its own Mac while the layout is open here (the lease is forwarded to the owner; a down Mac is skipped)
a long build string such as a preview version no longer collides with the drawer footer icons: it truncates with an ellipsis and its full value shows on hover

a paired Mac's link comes back on its own when the other Mac's server restarts: the redial over the surviving ssh connection re-adds the local forward instead of leaving a missing socket and a link stuck disconnected
a paired Mac's served listing drops the fields the importer replaces, the share read only control stays hidden for a paired Mac's sessions, and two Macs with the same session name keep separate rows

a paired Mac's session opens like a local one: the terminal socket is relayed one to one to the owning Mac through the link, so typing and output cross both ways, the size handshake and the size crown reach the owner's pane, only terminal frames cross, a lost link closes 4502 and a revoked pairing closes 4412; no interface yet

a paired Mac's status changes and toasts reach this Mac the moment they happen (a live events subscription, the two second poll stays as the fallback), marked as coming from the peer; only the Mac that owns the session sends phone pushes, and dismissing a toast here dismisses it on the owner

a paired mac now shows in the conversation search (hits tagged with their machine, one conversation found on both shown once), in the projects page (an other machines list, read only) and in the ledger (its accounts and limits beside this mac's, an account both macs share drawn once); each is asked of the paired mac when the page opens, a mac that cannot answer is named and never breaks the local answer, and the ledger summary carries no token, login path or email

a read-only library census tags every project, session row and conversation keep, junk, merge or needs-review with a named reason and proves by hash which archive copies are on disk, and a dry-run-by-default export writes the archive's only copies back out as verified jsonl files (issue #1145)
a running session whose tmux name an older stopped session also used now matches its stored record, so its menu no longer disables sleep agent with 'not matched to a stored agent yet'

a session listed under a saved layout in the sidebar now shows the same row as its pinned or grouped copy, context gauge included; the layout band's member rows go through the one session row renderer

a session running on a managed account now shows its running model and context gauge on the sidebar row, and the token panel and time machine capture find its transcript: transcripts are searched under every configured account's projects folder, not only the default one

a session running workflows or background agents stays green at its resting prompt when claude's own session record (2.1.283 or later) says busy and the transcript lists the work, instead of going grey
a session's terminal stream file now has one name however the session was opened, so restarting the app no longer tears down healthy streams or logs a false stolen-stream warning for its own copier

a skill whose review carries a warning kind this build does not know now stays listed as a warning, and the CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / MEMORY.md notice also shows on packs, blueprint launches, Try, one-shot and manual updates, while automatic updates skip such a version

a terminal that kept printing while a menu page, another tab or the parking shelf covered it no longer shows every frame stacked on top of each other when it comes back: it is redrawn once as soon as it is on screen again

a wallboard button opens the home analytics widgets alone in their own window (no bar, no handles, read only, sized to fill the window, following the synced home layout live), and analytics widgets can now sit beside terminals in a saved terminal layout

a widget that covers several rows resizes along its whole side edge, not just its top row: the left and right handles run the full height, and the four corners of the widget move the side and the row boundary together
adopting a session no longer disconnects the other windows that have the same session open

analytics can group tokens and cost by account or subagent type (conversations with no recorded value form an unknown group), backed by a per-conversation metadata table that stores versions, minutes and a hashed git branch and never any prompt, response or tool text, plus a typed event log read at /api/v1/stats/event-log

analytics charts give every series its own colour from a new eight colour palette that adapts to each theme, dash a ninth series and beyond, and the legend now hides and shows a series when clicked and keeps that choice when the chart redraws

analytics widgets choose a renderer (timeline or a new kpi with a big figure, change against the period before and a sparkline), show more or less by the box they are given, and read their data in one batched request per refresh; the leftover global range and resolution controls are gone and every chart legend is on so series can be toggled

each analytics widget keeps its own range (a preset or pinned window), zoom, resolution, filters and hidden legend series on the server and every browser follows them; the details view has its own range, resolution and filter pickers, saved only when you change them, and the legend is on by default

edit layout has an analytics gallery of preset widgets in five categories, and three new analytics widgets: a leaderboard (ranked table with bars and trends), a spend treemap (provider, model, project) and an hour-by-weekday heat rhythm

every account limit gauge (5h, 7d and the total on the providers page, the drawer providers panel, the home cell, the terminal status bar, the mini rail and the settings previews) now draws a thin pace line above its bar showing how much of the window has elapsed, and the bar colour reads usage against that pace: green on or under pace, yellow ahead of it, coral when it is on track to run out before the reset

every conversation you close is now kept in the database with a summary written by your local llm (spark, then the mini), its last six messages, its first prompt and the files it touched, all searchable: type in the projects page search box to find a past conversation by what was said or decided, and open it to read the summary and the last messages; settings can turn automatic summaries off, change how many messages are kept, and pause the summary queue

every session action on a paired Mac's session (create, rename, delete, restart and resume, theme, notes, timers, sleep and wake, size, skills and the rest) is forwarded to the Mac that owns it and behaves as it does there; a route with no forward is refused by name, never run on the same-named local session, and a paired Mac can never make this Mac forward on
every widget on the widgets page shows a screenshot of itself, captured by feature_capture.py from a spec, and the edit layout drawer uses the same pictures

federation foundation for pairing two Carnivore Macs: a peer grants table (schema 43), an Ed25519 federation key in the login Keychain, pairing codes, 15 minute peer tokens that reach only the session list and the peer routes, and revoke, unpair and a per-grant socket close code; nothing in the interface changes yet

federation link for two paired Macs: the pairing driver, ssh forwards both ways over one master, a peer-only listener, a key proof before any token is sent, hello, heartbeat and a disconnected state with redial by the initiator (schema 44); owner routes under /federation/peers, no interface yet

federation link security fixes: a loopback tcp back route proves the paired Mac's key on every connection before any token is sent, peer replies are size capped, the prove route is rate limited per client and grant, a fid match is computed by the server, host key pinning is read through ssh -G, peer rows are keyed by a hash of the full install id, an owner revoke ends the link and the acceptor stops retrying in a tight loop

federation pairing hardened (typed and ssh offers no longer share a slot or rate window, per-grant token limits, a re-pair cannot swap another Mac's key, a non-ASCII code is a 401) and an owner-only key rotate that tells every live peer, signed by the old key

home can hold up to 12 named boards, added, switched, renamed and deleted from a board picker in the edit layout drawer; the boards are shared by every browser, the board a device shows is its own, and the wallboard opens any board
home cells and terminal chrome draw their header tools, spacing and type from the one layered design system instead of per-surface copies
hovering a session, browser or layout row in the left drawer shows its full name, so a name cut short with an ellipsis can be read at every density

in edit layout a small arrow beside every widget's top left icon opens its actions menu (hide or remove, reset size, extend or pull back a row, settings), and outside edit layout the icon says what it opens when hovered

in edit layout on the home page, the add chart entry, its presets and the saved charts now narrow with the widget search and the category chips like every other card, instead of staying on screen whatever you typed

killing or removing a session saves a compressed restore point of its conversation and its subagents, sleep and restart keep one rotating emergency copy, and the api can list, pin, delete and restore them

legacy stylesheets begin joining the layered design system: 21 sheets with no selector shared with any still-unlayered rule are wrapped whole in the legacy layer, and a ratchet holds the unlayered file counts so they can only fall

limit gauges mark the elapsed time of a window with one vertical marker across the bar, coloured green, yellow or coral by pace, in place of the thin line above the bar; no known reset draws no marker

limit gauges now colour the usage bar by how much is used alone, and colour the thin pace line by pace instead: green on or under pace, yellow ahead of it, coral when it is on track to run out well before the reset

lineage is one graph of parent and child links with milestones (schema v49): a conversation forked into five sessions shows under each, siblings and subagents are listed, compacts are recorded, and the backfill reads the transcript archive first

open tabs now show a reload pill after a preview client hot-sync too: the server reports a client_build content key on the version route and the events hello, each tab compares it with the key it booted with (checked every minute while visible) and shows update ready with a reload button when they differ

opening a session that lives on a paired mac from the phone now attaches its terminal under the right id, so the on-screen keypad (arrows, esc, tab) reaches the pane instead of waiting on a pane that never becomes ready

paired Mac listing security fixes: a hostile or broken peer reply can no longer fail the owner's session list, an honest peer with hundreds of sessions loads, stale or disconnected peer rows read unknown with nothing measured, one shared fetch per peer, shadow rows are bounded, pruned and removed on unpair (the other Mac's row too), and a peer's label can no longer break out of an HTML attribute

paired Macs list each other's sessions: the session list on each Mac now also holds the other Mac's sessions with the owner's own status and lights, kept as local rows that survive a restart of either Mac, shown as disconnected while the link is down, never re-exported, and never adopted or reaped as ssh hosts (schema 45); no interface yet

pairing a Mac works with a long home directory: the ssh control and forward sockets get short hashed names in a short directory, and a socket path that cannot fit is a named 400 or a disconnected state instead of a 500

pairing two macs now shows a comparison code on both screens and makes no grant until the owner confirms they match, so a man in the middle on first contact is caught; a mismatch drops the pairing on both macs

projects page rebuilt as a ledger with a page per level: projects with running, sleeping and closed counts and a 14 day strip, a project's sessions grouped running, sleeping and closed with one primary action each, and a session page with summary, details, resume and time machine restore points; show hidden replaces the state chips

changes.details: style guide entry for scaled__in--live, instructions_write render tests following the lowercased copy, the layout drawer's analytics entries obeying the search, a DrawerMenu.test.ts type error, the unpriced-model token usage test, change entries for the audit gaps since v1.12.19, and reproducible media recapture for the surfaces that moved (capture specs updated for the rebuilt settings page, the command bar and the shared manager frame).
changes.summary: release v1.12.20: fix pre-flight test-suite reds and recapture UI media ahead of the cut

restore points are written as independent zstd frames of whole lines with a frame table beside them, so one range of a long transcript reads without decompressing all of it, and a capture scope setting (human, human and subsessions, all) decides whether headless sessions and subagent transcripts are saved
scheduled tasks of every paired Mac are listed under their host (the owning Mac runs them, nothing runs twice), and a Mac that does not answer is named
selecting text with the mouse in a window that only watches a session (shrunk to fit) now lands on the text under the pointer instead of drifting away from it

sessions on a managed account now get their status, conversation binding, reopen offer, project history, scheduled-task runs and archive: the status registry, adopt-time correlation and transcript archive read every configured account's sessions and projects folders, not only the default one

settings > appearance > colors is a compact theme picker: the current theme, a row of favorite and recent themes to switch with one click, and a browse all themes button that opens the themes page; the themes page is the one full gallery and shows and sets the same global theme

settings gets a time machine group: a storage slider (1 to 32 gb) with a live usage meter and a confirm before lowering the cap below what is stored, and a summary method choice (claude session or api) with the keychain key state; restore points can now be summarized and a fresh session started from the summary

settings, advanced can now export your whole configuration (settings, preferences, sidebar arrangement, terminal layouts, pinned themes) to one file and import it on another Mac: you see what would change before anything is written, and no password, token or key is ever in the file

sidebar session rows can show context use as a thin fill along the row's bottom edge, coloured by the same ladder as the foot bar's context meter; off by default, turned on per density in settings, appearance, sidebar rows; a session with no measured context draws nothing
stats api gains a batch query endpoint (up to 32 queries in one request) and a richer live feed with burn rates, cache hit ratio, top conversations and active models

stats harvest part 2: conversations now carry the right account (read from each profile's own session records, not the shared transcript folder), per-minute counters for tool calls by name, stop reasons, thinking tokens, web searches and fetches, compactions, turns and cache-write classes, and seconds spent waiting on you and with a subagent running
stats tripwires: threshold alarms on a metric query, evaluated by the stats scheduler with hold and cooldown, alerting in the app with a card and an event log row
terminal stream files left behind by sessions that no longer exist are now removed automatically once they are a day old, and never while their session, a live pane or any process still uses them

the alert center: a global, deduplicated app-health alert store (schema v50) with dismiss, snooze and auto-resolve, routes under /api/v1/alerts, live app_alert frames, a header bell with a severity badge and panel, and a card for each new error; the first producer is the summary worker finding no summary server reachable

the area at the foot of the drawer is now a widget area: in edit layout drag keep awake, scheduled tasks or the activity log into it, reorder, remove, and pick compact or full for the providers widget; it defaults to the providers panel and is the same on every device
the built-in default claude login is listed beside your managed accounts again (it vanished once a managed account was added), can be switched to, and reads built-in login on its card

the built-in login card can be renamed (display name only, blank restores the default), a working account's button now says log in again instead of a bare log in, and providers is a row in the main menu that opens the provider ledger page

the changelog page has a search box that forgives typos and word order (keychan finds keychain, shift update finds the update icon entry): matches stay under their release, releases with no match hide, matched words are highlighted, and it shows a match count, a clear button, / to focus and Escape to clear

the changelog search now matches exact text only by default, so searching pace no longer finds page or place; a fuzzy checkbox next to the search field turns typo and word-order tolerance back on and is remembered on each device
the collapsed status bar never hides the effort level at any width, its meter bars grow from 64px up to 112px when there is room, and its three groups sit further apart
the conversation search index now caps the text stored per conversation and deletes conversations older than 180 days, so its database stays small
the divider between two cells that both span down into an empty row can be dragged again

the documentation page is now a short user guide: a contents list, twelve sections from getting started to remote access, a search box, and the feature list at the end; stale wording (foot bar, the old help panel sections) is gone

the documentation page is written as markdown, one file per section in docs/user-guide/, and opens on the status lights: a grid of the eight states drawn with the real light, several per row on a wide screen and stacked on a phone; three screenshots (home, a session, settings) carry numbered click marks that explain an area on hover or focus and open the page it points at; #settings/<section> now opens that settings section; html typed in a guide file shows as text
the drawer menu no longer has an "arrange screen" row on a desktop, where the drawer footer's edit layout button is the one way in; it stays on a phone, where edit layout does not exist
the gear icon no longer throws a duplicate key error when drawn by the compiled icon component, because its two concentric circles now render by position instead of by a shared coordinate

the home layout is one value for every browser: it is kept on the server and followed live, your current home is uploaded once on first load, the default analytics charts are seeded once for all browsers, and the pop-out follows it without writing

the home masthead card (carnivore wordmark, tagline and five readouts) is removed from the home page on every screen size and the pop-out, and a saved home layout that still had it opens without it and keeps the rest of its arrangement

the home page provider ledger card is now the same widget as the providers panel at the foot of the agents tab: the same account rows with 5h and weekly bars, pick badge, re-add link, switch buttons and auto-switch icon, one shared component
the home pop-out window now wears the app's themed thin scrollbars instead of the native mac ones, and the page itself never scrolls

the home screen can be popped out into its own window from a pop out button in the top bar: it keeps its stats live in the background, opens no terminal, never votes on a pane size, remembers its size and place, and has a focus main window link
the home screen, and the top bar on every other page, make room for the docked agents drawer and for the closed drawer's icon rail again instead of sliding under them

the hosts page now finds and pairs with other Carnivore Macs: a found-on-this-network list with click to pair (no typing when the ssh host key is already trusted, otherwise the code shown on the other Mac), pair by name for a tailnet, each paired Mac's link state in words (connected, disconnected, incompatible, unpaired, identity changed), its grants with revoke and a full unpair, rotate key, the advertise switch, and one heading for a Mac that is both an ssh host and a paired Mac
the large control center preview and the header preview in settings now shrink whole to fit a narrow pane, like the status bar strips, instead of overlapping or clipping
the layout command bar centers its search box on the banner and is 15 percent wider (546px)

the layout command bar's "to N of N" recipients chip and click-to-choose menu are back in command mode, and the collapsed terminal foot bar's three meters are centered with even bar sizes again instead of packed left
the ledger account editor can set a short name (an edit no longer wipes one) and picks colours from a terminal style grid of all 256 xterm colours with a hex field

the left drawer (tabs, search, rows, groups, footer bar, mini rail, widget area, providers) draws from the one layered design system: rules in the components layer, spacing and type on the scale, the shared icon and field primitives instead of a rail button family

the menu pages (projects, sessions, skills, plugins, widgets, wrappers, hosts, provider ledger, info pages, blueprints) now share one page frame and the standard buttons, fields, chips, notices and switches instead of per-page copies; behavior is unchanged

the menu pages (providers, skills catalog, projects, hosts, blueprints, wrappers, plugins, widgets and the info pages) now share one page frame and one set of buttons, checks, chips, fields and notices, so they look and behave alike; under the hood the stylesheets now load in a fixed layer order so a page style can no longer be flattened by the global reset
the menu's arrange row moves next to widgets and is now labeled arrange screen, since it places and hides widgets on the screen behind the drawer while the widgets page enables and configures them

the menu's documentation, keyboard shortcuts and changelog quick links were inert rows and now each opens its own menu page: documentation is the feature list, changelog is the features-by-release view, and keyboard shortcuts lists the terminal search, skills catalog and conversation archive bindings read from the tables the keys act on

the pace line above each account limit bar is now clearly visible: a thicker light line for time elapsed on a faint track, with a notch at the elapsed point that drops over the top of the usage bar, thinner on compact bars

the preview installer takes its signing identity, designated requirement and output folder from environment overrides, and falls back to a home folder when the usb drive is not mounted, so it runs on a second developer's mac

the projects and sessions pages are tidied and complete: the list keeps a 1180px measure instead of stretching across a wide pane, every project row and a project's head have a kebab (new session here, rename project, copy folder path, load blueprint, hide project or unhide project), and running and sleeping session rows carry the drawer's own session kebab; the two line layout at a drawer-open pane puts the action beside the meta line; the dim behind a dialog is now the theme's own ground colour at a firm 82 percent instead of a near black wash, and the tab strips are a shade darker than the title row instead of nearly black
the projects page shows "restore point" on a closed session's button instead of a raw key, and the restore points list keeps a space between the turn count and the word turns on a narrow screen

the provider ledger's pre-expiry token refresh no longer skips every account as busy because of other accounts' running claude sessions, so idle accounts stay logged in; the expired-login log line now appears only when the state changes

the providers list in the left drawer now highlights the account the selected session actually runs on, and keeps doing so when that session's transcript cannot be read; hover the highlighted row to see why

the providers page can restart all sessions still on another account after one explicit checkbox confirmation; each session gets a fresh account check and restart preview, and unsafe or failed sessions are reported without leaving the page

the providers page now reads close like every other menu page; the keyboard shortcuts page drops the meaningless item count, lists the drawer menu's single-key shortcuts, and loads the conversation archive shortcuts reliably
the question mark at the foot of the drawer now opens the documentation page; what the marks mean is the documentation's first section, with a link that opens the legend

the settings page is rebuilt on the label-column layout Joe chose: every section is a list of groups, each named once in a side column beside its controls, on one set of shared controls (square checks, choice cards, outline buttons, order lists); appearance now shows colors as theme tiles, sidebar rows as a sample row beside its icon checks, the three status bar layouts as full-size strips that are the picker, the control center as three thumbnails and a filled preview, and the header shortcuts as one ordered list

the settings page now fits a narrow pane: groups stack their label above the controls until the pane is wide enough for a side column, hint text and choice cards use the small text size instead of the page size, status bar layout strips shrink to fit instead of clipping, check grids fill with readable cells, and a setting alone in its group no longer repeats the group's hint
the sidebar row context gauge is now on by default at every density; turn it off per density in settings, appearance, sidebar rows
the skill chips in the session skills panel take the primary text colour again; they named a colour token no theme defines, so the browser fell back to whatever colour the chip inherited
the start-at-login item works for a development copy started with npm start: the launch agent now passes the app folder to electron, and an existing launch agent with the old arguments is repaired

the terminal foot bar is now called the status bar everywhere you read it; its settings picker shows a named collapsed preview and a named open preview, stacked, each with the layouts' real names; the collapsed bar's three meters can be reordered from settings; and the settings page uses one spacing scale throughout

the themes and settings pages wear the shared page frame and controls, and the plugins page's detail pane no longer clips its facts and title in a narrow pane: the list and the detail split by the pane's width, and the detail takes over the pane when it is under 720px

the widgets page says which widgets can be added more than once, and that each analytics chart copy has its own settings; in edit layout that widget's actions menu has a settings item that takes you to them

the wrappers page is grouped by type: each type has a heading with its wrapper count, its default wrapper named (or "no default") and a plus that adds a wrapper of that type; a how wrappers work link opens a new wrappers section in the documentation with the pick order, the argument convention and four sample scripts

this Mac now advertises itself on the local network as a carnivore over bonjour and lists other carnivore Macs it sees, with a per-Mac switch to stop advertising (on by default); it shares only a name, a protocol number and two hashed ids

time machine summaries can be written by your own llm servers (vllm or ollama, no api key): settings lists them as an ordered fallback chain, seeded with the spark and this mini, with a model picker filled from each server, a test button that shows latency and first words, and an optional context size; long conversations are condensed to fit the model and split into parts when needed. local is now the default summary method

time machine summaries now default to the api method; the claude session method (a headless claude -p) only runs when you pick it in settings, and shows a warning that it can log the account out if it fails

tripwires on the widgets: set a threshold from a timeline, kpi or leaderboard widget's settings, a tripped widget gets a coral edge with the value against its limit (also in the pop-out), timelines draw the limit as a dashed line, and deleting a chart deletes its tripwires

when you /clear a session the old conversation is no longer lost: it stays under the session as a previous conversation, is saved like a close (a restore point, its last messages and a summary), and the projects page lists it with when it ended, why, and buttons to resume it into a new session or restore its point; session rows show how many previous conversations they have
while shift is held, every green update-ready icon turns yellow (color only, no ring or border) and its tooltip says a click will update and restart now

with account auto-switch on, an expired claude login that still has a refresh token is revived at once with one claude doctor run per access token, never retried, so an idle account comes back without a re-add
26 more themes now replace Claude Code's Clawd with their own sprite, including Black Market, Matrix, Dracula, Game Boy, Alien and Pokemon

a 3-question ask shows 1 of 3 instead of 1/1, option descriptions stay with their option instead of becoming extra options, and question cards read in the source session's full-strength theme text colour
a catalog plugin that carries hooks, mcp or lsp servers, monitors or a bin folder now counts as code: it asks for script consent on install and update and is never auto-updated
a conversation link that a backfill inferred instead of proved (a fork pointer or the one transcript written before a clear) is stored as inferred and shows an inferred tag in previous conversations
a decoy email sign in session now locks after five wrong codes with the same 410 a real cognito session gives, so six verify attempts no longer tell a decoy from a real session
a dialog in a narrow pane (a phone attached) stays in the approval inbox with the same fingerprint, and the agent-action card reads the fields the server really sends
a header inbox lists every open agent dialog and mcp agent action with a count badge, and you answer from its cards; a settings switch controls the cross-session mcp gate

a live conversation's new text is searchable within one 5-minute manifest scan: a grown transcript (and, under capture scope all, each subagent file) queues one coalesced live job that indexes only the appended complete lines from its saved offset, falls back to a whole read on a truncation or rewrite, and the save pipeline widget shows how many conversations are live and how long ago their newest text was indexed

a loopback-only POST /mcp endpoint answers a running agent's MCP handshake and six read-only tools (whoami, sessions_list, session_status, session_read_output, projects_list, session_notes_get), authenticated by the pane's hook token, off with mcp.enabled false

a page whose events socket is refused re-auths once and, if the same token is refused again (or the page has no refresh path, as the pop-out had), stops retrying it and waits for a new token instead of retrying every 31 s; the pop-out now loads the re-auth module; the server refuses a repeated dead token from memory and logs it once per ten minutes with the client address, origin and user agent

a paired mac's detail pane on the hosts page lists that mac's sessions and opens one on click; a session on another machine shows its machine's chip in the drawer at every density; this machine's card no longer says never probed

a phone pairing page served over the phone link, a phone link panel in settings (switch, certificate and tunnel state, pair a phone with a QR, devices with last seen and push result, revoke), and web push bound to the paired device so revoking it removes its alerts
a plain shell session reopens again, from recent and from the reboot offer: the launch no longer hands claude's --name flag to the shell wrapper, which zsh refused with "no such option: name"

a reopened shell no longer keeps the claude stats bar: a listing update that arrived while a slower read was still out was answered by that older read and never re-read, so the new row's family stayed missing until you navigated away and back
a restarted or recreated session no longer shows finished or unread for its own startup, and settings now explains that pinned sessions never auto-sleep

a resumable community purge for account deletion: ratings are removed with exact aggregate deltas, comments lose body and author id (a placeholder stays where replies exist), reports and audit rows are kept
a row divider can be dragged down again when the pane below spans several rows and its first row is already at the minimum; the extra height now comes from the rows further down
a save pipeline widget shows queued, running, done and dead counts, backfill progress, each summary server's state and the last archive freshness, with a retry dead button
a save step that keeps failing now has a retry button on its alert, and agents can requeue dead save jobs with the pipeline_retry_dead tool

a save that hits a file still in icloud (an undownloaded placeholder) no longer dead-letters after five quick tries: the pipeline asks icloud to download exactly that file, waits 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 and 40 minutes without spending an attempt, and only dead-letters after about two hours with an error saying the file stayed in icloud; the save pipeline widget shows these as waiting for icloud, not failed
a session opened only in a home cell launches its agent again; only read-only observers skip the pending startup command
a session waiting on a startup prompt no longer raises a 'needs a keypress' toast; the yellow light and startup_gate status are unchanged

a slim self check of Carnivore's own components (its files not being iCloud placeholders, free space, tmux, the claude cli, Full Disk Access) runs at boot and every 10 minutes, raises alerts only on a change, and answers GET /self-check and a self_check MCP tool
a terminal tab whose session has a workflow running shows the workflow icon to the right of its title
a terminal whose agent family has no stats source (hermes, openclaw, local) draws no stats foot bar, so the pane keeps the space; claude and codex are unchanged and a plain shell keeps its folder bar
a test slot keeps its federation key in a private file so slot pairing works, and the signing keychain always restores the user search list on every exit
a test slot server never reaches the login Keychain for any production key, so no Keychain Not Found dialog appears
a theme can now replace Claude Code's mascot in the terminal with its own sprite; HP Lovecraft ships a green Cthulhu
a theme's developer opens the in-app author profile instead of github.com, and a github link shows only when the server says the account is a github account
admin submissions queue shows a kind badge and opens a detail with the submitter block, file list and a text-only file view, admin bundle rebuilt
agents can read usage ledger pace, the save pipeline backlog, active alerts and conversation search through four new read-only mcp tools that wrap the existing api routes
agents can write through the carnivore MCP tools (notes, create, message, keys, restart, stop); an agent's keys, restart or stop aimed at another session wait for the owner's approval
an action on a session of an unreachable paired Mac now alerts the reason (for example studio is not connected) instead of a bare HTTP 503

an agent's mcp tools now list and act on the paired mac's sessions (remote:peer ids) over the existing federation link; sending keys, restarting, stopping or creating on the other mac always waits in the approval inbox, reads and messages do not
an approval can no longer be answered against a different command: the dialog's command, path or plan is now part of what the answer is checked against, and the inbox card shows it
an approvals widget shows every open approval item with its answer buttons; the clock is gone from the drawer header, the rail and the phone strip
an mcp panel in settings: mint and revoke named read or write tokens so an outside mcp client can read Carnivore, with copy-paste connect snippets and a usage guide the client receives

an open agent dialog is extracted from the pane the watcher already reads, and an authenticated owner route answers it by arrow keys after re-checking the dialog is still the one the caller saw; claude's single-question footer and codex's capitalised and permissions dialogs are now detected

changes.details: the owner: "some analytics have a modal overlay. needs to be cleaned up a lot. weird scroll bars." The details view was a native dialog with its own frame whose body scrolled inside a dialog that also scrolled, a data table that scrolled inside that, a phone filter strip that scrolled on its own, and a class collision that painted every line of the view cyan. It is now DetailsModal on the shared dialog chassis (ModalShell, the text-prompt-modal title strip, mounted on the body) with one scrolling body, shared field and button primitives, and a full-screen sheet below 600px. The card opens it from a faint floating icon (.oc-ibtn--float, now shared with the home pop-out glyph). The pop-out window links the dialog chassis stylesheets.
changes.summary: analytics details: one clean dialog on the shared chassis, a single scrolling body with no nested or sideways scrollbars, opened from a faint floating icon

approving an already approved submission again now finishes a half-done publisher mark (flag set but lookalike reservation missing) and sends the approval mail the failed first attempt never sent; a fully marked submission still answers 409 with no mail
auto-sleep no longer skips pinned sessions: only sessions with keep awake (the coffee cup) are exempt, and the settings help says so

background work is measured from the process tree on every watcher pass: a stale transcript claim is overruled only when no tool shell runs under claude and claude's own record says idle, a restart retires the old process's claims, auto-sleep waits on a real running shell instead of a stale claim, and the listing carries the measured answer

body search: a new search_index save stage indexes each conversation's filtered text (tool output and thinking left out by default, rules changeable through a route) into a contentless index that stores only pointers (schema v52); a hit opens by decompressing the one backup frame that holds it; GET /api/v1/pipeline/search, GET and PUT /api/v1/pipeline/search-filter, /conversations/search?body=true merges it in, and a script rebuilds the index from the backups

carnivore.ai publishes the final terms (2026-10-01), privacy policy and content policy with no dmca designated agent, and the landing page download now links the latest public release, v1.12.13, with the site deploy pinned to the latest public release instead of macOS/package.json

catalog account erase finds every submission through a submitter index and revokes sessions again before the account row goes, unsubscribe changes mail only on POST, and the admin audit log pages past 100 rows

catalog security fixes, not yet deployed: handle lookalike folds cover i, l, 1, 4, 7, 8, 9, the email decoy session matches a real cognito session and answers a wrong code the same way, the deploy carries the registration gate switch forward, approval is refused when the email author lost the handle, log mode serves when the proof of work record cannot be written, and the pool update plan drops the deprecated validity field

community hardening: admin grants, renames and submission decisions are audited first, new community writes always require registration, dismissed comments reset their report count, held comments count past one page, comment text refuses format and private-use characters
conversation search finds live and older conversations: a background pass indexes conversations that were never closed, instead of waiting for a kill or sleep
copy now says computer instead of Mac, and the phone link is called mobile sync with a paired mobile device, so tablets and other computers fit too
creating a session while no tmux server is running no longer hangs forever under the app's uvloop event loop
delete your catalog account (fresh sign in and typed handle, resumable, hourly sweeper) or download your data as JSON

developer perf hooks, off by default: loop lag, per-route request rates, socket messages and bytes per topic and client, server and tmux cpu and memory, and watcher pass time pushed over /ws/events every 5 s, plus an in-page overlay with keypress-to-echo, received bytes, frames and every active timed poller; switch with CARNIVORE_DEV_PERF_HOOKS=1 or PUT /api/v1/dev/perf; audit in docs/performance-audit-2026-09-30.md
draft terms, privacy and content policy pages for carnivore.ai with a footer link row on the landing page, listed for the next site deploy and not yet deployed
each device gets its own catalog sign in: list your signed in devices and sign any of them out
email publisher records keep a github_login so installed apps accept the index; the mail unsubscribe link opens a confirm page; batch signing lists each item before the prompt
every claude and codex pane launch registers the Carnivore MCP server, so the agent can call its read-only session tools; off with mcp.enabled false

every transcript file is tracked by size, modification time and last line, a removed conversation raises an alert saying whether an archive copy or restore point exists, and old agent conversations whose folder moved can be backed up again

every widget declares the zones and sizes it fits, and the picker and resize handles offer only those; a widget placed where it cannot draw keeps its frame and shows a hatched "can't show here" plate with the smallest size that works and a report button that raises an alert; in edit layout each widget's corner icon becomes a gear whose menu holds configure (a side sheet beside the widget), reset size, extend or pull back a row, fold on phone, report a problem and close widget, replacing the separate remove x
google sign in asks for an emailed code the first time for an address google does not run the mailbox for, and the sign in polls are rate limited
hosted catalog comments api: threaded comments with one reply level, edit and delete, a daily cap, hold_all moderation and read-time author handles (no app ui yet)

hosted catalog community layer pure rules: comment ids that sort in thread order, text and link validation, edit window, report reasons, moderation modes (instant and hold_all), held cap, visibility and the established reporter auto-hide rule
hosted catalog gains pure per-kind submission validators for themes and plugins with shared test vectors, not wired into any route yet

hosted catalog moderation api: admin queue, hide, restore, delete, dismiss and a hold_all mode switch, each written to an append-only audit table first; invalid item ids now refuse before the registration gate reads any table
hosted catalog ops baseline script: cost tags, an alert topic, cloudwatch alarms, 30 day log retention and a tag filtered monthly budget, with prior state saved and a rollback line per resource

hosted catalog: branded sign in code email Lambda whose copy comes from the string catalog mail.* keys, a pure planner for the Cognito pool update with a before and after diff check, a mail and inbox deploy script (not yet run), and a skipped-by-default live identity suite
hosted catalog: disabling an account needs a reason and hides its comments and reviews at read time, an admin activity view per account, public profiles by handle with validated bio and https links
hosted submissions accept themes and plugins beside skills, the admin queue shows kind and submitter, and an audited admin file view reads one member as plain text
layout command bar skill list reads each receiving terminal's own account profile and offers only the global skills every profile has

library cleanup routes: merge one project into another, delete a session row (soft by default, a hard purge only for an already deleted row), drop a conversation index row, and preview or purge junk archive rows (re-homing any kept row whose bytes lived there); a dry-run-first executor applies the census plan through them, keeping every junk node that belongs to a kept human tree

mcp approval cards now show the resolved target and the full escaped payload, a revoked token's waiting actions are denied, a token write is pinned to its target, and the token file is checked at startup

mcp on a paired mac: a busy session's screen reads instead of timing out, the create approval card shows agent type and name, create caps read a fresh listing and no longer hold the create lock over the network, and a watcher socket never types a console's pending command

mcp send-keys approvals now show the full escaped text (invisible characters as \uXXXX) and keep sends with different tails apart; approval_wait waits for an approved action to finish; a same-pane check refuses when the pane identity is unknown or changed; a lone surrogate gets a clear error
on a phone the home screen top bar now carries the approval inbox button with its count, so the inbox opens from home (the header button was folded out of sight there)

one authenticated list of every open agent dialog on this Mac and its paired Mac, a live approvals event that carries only a count and a version, and dialog answers that forward to the Mac that owns the session; the test rig no longer lets codex update the global install
one typed parse for claude code transcript lines and codex rollout lines, measured against today's files, with synthetic fixtures and a drift tally
publish_batch sign signs every approved item in one minisign run with one passphrase and verifies each; publish_batch pr opens one pull request; fetch_approved is retired

publish_batch.py prepare stages approved skills, themes and plugins into the public repo's per-kind folders, drops a bad item with its reason, creates missing publisher records and writes the plan the sign step reads
publishing a plugin refuses any file outside the allowed paths before upload, and a new version can no longer change an item's kind

recent sessions show when each one closed (closed 2h ago, exact local time on hover) and are listed by last close time, most recently closed first; imported sessions with no recorded close say last active instead

relay phone-link mode: an SNI router and tunnel endpoint that forward a phone's encrypted bytes to the Mac's outbound tunnel, a control-plane acme-txt route and DNS follower, and the Mac-side signers, off by default and with its own breaker apart from share links
relay-control deploy merges the shared api stage route settings instead of replacing them, so the catalog auth throttles survive
removed the host health alerts (launchd, iCloud, snapshots, disk): carnivore no longer inspects your mac beyond its own components

removing a configurable analytics widget from the widgets drawer now deletes it (Done removes its saved definition; Undo and Cancel bring it back) instead of leaving a restore entry, so add then remove no longer grows the list forever, and stale duplicate restore entries are pruned on load; the save pipeline widget shows a separate re-chunk progress bar beside the backfill bar

reopening says what it is doing: the reboot offer shows each row queued, restoring, opened or failed with the reason under a "restoring 3 of 6" line, pushed from the server as each row settles; a recent row reads opening... then opened or the server's refusal, with a toast for each step, and the opened session is shown
requesting an email sign in code now solves a short proof of work first, and the catalog api base is api.carnivore.ai

save pipeline backfill: scripts/save_pipeline/backfill.py (dry run by default, --apply, --only missing|rechunk, --limit) queues ordinary pipeline jobs the running server picks up, a full save for every conversation on disk with no restore point and a lazy re-chunk of every single-frame point into verified, byte-exact frames followed by a re-index; background jobs run behind live saves on one slot, never evict a point to make room, and are safe to rerun
scrollbars are always drawn as a thin themed thumb wherever an area overflows and brighten under the pointer with no layout shift, instead of appearing only on hover
sessions started on a new tmux server download iCloud placeholder files when they read them, instead of failing with a deadlock error
settings can switch stats collection off, clear collected stats and reclaim the disk, and backfill to catch up; stats widgets say stats off while it is off
sign in to the catalog with Google; a verified Google address signs in as the email account for the same address

stats.changed is published only when a statistics pass actually moved something and names what (metrics, live, events, dimensions, clock_only); an idle pass that only adds observed time is sent at most once a minute. the home analytics re-query only the charts whose metrics moved, read the live and ticker feeds only when those moved, hold everything while the tab is hidden and catch up once on return, and no longer re-read on a 15 s or 60 s timer

submit a theme of your own to the catalog from the themes screen: the app checks the folder locally (theme.json plus raster images only), relays it with its kind, and shows any refusal with the offending file paths

summaries are now a stage of the save pipeline (schema v53), one path: a circuit breaker per summary server waits for a busy spark and uses the mini only when the spark is unreachable, never a paid api on its own; with every server down the summaries park without using retries and one alert says so until a server answers; a summary that keeps failing becomes a dead letter; retry, cancel and retry-dead routes under /api/v1/pipeline; the old summary queue is carried over into pipeline jobs
test rig that drives the real claude and codex binaries in a test slot against a scripted model server

the Mac side of the phone link: an ACME DNS-01 client for the link certificate, a loopback TLS listener behind a deny-by-default gate, the outbound tunnel client, pairing windows with QR and codes, paired-device revoke, and a relay.legacy_fallback switch; off until you turn it on
the account keepalive now runs a minimal claude -p that waits for its token save and checks the result, so managed accounts stop signing out before expiry; a revoked login says to sign in again

the alert bell moved into the agents drawer beside the Carnivore mark (and under the claw of the closed drawer's rail, with a severity dot on the phone's claw), every newly raised alert now shows a card coloured by its severity, and clicking the card opens the alert panel
the alert center reads and answers alerts at the right address, so the bell fills instead of hitting a 404 on every page load
the app relays the hosted community routes (comment threads, posting, reporting, profiles, mail preference) through authenticated app routes; no screen uses them yet

changes.details: Ruled by the owner, 2026-09-30, "yes do both". The freshness check compares size and mtime first and hashes only when those cannot decide, re-copies through the existing archive writer, and raises or resolves the archive.freshness alert. The time machine cap default rises from 4 GB to 8 GB; an install that never moved the slider picks it up on deploy.
changes.summary: the archive checks daily that its newest copy of every live transcript is current and re-copies any that are behind, and the time machine storage cap now defaults to 8 gb
the authenticator login screen wears the military terminal look: the carnivore wordmark in a title row, a square field, a flat confirm button and lowercase copy, in every theme, with no emoji

the background shell count no longer rereads every sub-agent transcript from the start on each watcher pass: its per-file caches held 256 entries while one conversation alone has over a thousand sub-agent files, so every read missed; the bound is now 8192 and an unchanged file costs one stat, not an open (0.87 to 0.014 cpu seconds a pass over 803 real files)
the catalog admin page tells confirm from destructive buttons, finds hidden comments by item and restores them, and reads each audit row as one line with a named actor and target
the catalog admin page wears the military terminal look, hide and delete need a reason, the signed in name and audit rows are readable

the catalog and the local gate refuse a shell fence marker anywhere in a markdown file and front matter hidden by lone carriage returns; the email sign in decoy session has the real session structure, one canonical spelling, is bound to its address and expires 15 minutes after issue in code; an approval whose publisher mark failed can be repaired by approving again; the hosted deploy aborts when it cannot read the current gate settings

the catalog api can mail reply, moderation, submission decision and admin report notices through ses behind a kill switch that ships off, with one click unsubscribe, a signed in opt out, five a day per person and a global daily cap; copy lives only in the string catalog

the catalog api takes reports of comments, reviews and items (one per account per target, ten a day); three distinct established reporters auto-hide a comment with a system audit row, an item is only queued for an administrator

the catalog batch publisher writes publisher records the public index builder accepts, refuses cross-kind name clashes, reserved handles and any push remote but the public repo, regenerates the marketplace file, rolls back on any sign failure, and rebuilds paths and hashes support files instead of trusting the plan

the catalog now has one registration gate for every write: a handle (3 to 39 of a-z, 0-9 and dash, fixed once chosen, lookalikes of reserved names and publishers refused), the current terms and a 16-or-older attestation, stored with their times; the publish view's claim form becomes a register form; a GitHub login outranks an unapproved email holder; the first approved submission marks the account a publisher

the catalog refuses skills that carry shell lines, hooks or tool grants, and any front matter that hides a key, and the app asks for script consent for any catalog item that ships settings, workflows, shell lines or hooks
the catalog shows a comment thread and author pages, reviews show the reviewer's handle, badge and a report action, and the account panel can turn reply emails off
the collapsed rail's C, 5h and 7d usage bars follow the terminal's bound session, so they show the account's real usage instead of staying empty
the daily archive freshness check obeys message_archive.enabled: with the switch off it skips as the named state disabled, persists no result and resolves its alert

the decoy email sign in session now has the real cognito layout, length and key arn and answers every verify case like a real session; audit responses serialize dynamodb numbers; deploy.sh index check and sweeper target fixed; live suite reads 8 digit codes

the desktop home screen has no header bar: one faint pop-out icon floats at the top right and opens a menu (pop out home, wallboard, each board), the clock and the approval inbox door moved into the agents drawer header beside the bell, the connection light sits beside the version in the drawer footer, the user icon there opens an account menu whose log out replaced the standalone logout button, the session count is gone, and new session joined search and deep search on one row with row detail in the tab row's view menu

the dmg deploy no longer aborts when no tmux server is running (the normal state right after a reboot): no server counts as an empty session list before and after, and any other tmux error still fails the deploy
the drawer footer chip shows your name (a setting, else this computer account's full name) with the plan only when known, and the version is the short form that never truncates

the drawer footer's account chip names your catalog account (its handle, with your identicon in a square hairline avatar) instead of the provider account and plan, reads Lurker with an anonymous avatar when you are signed out, opens with a sign in or catalog account item, and the live-channel status dot beside the version is gone
the drawer gains a questions tab, shown only while something waits on you, listing every open question in a cell outlined in its session's theme
the drawer's footer is an account chip (initial, account name, plan, chevron) that opens a menu with settings, edit layout, help, master all and log out; the version moved to the right

the email sign in decoy now matches 17 measured real cognito sessions (length, constant bytes, lenient spelling, per address lockout, separate start and verify timing) and passes through the per address meter; sign in meter rows expire and are removed when an account is deleted
the four library cleanup routes are classified local-only in the peer forward table, so a peer token never reaches them and a remote id never forwards to them

the hosted catalog admin page gains moderation (comment queue, review moderation, mode switch with confirm) and audit screens, a required reason when disabling a member, and a per-member activity view

the hosted catalog admin reads open item, review and comment reports grouped by target with reason counts and reporter handles, and dismisses a target's reports with an audit row written first; the admin moderation screen shows reason counts on queue rows and a reports tab
the installed app can push an "approval needed" alert from your Mac to your phone when the approval inbox gains an item

the library census no longer counts claude code's own warmup sidechains (a subagent file whose first prompt is the literal Warmup) as subagent runs, so a one-turn conversation from early 2026 can be judged trivial; the warmup files still belong to their conversation

the library cleanup purges a forked session row before the row it forked from, keeps a row a kept session row descends from, and resumes a stopped apply from its own frozen plan and log without repeating a step

the library cleanup reads the v49 lineage graph: the tree rule joins conversations through every lineage edge (so a junk conversation resumed, compacted, forked or spawned from a kept one is kept), and the index row delete refuses while an indexed conversation descends from it unless the operator ruled it junk by name
the live suite fallback cleanup releases a throwaway's handle claim so no orphan claim is left in the production users table
the merge step now rebuilds the committed catalog admin bundle too, so it cannot go stale behind a source or string change
the phone link lets a paired phone open a burst of parallel connections so the app loads without a TLS error; strangers stay on a small, half-share budget
the providers screen has an (i) note explaining in plain words how account keep-alive works

the publish list offers your own plugins beside skills and themes with a kind picker; every catalog write (comment, reply, rating, report) opens the register dialog for an unregistered account and continues once it registers; handle errors are shown in words; deleting the account needs the exact handle typed

the reboot reopen offer no longer blocks a plain shell session with no conversation: it is selectable and comes back as a fresh shell in its folder under the shell wrapper, while a claude session with no conversation stays blocked

the reboot reopen offer no longer blocks every session with no wrapper to start it with: the app's own --mcp-config is ignored when matching a session's wrapper and is never listed as a flag it comes back without

the reboot reopen offer now reads each session's recorded agent family from the database, so a plain shell session such as mini terminal is selectable and comes back as a fresh shell under the shell wrapper instead of showing claude and no conversation recorded; a codex row's conversation is looked up in codex's own store

the relay control plane refuses a catalog access token whose session was signed out or revoked, or whose account is disabled, on the next request; a token with no session claim keeps working until it expires
the reload prompt lists what is new since the page loaded, grouped by type, with where to find each one

the save pipeline widget no longer polls: it reads GET /pipeline/summary once and repaints from a pipeline.summary frame the server pushes over /ws/events when the counts change (at most once a second), with backfill and re-chunk progress counted in SQL instead of paging /pipeline/jobs 500 at a time every 15 s; the alert center drops its 30 s re-read and relies on its app_alert frames, re-reading only after a reconnect and once when a snoozed alert is due to wake

the save pipeline: every save (kill, remove, sleep, restart, /clear and a new manual save) is one durable job (schema v51) whose stages capture, verify, record the milestone and write the index row, retried with backoff, resumed after a restart, and raised as an alert when a stage keeps failing; a manual save pins its point and is a save milestone; read routes under /api/v1/pipeline

byoai foundation: ai connection contract, presets, config block, keychain keys, transport and call log

new machine stats widget: cpu, memory, disk free, load and uptime of the computer Carnivore runs on, at 2 x 2 or 8 x 2, pushed live only while it is on screen

custom domains: the first certificate order waits for the DNS pin and a young binding retries within minutes, not an hour

dashboards have their own menu item: create, rename, set active, open in a pop-out to view and edit, export, import and delete (never the active one); the active dashboard is the home screen on every browser, and the board picker left the edit layout drawer
database v56 adds a nullable launch_record column on sessions, the home of the per session record of what launched (issue 1257, slice S1b); nothing reads or writes it yet
dead custom domains are answered by a sidecar in the relay task instead of a separate box

every widget's one corner icon opens one menu with every option (edit layout, config, size, rows, fold, pop out, info, its own sort and view all, report, close), the same in edit layout; config opens a settings popover beside the widget with grouped plain-word settings, toggles and segmented choices that apply at once, reset and done; info opens a card read off the widget's declaration; analytics chart settings moved out of the chart body into that popover

glances are their own area in the sidebar: in edit layout a yellow-dashed glance area appears under the open widget area, widgets are dragged into it separately and reordered among themselves, and each placement keeps its own options (the providers glance picks which account it shows, so it can be placed once per account); the edit layout dashes are now drawn in front of widget content so nothing covers them
hide on the working on line now turns the summary off for every browser and stops its model calls; settings, ai, summaries has one row per type with its model nested under the switch

huddle items are numbered top to bottom, each row is an accordion (one line collapsed, full detail open), and an item can carry a kind pill (your call, done, waiting, info) so claude no longer prefixes the text
huddle ships off on a fresh install with nothing granted; the plugins page lists add-ons after the plugins with a switch that turns one on and grants what it asks, or off keeping its data
launch profiles: the data model, its config store, the unregistered wrapper-to-profile config step, and the bundle rules land with no behaviour change yet (S1 of #1257)
launching a new agent from a project in the Projects window now switches the drawer to the Agents tab so the new session is visible
log processor summaries follow the default chat connection, with an override switch to pick any connection for priority 1 and priority 2; the cloud backup switch is gone

mark unread and share read only are now plugins you can switch on the plugins page, the old plugin list is gone, and open as widget is removed from the session menu (edit layout and drag to the grid still add a session)

changes.details: The pair page no longer shows a second code or install steps. A scan only starts a pending pairing; the authenticator code completes it. The QR changes every minute, and the computer shows when a phone scanned and which device paired, with revoke. A typed code (no camera) stays as the fallback. Orphaned duplicate mobile devices from the old flow are not removed: revoke any row that has not been seen since this update.
changes.summary: mobile sync pairing is one scan: scan the code, type your authenticator code on the phone, and you are in
on a phone the attached-file notification is a small card showing just the thumbnail, no longer full width
redirect box for dead custom domains: Caddy config, ask sidecar, deploy script
relay routes custom hostnames from the signed token claim
remove the unused RatingsBlock component, its test and its seven strings after the themes page layout (#1261) replaced it
removing a custom domain now clears it from the settings panel, even when the name is already dead on the control plane
renaming a session from the terminal kebab's actions menu now works with the drawer closed, asking for the new label in the shared text prompt

the add-on host: add-ons are listed, switched on or off and granted per install at /api/v1/addons (and the addons_list and addon_update tools); a switched-off add-on's routes answer addon_disabled, its tools leave the tool list and its tab and menu link disappear
the agent icon at xhigh effort is a steady purple with a moving sheen instead of flashing between purple and white, and at high effort it shimmers in its own colour

the bottom status line keeps its three progress bars in a wide cell: the reset timers, full-word labels and long work labels give way before the bars do; the context, 5h and 7d labels are white at every width and only the percent carries the usage colour
the bottom status line shows the reset timers again at about 990px: the extra edge spacing now takes only leftover room, and the timers outrank the full context word and the token fraction
the conversation transcripts removed from disk alert no longer shows; open ones resolve at startup
the custom domain panel has a copy setup prompt for your agent button that copies the exact dns record and the rules for adding it
the foot bar's account name now sits inside the bar: the strip and its top line run under it to the right edge

the huddle is the first add-on: its routes moved to /api/v1/addons/huddle, its push topic is addon.huddle.list, and its file moved once into the add-on folder (addons/huddle/huddle.db) with every item kept; it is on by default with its grants

the huddle's all projects view now shows every project's items under its project heading (the shared list first), each in its own priority order, and the pop-out window opens on the list the sidebar was showing

the huddle: a shared list between you and claude in the left sidebar, one per project plus all projects. claude adds items, marks them done and asks on an item; you add, drag to reorder, check what is good, leave a note, reply in each item's thread and press tell claude. the tab appears when claude posts without taking focus, and any sidebar tab that declares it can now pop out into its own window
the open layout's name in its top bar is now a tab, with a plus that adds other saved layouts as tabs so you can switch between layouts from the strip
the pace marker on limit gauges is white everywhere, stays inside the bar in the bottom status line, and the foot bar meters no longer shrink in a narrow cell

the plugin and skill detail pane now reads like the themes inspector: an icon tile, the name, a rating summary link that scrolls to the ratings section, the id, source, developer and version block, then the ratings, the comments (every rating with words shows as a comment with its stars and author) and a bug icon for a note to the developer; the catalog toolbar is one centred row at the themes bar's control height
the prompt header bar and rail ticks now appear only on claude sessions, so a shell with a fancy caret prompt no longer gets bogus prompt ticks
the prompt header bar and rail ticks now find your prompts by their shape instead of claude's prompt colour, so a colour change in claude can no longer make them vanish
