the providers widget shows one glance tile per account it lists, side by side, each naming its account (two claude logins were one tile); the auto switch toggle is one mark, the robot inside a ring of arrows, instead of a robot and a recycle side by side; the fold chevron loses its three step dots
the rename prompt opened from the terminal kebab's actions menu now starts with the name the drawer shows, not the session's tmux name

the sidebar widget area has exactly three states, closed, glance and full: a thin drag handle replaces the labelled bar, a small pull-up chevron opens it full while closed, a drag snaps to the nearest state, full is as tall as its widgets; glance tiles are half size, one per provider naming the account, a widget with no glance is a same-size icon tile; edit layout outlines every surface that takes widgets
the terminal foot bar names the provider account the session runs under in place of the agents count, with a yellow warning when it is not the active account

the terminal foot bar: account tag in the agents count's type with a yellow hazard triangle, pace marker exactly the bar's height, brighter bar outlines, double the space around the meters, and the dead agents show/hide setting removed
the terminal header kebab now says background instead of terminal background and ends with an actions item that opens the session row menu for that pane's session

the themes page shows a rating summary under the theme name that scrolls to a ratings section, ratings with words appear in the comments with stars and author, dates read as dates, ratings use a themable fang mark, and the developer note opens from a bug icon

the themes page top bar lines up on one centre line with matching control heights and stronger text and border contrast, the current global theme name is a link that opens it in the inspector, and only a theme's developer can reply to a comment

the widget area's mini row draws glance tiles: the provider widget shows one tile per provider with its 5h and 7d figures and pacer bars (amber when 15 points ahead), and a widget with no glance stays its icon
the working on line links to settings when no model is picked, ends with a [hide] control saved per browser, and settings has a switch to show it again
toasts now always appear in the top-right corner of the whole window, never mid-screen at the edge of a terminal tile
use your own domain for mobile sync: add one CNAME, a short-lived certificate is minted on this computer
widget sizes are suggestions, not limits: a widget placed at any size fills the box and adapts, and dividers snap to a suggested size
Acknowledge Claude messages absorbed during active turns after native queue consumption
Apply requested models to default Claude and transparent Codex launches, and supervise the transparent Codex YOLO command for native delivery.
Classify local fork, prompt history and huddle candidates in the peer route inventory without granting peer access.
Crosstalk cards accept message and thread ids containing underscores and show outgoing Codex tool results.
Fresh Codex coworkers keep their requested permission posture and receive queued tasks without a starter prompt.
Fresh structured Codex coworkers attach a persisted zero-turn thread before receiving their queued task.
Keep active tabs visible by scrolling only their horizontal strip, leaving outer pages at their chosen position.
Local fork lineage uses the shared host scope in addition to its pinned child identity.
Show crosstalk messages as expandable terminal cards beside their exact delivery line.
a checkbox with no label text no longer draws a frame around its box
a codex launch profile on a connection now reaches codex's app-server, and restarting a live codex session looks for its rollout instead of a claude transcript (found by the S9b end to end run)
a destination whose address changed now shows its private-address and plain-http switches off, so saving the form can no longer re-approve an address you never looked at
a pop-out window now takes the pushed session listing like the main window instead of re-reading the session list, the asleep list and the recent list every 5 seconds for as long as it stays open
a question alert and the status tooltip now say a question is waiting, with question N of M when the pane shows which part waits, instead of the permission wording
a terminal viewer that disconnects mid-send is logged at debug instead of error, so a closing tab no longer reads as a failure
agent MCP requests have bounded bodies and stronger credential redaction; approvals pin live panes, protect open dialogs and cap pending actions and agent-created sessions
agent drawer layout clicks focus the exact session, blocked storage is reported as unreadable, and the model icon shimmers only at the top efforts
agent messages reach live Claude and Codex panes through their native inboxes, and Claude native messages appear as cards
agents can send durable crosstalk messages with first-contact approval and safe delivery
agents can spawn a claude or codex coworker beside their terminal and receive its reply
agents drawer: clicking a session under an expanded layout opens that layout and brings the session's tab into focus, instead of leaving the layout
agents_lookup: agents find other agents by name (case, spaces, dashes ignored), local and paired computers, any provider
an unknown launch profile pick at create is now refused instead of silently running claude; endpoint profiles get their key at create, and each session records the launch it ran (S4b of #1257)

any row of the edit layout widget drawer can be dragged into the sidebar widget area or the glance area, not just onto the screen; while a widget is carried both areas tint to show they take drops, the one under the pointer shows where it will land or turns coral and says why when it cannot take that widget; the drawer no longer hides widgets by place or counts them under the list
arm beast mode to let agents act without approval while safety rails remain active
catalog install keeps the review, instruction-file warning and choices visible when a name collision returns a preview

claude can point you at huddle items with the new huddle_focus tool (they light up, the most urgent opens, and the tab shows a badge until you touch the list); the open item is redesigned on one aligned grid, the sidebar's controls are three icon keys, hide completed is a frameless check, and the pop-out keeps compact controls and shows claude's mark
codex panes only show a ledger account's usage when the login is the same person, not just the same shared workspace, so another member's 0% is no longer shown as yours
codex sessions on the default login now resolve to their ledger account by account id, so the foot bar shows the 7d window and the account tag
crosstalk delivers through authenticated paired-computer receipts and can spawn agents across machines
custom domains for mobile sync: plain http on port 80 now redirects to https on the same host and path (relay listener, needs the port 80 deploy)
deliver held Claude crosstalk when a retired tmux pane has exited

each huddle item claude added, changed, answered or pointed at shows the unread light until you open or tick it, on every device; the tab badge and the list picker count the unread items, and claude's huddle tools say which ones you have not seen

each huddle row's stripe now says who it waits on (claude's question for you, your change claude has not read, claude working, waiting on your review, ticked), claude reading the huddle moves your changes to working by itself, tell claude shows the session it will tell in a dropdown that follows the active tab and a count of your unread changes, the add box's list follows the active tab's project, and the popped-out huddle shows its unread lights

every page's top band (title bar, selected tab, search and filter bar) sits on the theme's chrome ground and the data below on the theme's page ground, so the bar no longer shows a stray lighter grey on some themes or vanishes into the page on others

every pop-out window boots the same push channels as the main window and resyncs after a reconnect, shows the reload pill when a new install or client update lands under it, and shows an 'offline, data may be stale' marker with the age of the last live moment and a retry once its live channel has been down for 8 seconds; both windows re-check the channel the moment they become visible or the network comes back

every widget goes everywhere: the widget drawer is one list with no sidebar or glance shelves and no pills under find (one kind select beside it), any row drops onto the dashboard grid, the sidebar widget area or the glance area, and nothing is drawn refused; a box a widget was not tested for shows a generic icon and "not available at this size" in place of the widget; the server no longer refuses a placement by place

family widgets (terminal, browser, analytics) drop into the sidebar widget area and the glance area too, each drop a fresh copy with its own session, browser or chart; drawer rows lose the sizes text and get their small preview back; session, terminal and browser read as one segmented window row above the list; the widget fit check fails on any slip (content past the top or bottom, a line cut mid-glyph, one label over another) at every tested size and aspect, the sidebar widths and the glance row; a widget's settings sheet or description card opened near the bottom of the window (a glance tile at the foot of the sidebar) moves up until all of it is on screen; the not-available plate steps down to fit short boxes
fork a live Claude or Codex conversation into either provider from its session row or agent tool
forks preserve their worktree and durable child contact, pinning source and requester across approval for exact-source requests
honor requested Codex model and bind its attached thread when the account home is symlinked
huddle items you add wear a person icon where claude's wear the agent mark, and tell claude from the all projects view names the lists that actually changed with each one's own list argument
initialize the attention watcher's shared pane-map state before its first publication, preserving the listing's fresh-map fallback
keep the offline style guide from requesting feature media, refresh its live contrast sample and descriptions, and recognize typed global aliases in the client cross-reference guard
keep the style guide, feature paths and isolated browser rig aligned with shipped UI
launch profiles page replaces the wrappers page: form editor, live command preview, check, duplicate, guarded delete and import, templates (S8a of #1257)

launch profiles: /api/v1/launch-profiles routes (list, create, change, delete, default, icon, usage, preview, check, export, import), a guarded delete and import, a launch_profiles_list MCP tool, and a BYOAI connection that a profile uses can no longer be deleted (S7 of #1257)
launch profiles: endpoints from AI connections, secret materialize on the stdin env path and the config v8 step (LM Studio connection) land with no behaviour change yet (S3 of #1257)
launch profiles: every launch now resolves through the profile resolver, config v7 and v8 are registered, and the old wrapper routes write the profile store (S4a of #1257)
launch profiles: the pure launch resolver (plan, render, permission table) for claude, codex and shell lands with no behaviour change yet (S2 of #1257)
layout command bar: a leading /skill or $skill is sent as /skill to Claude Code panes and $skill to Codex panes
let crosstalk cards reveal full messages and open the sending agent
make carnivore tools available on an agent's first turn and show current pane names on its approval card
mobile sync rejects malformed link traffic and repeated failed pairings; phone revocation also clears push subscriptions, with stricter push endpoints and send limits
native delivery resolves the live provider conversation and keeps the crosstalk reply identity in Claude messages
one launch picker for new session, launchpad, project, clone, reopen offer and blueprint members, a project default launch profile, and launched with text on session rows (S8b of #1257)
page title bars are 37px (one 44px row on a phone) and plugin rows are one 28px line, with the limits behind one (i)
page title bars keep their actions at the right edge on a phone, the plugins page drops its noisy title and draws one search row, and the projects sort select no longer clips its text
paired-computer message receipts enforce the 30-message conversation pause after authenticated owner controls and reset stale pause state when a pane instance changes

plain http and private-address switches now stay bound to the address you approved, public and metadata targets are refused in every notation, and only webhook and ntfy can report a local-switch refusal
plugins are cards in a grid by default (their own icon, switch, brief, tier and surface tags, author), with a grid and list toggle remembered per device; list is the old 28px rows

plugins are dense 28px rows with their limits in an (i); hosts has machines and pairing tabs inside settings; launch profiles and hosts left the drawer menu (keys l and h open their settings sections)
prepare bounded conversation replay for cross-provider forks
preserve hosted review fields exactly in catalog ratings
providers widget: accounts group by provider alphabetically, the active account first, then the accounts auto-switch would use next in its own order, the rest last
ratings now use bracketed monospace asterisks instead of a fang or a theme-provided icon
rebuild the public website as a scroll-driven Carnivore field guide with real interface imagery and a session-continuity illustration
report the optional message archive routes as off when only unrelated archive freshness routes are mounted
restart from recent finds a codex conversation when the session was started from a launch profile, instead of refusing it as missing
restart keeps the launch model and refuses a deleted launch profile by name instead of falling back to the claude default (S5a of #1257)
restore guarded crosstalk pastes and remote session reads

changes.details: Destinations (slack, discord, teams, telegram, ntfy, pushover, a signed webhook, email, sms through aws sns or twilio, pagerduty, and every web push device) keep their secrets in the Keychain. One matrix of 29 notification types by screen and destination decides what goes where; the screen column now decides which cards pop up, and the bell, history, light and tray keep everything. Web push carries typed per-type copy and per-device ticks. Settings sync to paired computers, and an agent can send you a notification with the notify tool. A ride-along fix: claude's folder-trust prompt now shows in the approvals inbox.
changes.summary: send notifications outside the app: twelve destination kinds, a per-type routing matrix, sync across paired computers, and an agent notify tool

settings rows sit in one framed column with the label left and the control right, a number shows its unit inside the field, dependent rows nest and dim, and save moved into a footer inside the frame (the floating save bar is gone)
settings sections are tabbed pages (sessions & agents: auto-sleep, agents, time machine, conversation index), launch profiles and hosts moved into settings, and the header shortcuts group is gone

settings tables get column heads, read-only values (mcp endpoint, tokens, snippets, dns record) become copy fields, the theme and hosts row show quiet value pills, the appearance colors tab is a normal row, and clear stats and remove custom domain sit in a lifecycle frame last in their tab

settings, ai, routing hides the log processor's summary features while its override is off; with it on they list under add-ons, each name a link that opens the log processor's ai tab and flashes the override switch

settings: launch profiles reads as one surface (no second title bar, quiet default badge, list takes the width until a profile is picked), hosts this-machine row drops its empty gutter, account section gets room under the bar

settings: the launch profiles link reads its copy instead of a raw key, column heads hide on a phone, the unsaved dot no longer truncates a rail label, and phone buttons start at the label's left edge
shared buttons, anchored popups, and drawer and home chrome now follow the design system rules across themes; text headings no longer carry tooltips
show Claude title and reachable transports in agent lookup cards
stat tiles on a board are full width again; the new icon tile class no longer collides with the stat tile cell
tell claude reaches a claude started through a launch profile's shell, and the huddle says which session it told or why it was not sent

tell claude sends to the session that last used the huddle (else a project's only agent session, else you pick), always shows whom it will tell and why before sending, and no longer refuses an adopted claude whose row records its launch

the MCP session_create tool takes a launch_profile: the new session launches with that profile and the result shows its label, harness, account, model and permissions badge; blueprint launches and the time machine summary resolve through launch profiles too
the account editor shows fixed identity details as text, and its xterm color picker offers 249 distinct swatches without duplicates
the add-a-destination kind is now the custom picker, grouped chat, push, incident, sms and other with each service's logo before its name, instead of the native select
the add-on link on settings, ai, routing opens the add-on's settings tab and flashes its switch directly instead of relying on the browser's fragment navigation

the dashboards page says what it is (your active dashboard is your home screen, any other opens in its own window) and shows every dashboard as a card with a preview of its layout, a clear home screen marker, rename in place and set as home, open, edit and delete; its title and search sit on the band ground and the cards on the page ground; in the widget drawer session, terminal and browser are three rows above a hairline that fold open to the live ones to add, and the analytics gallery's sub items are tidied
the drawer menu has a new order, a help heading, and real hotkeys that fire while the menu has focus

the huddle list is an accordion with one item open at a time and a cleaner open layout, shows each item's state as a colour stripe instead of a pill, marks claude's items with the session icon alone, reads info items muted, hides completed items on request and removes them with one button, adds several items at once from a multiline box, opens on the project of the tab you were on, and uses compact controls; the pop-out previews two lines

the huddle move to picker now uses the app's menu look: plain rows, the item's own list marked with a check, long project names clipped with an ellipsis, kept inside the window, with arrow keys, escape and outside click to close
the isolated terminal paint smoke test marks the account welcome as seen through the preferences API before clicking a session row

the menu bar tray reads the server's last computed session listing instead of forcing a fresh gather on every poll, the attachable listing no longer runs tmux on the event loop, and a working agent tells browsers to re-read projects at most once a minute instead of every turn
the new-wrapper script example shows how to pass Carnivore's launch arguments through with "$@"
the old wrappers routes, wrappers page and settings wrappers panel are deleted; launch profiles are the only way to configure how an agent starts (S9a of #1257)
the opscenter status line now says a question is waiting, with question N of M when known, instead of the permission wording
the prompt header's expanded view shows a multi-paragraph prompt whole, read from the claude transcript, instead of only its first paragraph
the restart picker and the wake menu list their choices as the one launch picker, with harness mark, account, model, permissions badge and the default marked (S8c of #1257)
the sessions and projects pages are dense: group header rows, 28px session rows, tabbed session page with resume in the title bar

the skills catalog page no longer overdraws descriptions on a phone, gives the search and publisher filter room, says the index age as "5h ago", reads "close", and lines its rows up with the other pages
the skills catalog toolbar is one row again on a wide window: the search takes the free space and the filter chips scroll sideways instead of pushing sort and publish onto a second row
the skills menu row opens one skills page with catalog, installed, census and diet tabs; catalog rows are 28px with one toolbar

the tell claude button turns to the accent colour while you have changes claude has not been told about and clears after a tell, and an open huddle item has a move to key (and claude a huddle_move tool) that sends it to another list with its thread, note, state and unread dot
the terminal foot bar re-measures in the same pass that its usage content changes, so its meters never run past the bar for a frame
the unused header quicklink preference and its script are retired; a stored value is ignored and dropped on the next save

the widget drawer is a compact list, one row per widget with its icon, name and suggested sizes, a search box and kind chips; the (i) on a widget opens a description card (what it shows, a preview, sizes, where it can go, options, who made it), also on the widgets page; a dashboard pop-out can add widgets with the same drawer, saved through that dashboard's own route

wake, recreate, imported restart, restart, fork and resume-a-conversation now relaunch from the session's recorded launch profile: the recorded model is replayed, a deleted profile is refused by name instead of falling back to the claude default, and each relaunch records its own launch
webhook and ntfy destinations can use plain http to a private address, behind an off-by-default switch that is per computer and never synced

widget polish: the gear opens a widget's settings directly (charts too), the sidebar widget area loses its hidden sizer, widget edit outlines are cyan and the glance area's are yellow on all four sides, and a providers glance whose account is gone shows every account
a blueprint remembers each session's keep awake, muted notifications and terminal background, and applies them to the sessions it creates
a brand-new claude sitting on its empty prompt reads idle instead of grey, and a restart's own first finished turn stays quiet even when the watcher stops watching the row mid-restart

a huddle item can carry a short title (claude may write one for any item); rows show the title, the latest message and a reply box after claude's info or question; a compact, normal or full density switch sits beside the view switch

a huddle item can carry an optional review block (what to review, where to find it, a link), set by claude with done_by_claude; the row shows it under the text, without opening it, while the item is ready to review

a huddle item claude built and committed but has not put on your app yet sits in its own waiting to install section under ready to review; claude sets it with huddle_update state waiting_install and your reply reopens it

a huddle item shows working only when claude started it or read a change you sent with tell claude, and stops working when claude posts a question, look or info or marks it done; an item claude only read stays open

a look from claude works like an info on the huddle row: each unread look shows in full in the look color with its own look icon that marks that one read; the look status and section are gone so a look never moves an item (it still marks the item unread and badges the tab)
a new settings item under appearance lists the sidebar's tabs and lets you pick a theme color for each; the tab strip paints it as the tab's accent, synced to every device

a question, permission or input alert now closes itself the moment the watcher sees the dialog answered, on every window; an input ask no longer waits for the turn to end, and an ask answered straight into another ask closes the first card

a session stopped on a startup screen (folder trust, mcp server approval, resume picker, bypass warning, first run, or any other screen claude has not started past) shows as a read-only card in the approvals inbox naming the session and what the screen says; clicking it opens the session, it clears when the screen is gone, and the screen is written to the session journal
a session that used a tool returning its own numeric status (RemoteTrigger's http code) no longer sits on an unknown light once it goes idle

a widget can declare how many copies one page may hold (max_per_surface); a drop over the limit says only one clock per page style, naming the widget, and at one copy the drawer offers to move the existing one; the widgets page shows the limit in the detail only when set; the live terminal cap of 6 is unchanged
after a recreate or a restart from recent, a session is still the huddle's default tell target and keeps its read position
ai settings, routing: the plugin overrides list sits behind a chevron, closed by default, with its count in the heading; it still only shows while a plugin's override is on

ai summaries no longer fall back to your chat default: with no model of its own the line sends nothing and says so, a token readout shows the last hour's cost, and summarize, backup and save are three plugins you can switch on and off (summarize and backup off by default, save on; each install keeps what it ran)

an ai connection that speaks the openai chat wire takes extra request fields (json), an object merged into every chat request for it, such as vllm's chat_template_kwargs to turn thinking off; secret-looking fields are refused. a custom connection now lists the models its server serves instead of an empty list
an asleep agent can be killed from its row menu: kill agent confirms, then removes the sleeping record (the conversation history is kept)

by status, dragging a huddle row over another area's rows in the same section now shows the insertion line there and dropping files the row in that area at that place; before, only rows of the same status and the same area could be reordered and every other drop snapped back
cards on the skills and plugins pages are bigger: the same card size as the providers page

claude's huddle write tools answer lean by default (lean false for the full item), huddle_changes stops resending unchanged groups and the text of items whose only news is a new message, and huddle_focus with list all accepts items from any project

deep search is a plugin: the drawer's deep search button now searches the text of every saved conversation, subagents included, grouped by conversation, and a click opens or resumes it; the plugin ships on, needs save and says paused when save is off; with it off the box filters session names only, and agents keep the conversation_search tool
dragging a huddle row now shows a ghost of it following the pointer, area headers light up as drop targets, and escape or dropping elsewhere cancels

dragging a huddle row over other rows shows an insertion line and dropping there reorders it, by area and by status, in the sidebar and the pop-out; an area header still moves it to that area and Escape or a drop outside cancels
dragging a session onto home no longer says at most 6 when home holds charts but no terminals: the add cap counts only terminal and browser viewers, never chart cells

each unread claude info shows in full on its huddle row, each with its own info icon that marks that one read; the row icon always shows the item's status and the info section is gone (compact shows an info count)

every built-in widget draws properly at each size it names: the block sizes are tall enough for what they hold (tall a narrow column, medium a square block, large a wide block, full a band across the row), lists show rows under their header, charts fill their space instead of drawing not available, title rows keep their name and their view all word; in edit layout a widget below its smallest size now shows the arrows and the words pointing the way (drag down, drag right, make smaller) even when it is short, where before it said only not available
every notification type can be turned off: the needs-you screen cells are no longer locked on, they start ticked and can be unticked like any other
huddle: holding shift in a reply or add box turns its button into send + tell in the tell colour, and a question you answered in the terminal can be closed with the new huddle_mark_answered tool

huddle: the new huddle_batch tool applies up to 50 edits in one call with a lean answer, and lean true on the single write tools plus include_thread false on list and changes cut the size of what agents read back
in the all-projects huddle view, folding a status section only folds it in that project; a project can fold to its title bar, showing a chip with the count of each status
in the by-status view, each status section breaks into one subsection per area, headed like the by-area view's subsections
interactive todo groups: a new group shows in all projects at once, even empty and even in a list with no items yet, and claude's huddle_list and huddle_changes answer the groups the items sit in
launching a blueprint wakes its asleep sessions instead of duplicating them, creates only the missing ones, and asks before updating a layout it already saved
loading a blueprint keeps each agent's own theme and reuses sessions that are already running, creating only the closed ones
mcp: a project_rename tool renames a project's display name through the app's own rename route after the owner approves; folder, ids and sessions are untouched
on a phone, a page opened from the account menu now closes the drawer, and back returns to the drawer on its tab
on a phone, a sidebar widget area shrunk to zero shows a taller up-chevron tap target (44px) with the words tap to enlarge; desktop is unchanged
pairing a phone from the same phone works: switching tabs to type the code no longer closes the pairing window
phone back arrow retraces: a page opened from the drawer goes back to the drawer on its tab, a page opened from another page goes back to that page
phone header is one 56px bar: back arrow, the title over the search in one frame, the filters that fit and one grid/list flip
phone header: a back arrow replaces the claw while a page is open, the page's search takes the title bar, and filters, actions and the grid/list toggle share one row
phone: skills joins the omnibar (back, SKILLS over the search, the view flip in one bar) and the tab and filter rows slide away on scroll down and return on a small scroll up on every page
phone: the skills filter row fades at its right edge, like the tab rows, so the last control is no longer cut off
plugins, blueprints and the skills installed tab use the shared page toolbar: search, a state facet, sort and the grid/list flip
providers cards wear the revamped pages' card and chip colours with no layout change; the skills where select is a toolbar facet
providers: status in the title strip, usage as the hero figure, a headroom strip ranked by worst window; blueprints: member marks in one tile, family tags and session count in the footer
sessions and projects pages get the shared top (toolbar, busiest projects, what matters now), a ledger or cards toggle and a session detail drawer

sessions and projects pages: ranked rows show the agent mark or a letter tile, the phone title row is the omnibar alone, each toolbar facet is its own box; the skills catalog toolbar never clips a control and its phone sign-in joins the facets row
skills: census is a ranked list, diet is two panels, installed is a grid of cards

tell claude to a busy session (a question, a dialog, an unconfirmed status) is held and sent once the session is free, never into an open dialog; a colored notice by the tell key says held or not sent, a hold that times out (plugin setting, 30 minutes) raises a toast, and a session that stops while held sends nothing and the next tell asks who to tell

telling claude about a project with no session of its own never sends it anywhere by itself: the pop-up and the reply box offer start a new session (told once it is ready), a running session, or stop (the items stay waiting to send)
telling claude about a project with no session of its own now offers every running agent session to pick from, in the pop-up and beside the reply box, instead of leaving the item waiting to send

the huddle gains look and info sections for items with an unread attention or info reply from claude, each with its own icon; sections now run question, look, info, review, working, waiting to send, open, done
the huddle tab badge counts every incomplete item (not approved, not deleted) of the list the tab shows, all lists for all projects; unread shows on the row instead
the huddle tab's count badge counts only open items: an approved (done) or deleted item no longer adds to it

the interactive todo drops the per-row lights beside the text and shows unread, info and attention on the left stripe instead; the reply and add keys turn the confirm colour when there is text to send and flash sent after; ticking or unticking an item now counts as a change to tell claude about

the interactive todo has groups: make named, foldable sections inside a list, drag items into, out of and between them (or use move to), numbering counts on across them, and claude can make groups and file its items by area with huddle_group_create, huddle_group_update and the group argument of huddle_add and huddle_move

the interactive todo shows a small status icon where the item number was (an info icon while claude has a message you have not opened); by area each area splits into status subsections; an open item shows its thread as a chat in its own scroll box, landing on the newest message; tell claude tells every changed list into its own session and asks in one pop-up only for lists with no session, a reply box picks a session when its list has none, and the dropdown beside tell claude is gone; a successful tell clears the waiting count at once; the pop-out has a foot strip so rounded window corners do not clip it

the interactive todo sorts itself into status sections by default (question for you, waiting to send, working, ready to review, open, done folded) that items move between on their own; a by status / by area switch at the top is stored on the server, rows show their area as a tag, a drag in the status view reorders inside its section, and the numbers follow the chosen view so the number you see is the one claude gets

the interactive todo tells claude's notes apart: an fyi while claude works keeps the item working, is not unread and shows a small yellow light; a call for your attention is unread and shows a blue light; a blocking question is unchanged. shift+enter in a reply box or the add box saves and tells claude in one go, and the tell claude count no longer clips at the sidebar's edge

the light is right straight after a restart: no false question from a question the old process asked, no false green from its background agents, no grey after restarting into a new conversation, and the dying process no longer counts as the new one having started

the live label and the handoff summary share one token budget (250,000 an hour and 2,000,000 a day by default, set in settings, ai, summaries); when it is spent every summary pauses and the panel says when they resume. one readout shows what both cost, and a handoff summary now sends only what the conversation added since the last one, about 66 to 89 percent fewer tokens
the pair page now says pairing is kept per address, so a phone paired on one address knows to open that one or pair again

the restart picker shows one row when launched with and current are the same launch, with both badges; update and restart on a session with open shells or background work now opens the picker, which says that work will be killed, instead of refusing

the skills catalog is a grid of cards by default (icon tile, install state, two-line brief, trust marks and publisher), with source and type facets, a grid/list toggle that remembers your choice, and a packs podium; on a phone the search moves into the title row
the skills page gets the shared toolbar, a top-fired strip and ranked panels from the census, cards by default and a large image area on every card
the toast a huddle question raises goes away on every window and device once you reply, open or tick the item, mark it read, or mark the question answered

the top right open menu lists the home screen as its dashboard, its wallboard, every other dashboard and the tabs that pop out; a popped-out page scrolls; a dashboard pop-out shows edit layout and names the dashboard; the drawer menu has pop-out keys and dashboard previews; a widget's settings open outside edit layout; a placed widget stays draggable and a drop where it already is asks whether to add a second copy

the widgets page is built like themes: a list on the left, the first widget selected on open, a detail with how it works and live previews of every size it supports (sample data by default, a toggle for real data); sizes are named (small, wide, tall, medium, large, full) and no size numbers show to anyone; the edit layout drawer shows no size details and offers every widget on every surface; a widget at an unsupported size points the way to the nearest supported size in edit layout (drag right, drag down, drag right and down, make smaller)
a crosstalk message the receiver read through its inbox, or whose queued frame was lost with its claude, no longer stays held on a native receipt forever

a folded project, status or area header in the interactive todo now shows what is waiting on you inside it: questions, unread looks and unread infos, each with the same icon and color as the rows and a count (hidden again when the header is open)

a huddle item can be scheduled: set a date and time on it (or have claude set one) and when it comes due carnivore tells the item's session about it, waking or starting the project's session first; the row shows the time with a clock, and you can change or cancel it
a huddle item you want but not today can go on the back burner from its move menu: it sits in its own folded section above done, counts in no number, and claude leaves it alone unless you ask
a pack agent's chat keeps the line saying its question went to the owner after the owner has answered it

a pack agent's craft export no longer carries the project in its file names: the zip, the agent definition, its memory folder and the download all use one neutral name, and the browser saves the file under the name the server sent
a session row's menu now has a keep awake toggle (coffee cup) that shows whether that session is kept awake and flips it, even with the row's inline cup hidden
a skill card and its open pane now show the skill's hero image when the signed catalog has one, falling back to the letter or icon tile when it does not
added the Pack brief renderer (seven charter sections, vouched order origin, secret refusal); nothing calls it yet

changes.details: The page draws the same active floor as the drawer panel; an agent that is asleep now joins its own asleep session record on the sessions row, so it shows once.
changes.summary: added the Pack page: your floor as a ledger, an org chart or squares, with settings for the default view, density and character set
added the plugin widget seam and the first plugin widget, the Pack agent chat (huddle.chat); not shown anywhere until the agent page lands
adding an asleep agent to a layout from the add to layout menu now wakes it, resumed into its own conversation, since layouts are on demand; loading or syncing a layout never wakes anything
ai connections now accept keys with a colon in them, so a fal.ai key (id:secret) can be saved

changes.details: The agent chat drawer's menu has pop out (its own window, chat and Tasks Viewer tabs) and make widget (adds that agent's chat to the current layout). Dragging the drawer's title row onto the layout drops it as a widget.
changes.summary: an agent's chat can be popped out into its own window or made a widget

changes.details: Clicking an agent in the pack panel slides a resizable drawer out from the right edge (default width: the left drawer's) instead of opening the agent page. The Tasks Viewer tab reuses the huddle lists view for that agent. The shift-queue and the queue (x) pop-up are gone; a tell to a busy agent is still held and shown.
changes.summary: an agent's chat opens as a right drawer from the pack panel, with a chat tab and a Tasks Viewer tab, and replies send at once with no send queue

an agent's trust card (and the other pack decision cards) now has its own buttons, trust and not now, instead of a reply box, and the agent chat's reply box no longer shows the tell claude session picker

an install whose databases were upgraded by a build that numbered its migrations differently now upgrades cleanly: missing tables and columns are added in the same upgrade, the huddle file is brought to the exact shape a new one has, and no item, claim, schedule or project color is lost

an interactive todo item now reads working only while the claude session that took it is still in its turn; when that session finishes, goes idle, closes or dies the item goes back to open, and old stuck working marks were cleared

an open claude question now shows in full on its huddle row with the reply box directly under it, and wins over a newer info; questions, infos and looks each have their own color (yellow, violet, cyan) on the blocks, counts and folded header marks
author hero images now reach the catalog publish step, the admin sees them as a picture, erased handles stay retired, and the upload needs a registered account
authors can upload or replace the hero image of their own skill, theme or plugin from my submissions; every image is re-encoded to 1536x1024 before it enters the catalog
catalog detail drawer: name, rating and facts sit over a darkened hero, drawer defaults to 400px and resizes by drag or arrow keys, remembered per device
catalog images no longer fail or show broken when two requests ask for the same picture at once: one fetch is shared and a picture is only served once it checks out
claude's huddle posts now draw formatting: bold, italic, code, lists, small headings, links, data tables and key: value blocks, and the MCP tools tell claude which forms to use
claude's huddle tools now treat the text "false" and "0" like false for include_thread, lean and the other on/off options, so a session with an old tool list no longer pulls every thread by mistake
companies: group projects under named companies (create, rename, delete, file a project or orphan it) through the api and the mcp server; every project now reports its company
companies: upload, serve and remove a hero image for any company or project through the api; companies and projects report has_image and image_rev, and deleting one removes its picture

changes.details: The home directory symlink scan is cached on the directory mtime with a 60 s backstop, and table column lookups are cached per database file and schema_version. Issue 1180.
changes.summary: cut idle server cpu: cache the home alias scan and table column lookups
dragging an asleep agent from the drawer into a tab strip or the terminal grid now adds its tab and wakes it, resumed into its own conversation, since tabs are on demand

every company and project without a picture now gets generated ANSI / ACiD BBS art with its name as a logotype and a motif drawn from what it does; an upload always wins, remove image falls back to the art, and a new regenerate art item in the image menu makes a fresh one

every project now has a color you pick in its edit screen (a row of swatches), new projects get a random one and existing ones are filled in; the interactive todo shows each project's title a bit larger in its own color, and the project list and the projects tool for agents carry the color

fixed Pack cards: any owner decision now closes the card, a new trust or dialog card replaces the older one, dialog card text drops the border lines, and an unknown launch profile is refused up front so a retry with a good one wakes the agent
fixed a huddle schedule losing its set time when a repeat is added without a new time: the pending fire time is kept as the first fire and the repeat applies after it

fixed clicking the layout you were already on, or one of its sessions, doing nothing while a menu page such as settings was open: the page now closes and the workspace shows, with no reload or reconnect
fixed the drawer's interactive todo tab that could not be selected once the pack panel was the default view: reading a session's listing row no longer writes state while the panel draws
fixed the questions tab dropping a multi-question ask after you answered one part on a narrow pane (phone): the wrapped step strip is now read, so the next question shows up
fixed the shift-held wake icon on asleep agents in the drawer: it is now the same sun as the wake agent menu item, in yellow, instead of an orange starburst

generated hero pictures are redone with no text: a project now gets a cinematic NSA-style project visual and a company a sleek logo mark, both drawn as a compact centred subject in a wide scene so every banner, card and thumbnail crop shows it, and the project and company page banner is no longer a thin 12:1 slice

generated project and company pictures now each show something about that project: the theme is distilled from the readme, CLAUDE.md, description or session titles, or from the name alone, the fixed vault default is gone, and two rows that land on the same theme are redone so no two pictures match

guest accounts hardening: the rate and comment install requirement sits behind its own switch (off for now), a computer whose guest was deleted gets a fresh one, and a guest unused for 13 months is deleted

holding shift over an info or look post on a huddle row shows a semi-transparent close layer over it, and a folded post now opens with a click anywhere on its top line with a visible chevron and hover; shift-click still dismisses

hosted catalog: guest accounts for computers that are not signed in (install reports and ratings only), a fold into the real account on sign-in, rating and commenting need an install record, and install records are kept for the life of the account

huddle polish: the review card is a colored bubble with its click path on its own line, rows lose the second line under the title, pointer and clear cursors, the empty list keeps the bottom bar down, the open item reads as bubbles with the description as its lead, and a reply reads every unread claude message
huddle: a long post opens and closes with a click anywhere on it (pointer cursor, links and text selection excepted), and Shift shows a remove cursor over a post it would dismiss
huddle: a question from claude can carry its background apart from a numbered list of short questions, so you answer by number; the reply box hints it, and older plain questions look the same

huddle: a row reads in time order (questions, infos, looks and your replies), shift-click anywhere on an info or look reads it like its icon, long questions fold, and a reply reads every unread claude post
huddle: every footer key is one family (24px, 16px icon, label when wide), remove gets its icon, hide completed wears an eye with a check, and tell claude and queue use the confirm outline

huddle: queued tells are tidier (title, a pending tag, remove) and each shows an agent dropdown, and the add box has an agent select defaulted to the list's current agent; the agent is a per-list pick that every window follows
huddle: replying to a question now reads the question and the infos and looks posted before it, and ticking an item off reads everything on it
huddle: shift-click on an info, look or held-tell strip reads and hides it; posts on the row are roomier; long posts fold to a one-line lead with a chevron that opens them inline

huddle: tell, reply, add and a tick now send right away, and holding shift queues the change instead; the count moved out of the tell button into a small queue (x) link whose pop-up lists what is queued and lets you remove one entry or clear all (it drops only the tell, the change stays saved)
huddle: the show empty groups key moved next to new group on the left of the footer, the footer icons are larger and centered, and a wide huddle shows a short label beside each key
in the compact huddle list a question waiting on you now shows its text under the title, and a question already waiting when the huddle loads opens the row once your compact setting arrives

in the interactive todo the project, status and area headers now each look different at a glance: the project is largest with a bar in its own color, a status is a small capitals strip with its icon, an area is a plain-case name with a side bar

installs, loadout members and updates are always reported to the catalog under your account, or a guest account made for this computer when you are not signed in; items installed before this update are reported once so they can be rated; the install report switch is gone
internal: the Alpha guard matches Alpha by its session row, agents cannot edit Pack owner cards, and the plugin messenger checks a delivery id instead of a flag

menu pages are real pages now: no close button, every page and every settings section has its own link, back and forward move between them, and clicking an agent or session in the sidebar just takes you there
pack agents get a body: wake, sleep, one live body per agent, a delivery queue that holds messages while a body starts, push topics for the roster, and an auto-sleep rule for idle agents

pack alerts reach you by default: a new web push destination is ticked for the immediate alert push and a new text destination for the flash text; quiet hours still hold both, and your own choices always win
pack: Alpha, the chief agent, is created asleep at the first boot with the Pack on, in its own local git folder under the projects folder
pack: a company's HQ folder and Alpha's folder are no longer drawn as empty project seats, because their agent already sits there
pack: a folder takes one agent, so turning on a project agent on a company's HQ folder or on Alpha's folder is refused, and a project agent's chat line no longer reads as its parent spawning it
pack: a plugin widget such as the agent chat opens alone in the pop-out window while its plugin is on, with no open terminal button
pack: a task type accepted enough times becomes a feature agent with a seed digest, a receipt card and a flip-back; the next task of that type goes to it
pack: a wake that arrives while a memory rewind is running now waits for the rewind commit instead of starting on a half-restored folder
pack: agents can delete a pack item over mcp with the new huddle_delete tool or a delete op in huddle_batch, the same soft delete as the delete button

pack: agents can remember facts (pack_remember) with provenance, an FTS5 memory index that answers whether a tier covers a question, held conflict cards for facts that clash with the owner's, and the S3 tables at schema v63

pack: an agent answers the owner in its chat with pack_say, child crosstalk is no longer held behind a dialog, and held-message, external-import and other stuck dialogs in an agent's pane become cards
pack: an agent's chat menu has turn off, which puts the agent to sleep (its memory is committed), closes its open cards and takes it off the floor; its files stay and turning it on again reuses them
pack: an agent's conversation stream merges crosstalk traffic and Pack events, survives wakes, pushes on send and delivery, and every wake restates the reporting duty

pack: an owner message to an agent can be stored as that agent's owner fact (its exact words, vouched by the message row), a question card closes when the owner answers it, a flipped-back promotion receipt reads flipped back instead of kept, and pack.json records the parent

pack: approving a company or project suggestion hands the new agent the owner's exact words and tells the suggesting agent, a project agent made from a company's suggestion is parented to the company agent, the HQ and projects that already have an agent cannot be suggested, a dialog card is posted once, project agents are told to delegate and task agents to keep work small, and a Beast Mode failure logs its reason (#1354)
pack: company agents with their own HQ repo, company account pointers, and pack_suggest cards the owner approves before any company or project is created

pack: crosstalk repin moves contacts, queued, held and delivered messages and watches onto a woken agent's new pane; agent:<id> handle and exact session_uuid directory tier; replies address the sender key
pack: pack_spawn lets a project agent start a feature or task agent (owner approved, with the caps, the contact and the first task), and the pack_reports table at schema v62

pack: questions climb the agent chain through stored memory with server-built receipts, an open question is joined instead of asked twice, the owner's answer reaches every asker, and killing a fact reopens the questions it answered
pack: render and parse agent definition files, the codex twin, pack.json and memory folder files, with a secret scan before every write
pack: rewind a feature agent's memory folder to an earlier checkpoint in a new commit, resume an earlier conversation, the agent menu's rewind picker and the promotion receipt card

pack: the Alpha guard hardening. An owner turn opens only on an idle body, a paste that may have landed keeps its row, a paired computer's keys and the skill one-shot and scout routes record as agent data, and peer-origin text in Alpha's transcript lowers an owner turn

pack: the Alpha guard. Every text delivered into Alpha's body records who authorised it first, and while Alpha works on agent data every write tool it calls is refused on the server, Beast Mode or not
pack: the Pack API routes, MCP read tools and the agent conversation read (S1i)
pack: the Pack ships on for a clean install; an existing install keeps the choice it has, set once at boot
pack: the agent menu's export downloads a zip of an agent's craft only (definition without the order, goal and repo details, craft facts, the Codex twin, a README), secret-scanned
pack: the craft-only export names a removed home word in plain words (your-project, your-repo) instead of an angle-bracket placeholder
pack: the ctx.pack plugin capability, the thread port, agent:<id> huddle lists and huddle.db rung 14 (author and creator keys)
pack: the first owner order that wakes Alpha opens an owner turn, and the guard finds its caller's row through the request's own session listing

pack: the first project-agent turn-on works without a restart, an approved naming family reaches the live agent and renames its row, new agents default to medium effort, children stop sending a duplicate crosstalk report, and decided cards leave the send queue
pack: the huddle drawer tab opens on the Pack panel, every agent as a square grouped by rank at three densities, with a pack and lists switch
pack: the huddle tab lists the Pack's agents as rows that open each agent's own chat page, a project's menu offers turn on agent, and a plugin widget's menu offers pop out

pack: the learning inbox (sealed answers, discoveries pushed up, skip-level words) rides each tier's wake, a tier with ten items or a day-old one is woken for them, and the chat shows a receipt row on an answer plus the question and withdrawn cards

pack: the memory commit an agent makes when it goes to sleep (only its own paths, secret scanned, first commit in a public or unverifiable repo waits for approval) and the repo origin visibility check; nothing calls them yet
pack: the one launch helper adds --agent, --effort and the upper-rank lockdown flags to every body start (create, wake, restart, recreate)

pack: the squares go back to the approved mockup's motion, shapes and colors, keeping only the owner's own changes (question looks up, the gravestone keeps its eyes, asleep is flatter but readable, one comet flown twice, the spike rings turn cleanly) (S6a3)
pack: the squares turn into a question mark and a gravestone, the alert spikes rotate, one-shot beats play twice, and a corner badge or glow tells question, notice, waiting and unread (S6a2)
pack: turning on a project's agent (git init card, naming family review card), the agent's desk of open work, pack_report and pack_accept_report with task-agent teardown
pack: upper-rank agents launch on a seeded pack-upper profile with the ask posture, and a wake under any other posture is refused with a card
pack: upper-rank agents launch with setting-sources project,local and strict-mcp-config, and refuse to wake when the repo's own settings pre-approve writes or other MCP servers
pack: when a launch carries two --name flags the last one is kept, the one claude used before the duplicate was removed
project colors on the projects page list view too: each project row shows the color dot and its menu has the color item, so projects with no company (listed as rows by default) show their color
project colors on the projects page: each project card shows a small dot in the project's color, and the card's menu has a color item that opens the swatch row and saves it live

projects page: #projects is now a companies level (a card per company A-Z, orphaned projects last, new company button), a company opens its own projects, old project links are rewritten to the company path, and the company and project menus rename, delete, file and unfile

scheduled todos can repeat: every day at a time, on picked weekdays, every n hours or monthly, in new york time and daylight-saving safe; the row shows the repeat and the next time, and a repeat can be paused, edited or stopped. the schedule control now appears only on a scheduled item and is opened from the item menu's schedule row

settings > account now shows your carnivore account right there (who you are, news email, signed in devices, your data, reply emails, sign out) instead of a link to another page; signed out it shows the sign-in button
settings mcp server no longer prints the tool list inline; a link opens the documentation's new mcp section, which lists every tool from the server

changes.details: Launch ledger, prompt mark and the three completion indexes persist in reader_state.db (#1180, fix 3, slice S2).
changes.summary: sub-agent transcript readers resume from stored state after a server restart

tell claude can reach a claude session as a claude code channel event instead of typed text: a prototype behind the mcp.channels setting (off by default), with the paste as the fallback and delivered_via in every answer

the Pack characters and the theme character packs: a square with face B whose body shows its state, the spike alert ladder, and an optional characters block in theme.json (gameboy ships pixel squares); shown in the style guide only, the panel comes next

the agent chat now shows agent-to-agent messages with their delivery receipt and every Pack event as quiet cards; blank gaps are gone, a decided card shows its decision with no buttons, the reply box names the agent and the page is titled with the agent's name

the agents tab groups projects under company headings (a to z, foldable, synced across devices) in place of the projects heading, with an orphaned projects heading last; a company's menu renames or deletes it, and a project's menu files it under a company or takes it out

the agents tab now closes an open menu page such as settings and shows the selected layout again, and opening an item on the plugins, skills or companies pages no longer throws you back to the terminal
the default folder for new projects is now ~/carnivore-projects instead of ~/cloude-projects; existing projects and folders stay where they are

the drawer search box has a mode dropdown: names, transcripts (the live scrollback grep), prompts (only what you typed, a new search) and database (the deep search plugin's row); the choice is remembered per device
the huddle drawer tab now shows an agent's own thread by the agent's name, opens it from a pop-out link, offers it as a move target and never offers to start a new session for it

the huddle list keeps project headers pinned (stacked at the top and the bottom), pins section headers under them, indents items one step and draws the project color down the left of every header and row
the huddle now shows empty groups, with an empty line and a remove key, in both views (a new group no longer vanishes), and the word area reads group everywhere

the huddle's bottom bar has a show empty groups key (a folder with an eye): off by default it hides groups with nothing in them in both views, on shows them; remembered as a huddle setting on every device

the install report switch and panel are gone; the install sheet and catalog footer say what an install sends and to which account; rating and commenting are disabled with 'install this to rate or comment' until you installed the item; the account page has a guest account section (export, delete, sign in to keep it everywhere)

the interactive todo is now called the pack everywhere you read it: the tab, the menu, the settings page, the toasts and the line claude gets pasted; its settings page also opens at #pack-settings, and the old #interactive-todo link still works

the interactive todo menu row now opens its own settings page with a show tab switch: on keeps the interactive todo tab in the strip with no close key, off hides it, and the choice is saved on the server and followed live by every browser

the interactive todo pop-out now opens a new window every time, so you can have several at once, each on its own project (or all projects); each window keeps its own list through a reload and never moves another window or the sidebar

the pack panel shows the whole live floor: every session the agents tab lists, with its companies and projects, active ones by default and the rest behind a small show inactive link; a company or project with no agent is a vacant seat that asks before turning one on
the pack roster now says which alert rung each agent is on and what it is doing, pack agents can raise an immediate alert or a limited flash, and an agent's color can be set
the pack: database schema v59 (agents, wakes, deliveries, repo visibility) and its store, with one live body per agent enforced by the database; nothing user-visible yet
the plugins page shows a grant button beside a plugin that is on but waiting for a permission grant, so it no longer takes switching it off and on

the projects page is now a real page: a description, every company as a card with a hero banner, then the orphaned projects as a ledger with square thumbnails, each section with its own grid and ledger toggle; a company page shows its hero and only its projects; companies and projects get a generated hero from their name, replaceable with set image and remove image on the kebab

the projects page reads right in singular and plural (1 project, 2 companies), and the search, state and hidden filters now narrow the companies too: a company stays when its name or one of its projects matches, and an empty section says no match

the restart dialog has an account dropdown for claude sessions, listing only accounts that can resume the conversation, and an "always restart this session on this account" box that keeps the choice for every later restart and recreate of that session
the search mode select now sits at the right end of the search field (mode icon, mode word, arrow) like a standard select, and its open menu is wider with a short muted note after each mode

the skill and plugin detail pane opens on a banner hero with a large name, a double-size rating and the id, source, developer and version block on the right; the brief follows in larger text and the digest, size, files and executable-files line close the pane
timer index and crosstalk native mirror cursors survive a server restart (reader_state.db)
transcript token totals cache survives a server restart (reader_state.db, #1180 fix 3 slice 1)
waking an agent now brings it to you: its tab in the layout on screen is activated and its terminal takes the keyboard, and an agent in no layout opens the way clicking its row does

Pack leaders (Alpha, company agents, project agents) now sit in fixed slots in the agents tab with a rank insignia, can be renamed, and need their exact name typed (enforced by the server) before they are closed, deleted, killed or turned off

Pack leaders that were asleep, never woken or had no session row now show in the Agents tab: Alpha on top, a company agent and a project agent first under their headings, each with its own wake, rename and turn off (typed name) menu

Pack project, company and Alpha squares now wear the same rolled-up status the Agents tab heading shows (a project with a working session paints working, a company rolls up its projects, Alpha rolls up everything); a vacant seat takes the state's hue on its dashed outline
Renaming a Pack leader (Alpha, a company agent or a project agent) from the Pack route now updates its row in the Agents tab right away, with no reload
a mouse click on the org chart's show inactive toggle now works; pressing on a button or the footer no longer starts a pan that swallowed the click

a personal huddle add-on skill declares extends: huddle and guide_rev in its front matter; the skills page flags one written for an older huddle rules revision (with the changes since), and huddle MCP answers carry stale_extensions so a session checks the add-on and raises its guide_rev; huddle guide rev 3

a project agent whose repo settings pre-approve known read-only tools (filesystem reads, context7 docs, brave search) now wakes instead of refusing with unsafe launch posture; writes, wildcards and unknown servers still refuse

a sleeping session's square in the pack panel's agents section now wakes and opens on a click instead of doing nothing, and the pack panel no longer shows a horizontal scrollbar that came and went as ribbons orbiting the last column swept past its edge
a third huddle view, claude's view: one group per claude flag (color swatch and reason), then everything else, in the status view's row order; the choice is stored with the other two views

a widget at a size it was not tested for now shows a chevron on each edge that has to move, pointing the way, with resize to fit in the middle, in normal mode as well as edit layout; an edge whose side already fits shows no chevron; fixes the hint flipping from drag right to drag left before the size was reached

a working item's row shows each worker's live state (queued, running, testing, installing, blocked, done) as a small strip under its title, set by the new huddle_progress tool or a batch op, dimmed when stale for 30 minutes; the answer text for a form now lists one line per question again
agent terminal and a shift-click on a pack square now open an asleep agent's terminal: the agent is woken first, whatever the wake-on-click setting, and its terminal opens once it is up

agents can now find a sleeping agent by name and wake it to ask a question: agents_lookup lists asleep sessions, and crosstalk_send to one wakes it (after the owner's approval) and delivers, resuming its conversation
an agent whose pane died and was later revived in the same tmux session returns to running, so putting it to sleep no longer refuses with 'this session is not running'
an answer post on a huddle row and in the thread now wears its own color, the accent orange, apart from info violet, look cyan, question yellow and review green, so one is not mistaken for an info

an install or restart gets the server back about 2 to 3 seconds sooner: the install copies the new app before stopping the old one, polls every fifth of a second, and a restart keeps the server's compiled modules instead of rebuilding them

bookmark a point in a claude code session (bookmark now, or pick a past turn), then branch from there into a new session or rewind the session in place behind the arm box; claude can add bookmarks over mcp

carnivore keeps its own first-party skills installed: the huddle skill installs itself from the signed catalog with auto-update on once it is published, stays removed if you remove it (with an offer to bring it back), and shows pending in catalog until then; huddle answers now carry a guide revision so an agent knows when to re-read the skill

claude can flag a huddle item with a fixed color (purple, pink, teal, lime; status colors are refused) and a short reason: the row stripe wears the flag, a legend above the list shows only the colors in use with their reasons, and the flag clears when the item is approved or deleted
cplug boundary fix and stale huddle enablement expectations corrected so the red tests go green

changes.details: The mirror cursor always advances and stores a reference (byte offset and length) per undelivered event, rebuilt from the file on restart, instead of being forgotten while a backlog exists. Issue 1180.
changes.summary: crosstalk mirror keeps its restart cursor with undelivered events carried as line references
drawer search icon and input padding use the spacing tokens; the huddle queue item name no longer carries a tooltip; the phone drawer test checks the search mode select's enlarged tap target

fixed the account usage glance bars: they now use the same green, blue, yellow, orange and red ladder as the ledger windows, so a 95 percent account reads red and 89 percent reads orange instead of staying green or yellow
huddle posts: a numbered list keeps counting 1, 2, 3 when items have a blank line between them, and a list written to start at 7 starts at 7

huddle schedule editor: add a scheduled item by hand with a title, instructions, first time and repeat from the scheduled header's + schedule, change an item's time, repeat and instructions in the same popup, and run now fires it immediately through the schedule's own delivery (route and huddle_update fire_now)

huddle: a question written into an item's own text shows as a question (bubble, pending marker, reply box) until answered, huddle_add with kind question files a real question post, and answering clears the row so it shows only his reply and the posts newer than it

huddle: claude can ask typed questions (yes or no, pick one, pick many, rank, short and long text) with recommendations and reasons; you answer in one form opened from a one-line bubble, take recommendations in one press, and submit tells claude at once; a reply on a typed ask is a comment that counts in the tell number and does not answer it

huddle: claude can reply with an answer post that quotes your question in one box and behaves like an info; a typed ask on the row is a lead line plus N questions, answer instead of a wall of text, with the form inline in the thread; every answer form ends with an optional anything else box that comes back as _extra; and your submitted answers are never unread

huddle: fork an item, in the item menu and as the huddle_fork tool and batch op: a new item beside the original, with the fork's own state and, if you like, the original's, set in one step; the fork's row says which item it came from
huddle: paste or drop files and pictures on a reply; they upload at once, show as chips and thumbnails, may be sent with no text, and claude reads them from absolute paths in its thread

huddle: the review block leads with an action tag (check and tick, check and tick to push, answer, read only, no action needed), the description renders markdown, the click path is now a short location, and every needs-you row shows its action; a look counts as needs-you only when it carries an action
huddle: working stays working across idle, restarts and dead sessions, and ends only at Claude's question or look, done, waiting to install, open, back burner, or the owner's tick or delete

pack characters make random faces with their eyes: 50 expressions (happy, smug, skeptical, shocked, furious, wink, love-struck, dizzy and more) play one at a time on a random resting character every 2 to 3 minutes, then the eyes return to normal; none in reduced motion, pixel versions on gameboy, and the style guide has a picker and a contact sheet

pack characters: back to the approved mockup's shapes and motion; faster, wider, contrast-colored ribbons, a grey gravestone for dead, a ? for question, ! !! !!! spiky glyphs for the alert rungs, no corner badges, an even contrast glow behind unread

pack chat fixes (#1353): cards and agent posts are hairline regions instead of outlined boxes, agent text renders as markdown without raw html, a card closed by a turn-off reads closed instead of approved, the send button stays quiet until there is text, the agent menu rows are split by hairlines, the chat title strip no longer scrolls out of view and the agent name shows once, the drawer row follows the header after a menu action

pack chat fixes (#1353): underscores inside words (pack_ask, test_hello.py) stay literal in agent text and notes, confirm buttons are an accent outline so they differ from the destructive fill in every theme, a turned-off agent's header says turned off, and the chat strip on an agent page no longer paints a lighter band

pack drawer panel and org chart fixes (#1353): the pack / lists switch, density keys and a quiet pack page icon key share the PACK title row, names use the full cell width on one line, a dashed plus slot closes companies and projects to turn on a vacant agent, Alpha shows its working-on line, every detailed row draws its provider mark, context bar and working-on line, and the org chart scales to fill its frame with the show inactive link inside it

pack look fixes: thin context bars read as a quiet track on light themes, the unread glow is an even halo, the turn-on buttons are small and the confirm is an outline apart from the destructive one, a waiting question in the agent chat is a hairline region, and the style guide lists the chat title row's titled variant

pack page fixes (#1353): ledger columns start at one x at every depth with a header row, the org chart sizes nodes from their names and links end at the node edges, the squares tab shows names and an ALPHA label in fixed cells, the inactive link no longer sits in a different-ground strip, the drawer's detailed rows keep room for the alert spikes, settings selects share one width
pack panel names wrap to a second line instead of cutting off, the agent chat menu gains an agent terminal item, and a shift-click on a pack square opens that agent's terminal
pack turn-on buttons are sized by a shared small modifier on the modal button family instead of unlayered component rules, so the layer ratchet is green again and the buttons look the same
pack turn-on buttons use the existing small oc-btn family instead of a new modal button class, so the new-button-family guard and the layer ratchet are both green

pack: Alpha's guard no longer opens an owner turn over a body that is already working, scans the transcript for peer frames from the moment the body was last idle, matches Alpha by its tmux name with no listing pass per write, fences agent-written desk and resume text under one data heading, tells the owner to resend an order that ran read only after a restart, and an export masks spaced and home paths, repo URLs, spelling variants and persona names (fix #1354, #1355)
pack: a body whose pane died (a folder-trust prompt answered no, exit) is noticed, its wake ends, its agent sleeps and its cards close, so sleep and turn-off no longer answer 409 (fix #1348)
pack: a folder-trust prompt answered anywhere closes its card at once, and an agent's first message survives a long wait at the prompt and a server restart, delivered exactly once (fix #1348)
pack: core no longer imports the huddle plugin; the thread port raises the SDK PackError for a refused card (fix #1364)

pack: every agent body launches with --no-chrome (feature and task agents keep a browser only when their profile names --chrome) and the Claude in Chrome startup prompt becomes one card with allow and deny buttons in the agent's thread (fix #1348)

pack: the Alpha guard's resend card survives a failed post and retries, Alpha is guarded on her first wake before her row is bound, the company agent's desk quotes agent text and one shared sanitizer keeps a newline in a project name from forging a desk line, and the craft export masks folder names with spaces and any git host's repo URL (fixes #1354, #1355)

pack: the immediate and flash alert characters are now a literal copy of the approved mockup, spiky squares with open eyes, a burst shake for immediate and the stepped jitter for flash, with no exclamation-mark morph

pack: the startup-prompt card quotes the prompt heading once and names both options in the prompt's own words, and an alpha, company or project agent's Chrome prompt card offers only the no option while the server refuses the yes (fix #1348)

red suite fixes (#1366): an owner approve or a wake settle ticks a card as approved again (only a turn-off, newer card or dead body marks it closed), the style guide uses a declared text token, and the pack web test files and chat entries specimen type-check

restart dialog: the account dropdown preselects the saved account, else the ACTIVE account (it used to preselect the account the pane last ran on, so an unpinned restart looked like it would return to the old account); (current) stays a label

changes.details: The agent chat drawer now slides out from under the Pack drawer toward the right, anchored at its right edge over the main area, and slides back under it on close. Make widget adds the chat as a cell in a row of its own in the current layout instead of a full-height column beside the last row.
changes.summary: the agent chat drawer slides out from under the Pack drawer, and make widget adds a normal grid cell

changes.details: The agent chat widget now has the same chat and Tasks Viewer tabs as the agent chat drawer, drawn by the same frame, so a chat made into a widget can still reach the Tasks Viewer.
changes.summary: the agent chat widget offers the chat and Tasks Viewer switch like the drawer
the database search suggests words as you type: the index's own terms for the word at the end of the box, most common first, taken with the arrows and Enter

the huddle MCP tools read lean: huddle_list answers summary rows without threads or approved items by default (fields, include_approved, item, limit and cursor opt in), huddle_changes thins any item the session already holds and leaves out its own posts, form questions and answers no longer send their text twice, crosstalk_inbox reads newest first with a limit of 20, every MCP result size is logged, and the huddle tool descriptions are cut to 400 characters

the huddle list now opens with a needs you section holding every item with an unanswered question, an unread look or a review waiting for your tick; an item leaves it when you answer, read the look, tick or delete, and the tab badge counts it
