the huddle rules now ship inside the app: claude reads them from the huddle_guide tool (no skill needed), and carnivore keeps a safe global copy of the huddle skill that it never overwrites if you edit it and never brings back after you remove it
the immediate and flash alert squares morph into the ! and !! glyphs again instead of crossfading into them

the loud Pack alert characters (priority, immediate, flash) are the normal square with eyes most of the time and periodically morph into the spiky ! / !! / !!! and back, the way the question square morphs into its ?; reduced motion keeps the static glyph
the loud Pack alert characters are the spiky square with eyes that morphs into a plain ! / !! / !!! (no spikes, no eyes) and back; the !! and !!! jitter nonstop through the whole cycle

the mcp server instructions shrink from 29,000 to under 1,800 characters with the channel rule first, so claude code no longer cuts it; every non-huddle tool description is capped at 400 characters; a session id that no longer matches the tool list answers 404 so the client re-lists tools, and the server declares tools.listChanged

the pack alert characters wear the approved mockup's own spiky square again: priority is the spiky square with no glyph, immediate loops into a plain ! and flash into a plain !!, the !!! is gone, and the shake and jitter never stop on immediate and flash

the resize chevrons now always lead to a size the widget declares and can reach, stay on until the widget is at that size (in edit layout over a working widget too), and an axis's chevrons hide only when that axis matches; fixes chevrons vanishing at the floor and inward chevrons pointing at a size that does not exist or a row cannot reach

the server now listens on its port before it starts up, so a claude reconnecting during an app restart or install waits for the server instead of being refused; boots that run the database backup (about 16 s) no longer use up claude's five reconnect tries and leave the pane needing /mcp, and a second copy of the app stops before it starts anything
the widget pop-out size test expects the window cap, not the stale 768
An approved crosstalk pair stays approved when either agent sleeps and wakes: sending to an asleep agent you already approved wakes it and delivers with no new approval request
Clicking a project agent in the Swarm panel shows only that project's agents below it, clicking a company shows only its projects and their agents, and clicking SysOp shows everything again
Hiding or closing an agent's chat window puts the Swarm panel back to showing everything; clicking a node again still narrows it

On the Swarm page's nodes and org chart tabs a click on a node opens that session's terminal, and a shift+click toggles a filter to that node's lineage, its parents up to SysOp and everything under it

Shift-clicking a Pack agent opens its terminal every time, not only the first: after its terminal tab was closed the next shift-click did nothing, and a leader's row in the Agents tab with no session now opens its terminal on shift-click too

SysOp, company and project agents now launch with permission prompts off, so they stop asking you before each tool; a row in the swarm settings tab turns the prompts back on, and each agent picks the choice up at its next wake

The Swarm page's ledger, org chart and nodes views follow the same node filter as the drawer panel, and the org chart stacks each parent's leaf agents in a column so a big swarm grows down instead of off the side of the screen
The Swarm page's org chart keeps every name inside its frame: a chart that fits the frame is centred instead of pinned past the right edge, and a parent's own name is counted in the chart's width
The iPhone app pairs with a computer that advertises a custom name: it asks you to confirm adding that computer, and a QR that is not a pairing code now says so
a board tab on the swarm page: every card in swimlanes per project, with list, timeline and calendar views behind the same switcher on their way

a card dealt to a sleeping agent now waits for a slot when the project or company grant is full or the machine is running hot, and is dealt on its own when a slot frees; SysOp and company agents set grants and pace, and you can read and set grants over the API

a card in Review can be validated by a fresh task agent or a validator agent definition that runs its how-to-validate steps and returns pass or fail with the proof; a fail sends the card back to In Progress marked validation failed, a pass can finish it, and the project's auto-validate switch does it on every card that reaches Review
a card's history is readable over the api: every step it took (created, started, finished, sent back, done and the rest) with when and who, oldest first
a changes rail beside the terminal pane lists the files changed since the last commit, collapsed to a count badge by default

a company or SysOp card can have child cards in several projects' queues, each dealt by its own project agent; the parent moves to Review when every child is done, and shows in every child's lane on the company and SysOp board

a layout-defect check sweeps every widget at every named size, three themes and sample, empty and stress data for overlapping, cut, escaping, tiny, low contrast and wrapping text; the widgets page previews are drawn by the desktop grid again, so a stat tile's sparkline no longer lands on its number, a one-tile stat label fits on one line, not measured reads as a quiet note in this machine, and save pipeline counts read compact so a big count stays in its own column

a project queue's new cards now reach the project agent as one deal request, held cards carry a lease that lapses to a hand-off or a stalled line, a stale handoff is asked for, and dealing lands off for every existing project until you turn it on

a question card is marked sent to your phone only when a notification destination really took the push, so an unticked type, quiet hours or paused routing no longer leave a card claiming a push that never went out
a repo:branch chip in the agent and shell foot bars with a dirty dot and ahead/behind
a session row's menu takes its keys from the same shared table as every other menu, so the same verb has the same letter everywhere and add to no longer sits on d

a spawned child's first message lists the top facts its parent chain already knows, with their f_ ids, next to its card; a failed or empty read gives the message with no facts and the spawn never waits on it

a swarm agent in a folder Carnivore made never flashes a trust card after the automatic yes, a made folder swapped for a link to your own repo asks you again, and a wake that fails to start no longer leaves its trust card open
a swarm agent's trust card now closes even when the server shuts down while a failed start is being cleaned up
a swarm body's own finished, attention and posted pushes stay in the app only while that exact tmux instance is the body, so a plain session that reuses a destroyed body's tmux name still pushes

a swarm card holder's lease heartbeat and a body's settle and dialog-card paths follow the exact tmux instance, so a plain session that reuses a destroyed body's tmux name can no longer keep a held card from lapsing

a swarm node whose session waits on a question or permission keeps the question mark until it is answered, so its project, company and sysop nodes read as asking too; the default swarm view now shows what the agents tab lists: a listed session counts as active, asleep included, and only a dead pane does not, so a company whose agents are all asleep stays in view

agent chat drawer: a press outside closes it on a phone too (touch and pen, not only a mouse), a swarm page ledger row or a chat crumb switches it in place instead of closing it, and focus goes back to what opened it only on escape or the close key; the message header stays one line at every drawer width, names shrinking with an ellipsis and the full name on hover; times past a day read in days (8d)

an agent can ask to delete a session through the carnivore mcp server; the request always waits for your approval on the huddle item it names, even with beast mode on, and an agent cannot delete its own session
an agent report longer than 2000 characters now posts instead of failing: its done card shows the text cut to fit with an ellipsis, and the whole report shows as the agent's own message in its thread

an agent's chat now shows the answer it wrote in its terminal, word for word and once, instead of a second reworded copy: when a turn you started ends, carnivore posts the agent's final text from its transcript, and a separate chat post the agent makes during that turn is held (#1417)

an agent's swarm question must now carry a one-sentence summary; the phone push and the lists row for a question show the asker, the summary and the task instead of the raw question; chat events like reported and answered show who actually did them; old question cards link the live company and project agent again; a long derived task is cut at a word with an ellipsis

archive a project from its three dot menu on the projects page and it leaves the list, set archived to show to see it, and restore project brings it back; the folder is never touched and a running session keeps running. agents can do the same through the project_archive and project_unarchive tools, each waiting for your approval

auto-done now checks the validation pass inside the Done write itself: if the card was sent back and re-finished, or validated again, between reading the pass and moving it, it stays in Review instead of reaching Done on a pass that no longer covers its work
auto-switch now moves to the account the providers panel stars: the most weekly quota left per hour until its weekly reset, not the least used account

beast mode can also answer session permission prompts with plain yes while you are away (never yes and don't ask again; questions, plans and folder trust still wait), switches itself off after 1, 4 or 8 hours if you pick one, and the questions tab gets an approve and deny button on every permission prompt

carnivore ships a widget-builder skill inside the app: it teaches a session how to build a dashboard widget end to end (named sizes, push data, fit check, style guide, catalog); it is offered on the skills page rather than installed for you, the install never overwrites your edits, and a removal is remembered
carnivore tui: a terminal client for sessions, approvals, ledger and catalog, with a ? help screen generated from its key table
changes rail and git diff styles use the spacing and type tokens and sit in the components layer
changes rail diff edge cases: truncation flag, unborn edits, safe file open, watch survives a bad tick
changes rail diff read refuses hardlinked files that may alias an outside file
claude can list, create, rename and delete the sidebar's session groups and move sessions into a group or out of all groups, through the same routes the drawer uses; open drawers update live
claude can list, pin and unpin sessions in the drawer through the same preferences route the drawer uses; pins stay the same on every device and open drawers update live

claude's approvals show in the huddle: each action waiting on your approval sits on the item it is for (or the list's claude's approvals item) in needs you, with approve and deny on the row; nothing expires, a waiting approval survives a restart, the safety checks run when you approve, and the asking session is told the result
clicking a file in the changes rail shows its read-only diff over the terminal body, and a second control opens the file

clicking an agent (a name in a chat message, an agent row, a square, a swarm page row or node) opens its chat with its terminal beside it on the right: at 1024 px and wider the chat docks and the terminal moves over instead of sitting under it, a press in that terminal keeps the chat open, and the swarm page steps aside; an asleep agent opens its chat alone and is not woken; shift+click on a swarm page node still filters to its lineage

delete project in a project's three dot menu on the projects page removes it for good after one red confirm: its project agent and every agent under it are turned off (each sleeps first so its memory is saved), the project leaves carnivore, and its company's agent is told it is gone; the folder on disk stays
every huddle message bubble (info, look, question, answer, owner message, approval card, review card) is now one extensible bubble class with one registry; a new bubble type is one registry entry

every menu has hotkeys by default: each item shows its key and a press runs it while the menu is focused, with the same letter for the same verb in every menu (r rename, d delete, v archive, y copy, n new)
git status route and push topic for a session's repository, read only while viewed

huddle markdown now renders on the list rows (title, latest line, description, questions) and in the answer popup (name, context, prompts, help, options, reasons), including bold italic with three stars; a cut-off line keeps its bold, italic and code styling up to the ellipsis and never shows raw stars
huddle tasks now carry a swarm card model: four board columns worked out from each task, a checked backup of the huddle database before the one-time update, and board and card reads
huddle: a read-only look no longer moves its item into needs you; it stays in its own section, still unread with its look icon, and needs you holds only answer, tick, push and approve
iPhone app design doc, decisions and catalog entry
install command line tool in the menu bar adds a carnivore shell command
install the carnivore command from settings, terminal, in every run mode
ios release tool: scripts/ios/testflight.sh archives, exports and uploads to testflight with the app store connect key, plus an unsigned dry run
iphone app registers for push, decrypts alerts in a notification extension and opens the tapped session
iphone app shows a named unreachable screen with retry, in the web app's theme colors
iphone app skeleton: a list of computers (relay link, local network or https address) opened in a web view locked to that computer's origin
iphone app: every native screen uses catalog strings and the theme the web app picked, and the app reports its real version

changes.details: each computer gets its own payload key and row id on the phone, taps open the computer that sent them, and removing a computer drops its key
changes.summary: iphone app: push keys and registration are now per computer, and only relay links can register

changes.details: The shell bridge now checks the port as well as scheme and host, push keys use the this-device-only keychain class, existing keys are migrated, and a restored phone registers its computers again.
changes.summary: iphone app: push keys stay on this phone and re-register after a restore
iphone app: the web app detects the native shell, hides web push there, and offers alerts on this phone
iphone pairing: cancel on the confirm prompt sticks, a code scanned under the type-the-address sheet is ignored, and a newline in a pairing host or secret is refused
iphone push relay hardening: bad device tokens keep their row, own payload key keychain service, revoke cleans ticks
local install refresh now fails when the running server is not on the merged code
mac and iphone builds now sign on the nyedis apple team
mac app release signing: Developer ID on the Psyance team, hardened runtime and notarization code path, ad hoc fallback
mcp read tool session_git_status over the git status route, plus docs/changes-rail.md

move a project's folder through POST /projects/{name}/move or the project_move mcp tool: a plan first, then the project, its child projects, sessions, search rows, claude transcript folders and the reboot journal re-point in place; refused while a session there is live
native app push device routes bound to the paired phone, payload key in the Keychain, revoke cascade
notification kind apns sends the typed alert copy, end-to-end encrypted under each iPhone's own key, through the relay push route

preview and try builds keep their log outside the packed app folder, refuse stale installed node_modules, and verify the built app.asar against its sources before anything is installed; the try tool can recover with the app down
read-only git diff route for one changed file of a session, capped, binary and secret-looking files named only
relay push route requires a signed-in account and its own gateway permission and throttle
relay-control gains POST /v1/push/apns, a device-signed, rate-limited route that relays one end-to-end encrypted push to an iPhone through APNs
release signing fixes: real key label lookup, nested entitlements, bounded unlock, ad hoc DMG never notarized
release signing hardening: clean signing environment, forced signing, bounded keychain unlock and notarization, key-only partition list, minimal entitlements
release signing keychain never auto-locks and is never listed outside a pass, with a one-time command to set it
release signing refuses ad hoc when a Psyance identity is invalid, import script verifies the backup and can re-run

changes.summary: release signing: the signing keychain joins the search list only while unlocked and leaves it before it is locked
route contract test reads client paths whose template holds a conditional query suffix
route-module test no longer trips on an imported FastAPI class in a sibling router module
routed and peer messages are now delivered to an agent that finished its turn but whose last turn the owner has not read yet, instead of being held until someone opens that session
session git reader: parses git status porcelain v2 into typed models for the changes rail and repo chip
settings, terminal: a carnivore tui block that explains the terminal client, shows a screenshot and installs the carnivore command
settings, terminal: the carnivore tui block shows the launch command in a copy box and where the command lives, or the full-path launch line when it is not installed
shift cmd enter zooms the focused terminal to fill the layout and shrinks it back, the same as shift clicking its magnifying glass; both zoom keys are on the keyboard shortcuts page

changes.details: importIdentityFromEnv feeds create-keychain, unlock-keychain, import and set-key-partition-list to security -i on stdin, refuses a password it cannot quote safely, and unlists the temporary keychain from the then-current search list before deleting it.
changes.summary: signing keychain import no longer puts passwords on a command line

swarm agents are taught the card loop in their briefs and on every wake, a project agent gets the rules for dealing its queue, a dealt card lists the top facts its chain already knows, and the huddle guide moves to revision 6

swarm agents get card tools (start, handoff, finish with how to validate, release, create, reorder, deal) and the owner gets routes for done, send back with a note, move, release, pause, resume, swap, pin and the project switches; a spawn gives its agent a card, reports are tied to cards, and a send-back note becomes a project fact

swarm agents in folders carnivore made (alpha, each company hq, projects you approved) are trusted automatically on every account, and a trust card now posts once per start instead of up to three times

swarm chat lines now carry categories with a mute preference and a shown view, a question no agent could answer pushes to your phone as its own notification type, and a swarm body's finished toasts stay in the app

swarm chat reads like a chat: one header per burst from the same sender with an arrow for received or sent, the sender's square and the time since, follow-ups tucked under it, quiet events folded into one expandable line, and question and review cards under their own header with a yellow edge

swarm chat reads plainly: every message starts with its author's path (company > project > agent) and the time since, each name opens that agent's chat; a question card shows the asker, the task, a one-sentence question and a full details toggle with the raw question, the other askers and the routing; the agent chat hides on a mouse press outside it

swarm colors are bright and vibrant: every company shade sits in a high chroma, bright lightness band on every theme, never olive, tan or gray, and sysop and agents with no company wear a reserved bright aqua no company comes near

swarm colors are grouped by company: each company wears its own far-apart hue family and every agent, project and session under it a distinct shade of it, sysop and agents with no company a neutral gray; a hand-set color still wins, and company_set_hue recolors a company

swarm colors spread evenly round the wheel: sysop, every company and every project take the middle of the largest gap left, so argent, cobalt, carnivore.ai and mail-sorter no longer look alike, neighbours alternate lightness, and a new project never moves an older color

swarm colors: every project, company and sysop wears its own bright hue, far from the others, and only a project's agents and sessions share its tone as distinct shades; a company's chosen hue colors only the company itself

swarm task agents never linger: a finished task agent its project agent has not closed out within 15 minutes is put to sleep, and a close-out card asks the project agent to accept the report (tear it down) or promote it and let it sleep
terminal client foundation: textual shell, own login and locked refresh pair (python3 -m src.tui)
terminal client: live events feed with polling only while the socket is down and a server-down banner
terminal client: read-only ledger screen (key 3) and catalog browser (key 4)
testflight upload names the app group click when provisioning fails on it
the Mac app can open Carnivore in its own window from the menu bar, with the dock icon shown only while it is open
the agent to agent message card no longer covers the message on the receiving session's terminal, where the text is already pasted; the sender's terminal still shows it
the bundled huddle skill reads its manifest name from the one kind table instead of a second hardcoded literal

the changes rail beside every terminal is gone; its list moved into the file browser as a 'changed files' tab, the tree tags changed files with a tinted name and a status letter (folders roll up with a dot), and a git status line at the bottom of the browser shows the repo, branch, counts and last commit
the changes rail never runs a repository's own commands, hides more credential files, and truncates a huge diff instead of failing
the changes rail now shows in the main terminal cell, and the shell bar keeps the branch at narrow widths
the changes rail shows dotfile names such as .env.local with the leading dot first
the developer id import script gives the new signing key its own label, so it no longer collides with the other team's key

the drawer's cozy rows are a meter (context used, model, effort and live work as counts) and its detailed rows a triage stack (state word, every active flag on its own line loudest first, what the agent is working on, live work and when it last worked); compact is unchanged
the iphone app now has an app icon and is iphone only, so testflight accepts the upload
the iphone app pairs through a computer's relay link address even when its custom name is live, so push works
the iphone app scans the pairing qr code (or takes a typed address) and opens the pairing page to finish pairing
the live-suite guard test no longer fails when an aged live test socket exists, a nested pytest session skips the socket sweep
the mac app moves from end-of-life electron 28 to electron 44 and electron-builder 26, built for apple silicon only, still signed ad hoc and still ai.carnivore.menubar (#161)
the mac app signing, app window and command line installer node tests live under tests/node so the flat file guard passes
the mcp session_delete tool also deletes an asleep session by session uuid or tmux name, through the drawer's remove-from-lists route, unpins it, and still always waits for the owner's approval
the menu bar app can update itself from a configured feed and offers restart to update

the pack is now called the swarm, its top agent SysOp, and the squares nodes, everywhere you read them: the page, the drawer tab, tooltips, settings, notifications and the text agents see; the providers page total now says all accounts total
the plugins card lists the deepsearch plugin again, its manifest now declares its search-mode surface

the post-build app.asar gate matches each packed dependency file to a source copy of the same package name and version, so electron-builder's hoisted production copies no longer read as corruption, while a changed dependency file still fails the build

the questions tab shows a long question whole, with its question tabs, even when a short pane scrolled its opening lines away; questions whose options carry a preview box parse again; and a session whose light says a question is open but whose dialog could not be read still gets a card that sends you to the session
the run from checkout command in settings, terminal pastes cleanly from any directory
the style guide registry now lists the terminal cell's split layout class

the swarm board's calendar view: a week grid (or today, or three days) counting what each project's cards did per day, created, started, to review, approved and sent back, with an hourly activity bar, the faces of agents on the day their card started, and the board key

the swarm board's list view: cards waiting on your review first under needs you, then in progress and todo with their trees, and a detail pane with the phase strip, the history and done or send back with a note
the swarm page org chart hangs sysop's own agents beside its trunk above the companies instead of in a far-left column, and the connector lines to every stacked agent draw again
the swarm page org chart wraps a row of companies or projects wider than the panel onto a new row below, so it grows down instead of sideways and no agent sits past the right edge at first paint
the swarm's mcp tools are now named swarm_* (swarm_spawn, swarm_say, swarm_report and the rest) instead of pack_*, with no old-name alias; running agents see the new names after /mcp or a restart

the tools that always wait for your approval (bookmark branch and rewind, pack rewind and color, project rename and company, board import, pipeline rebuild, plugin changes) are listed in one place that beast mode can never skip, and a test fails if a tool says it waits without being on it; a bookmark's preview now shows the prompt or peer message of the turn it marks
the tray update icon now follows the auto-updater, so it never disagrees with the update menu row

the usage floor counts only the Claude account a new agent runs on, so a parked account at its limit no longer holds back every deal; the capacity reading, the deal request and a refused spawn name the account and the window that tripped
tui approvals screen: pending list, a approves and d denies, live from the events feed
tui attach and session actions: enter attaches without resizing the pane, n s R A u call the web's routes
tui hardening: crash output hides secrets, a 401 anywhere returns to login, token file and lock checks, loopback-only request paths
tui login: no proxy, refresh keeps the pair on 429, 401 clear only drops its own pair
tui sessions screen: drawer-order rows, status light, filter, sort, screen keys, one key table
tui theme and chrome: palette from the active global theme, truecolor or 256, ascii frame, title strip, coral for destructive
tui: every 401 returns to login, lock-release test can fail, path check raises ValueError
turning on a project agent from a swarm square now shows why it was refused, and a folder that needs git init points at its one approve card instead of posting a new copy on every click

widget sizing pass: this machine fills its box with a detail line under each bar, scheduled tasks and running sessions give the name and status more room, the fleet rack summary stacks instead of cutting its labels, and analytics cards say to sign in rather than loading history forever when signed out

changes.details: The server looked for user themes in the old cloude-code-menubar folder; it now follows the app's current folder.
changes.summary: your own themes folder is found again after the carnivore rename

a card held by an agent that went quiet is taken back again: only a question asked since the agent took the card holds it, a sleeping agent's screen no longer counts as a sign of life, and the owner gets a line saying who went quiet on which card and that it is queued for the next deal

a mute button at the bottom right of every notification card: mute here silences that notification type on this device (a phone also stops its own push), mute everywhere silences it on every device and destination; an undo card confirms it and settings lists every mute with an unmute. the status lights never change.

a plugin can call the owner's AI only through named features it declares and the owner grants and routes: the host builds a chat or embed request with no tools, files or permission mode, masks secrets in the prompt, refuses providers that can run tools, and stops the plugin at its per-day call and token budget

a plugin can reach the network only through a host proxy: exact granted hosts over https, a separate tick for writes, private network entries that can never reach this computer or a paired peer, owner-entered secrets bound to their hosts and injected by the host so the plugin never holds them, and a per-plugin egress log

a project agent pulls its own project's work cards into the work with swarm_card_queue (the top todo card first, a lower one only with a reason kept in its history) or makes one queued, and a work card an agent made that never got queued is flagged stranded; the owner's own todo cards never move on their own

a swarm agent with a persona codename can no longer commit a message that names it: every launch points that agent's own git at a carnivore hooks folder that refuses the codename and then runs the repo's own hooks, with nothing written into the repo

a swarm question is now asked of every tier above the agent (project, company, sysop) even when none has a stored answer; when all pass it lands as a question in the thread you are actually using in that chain, and your answer reaches the asker carrying your real message id, which an agent relaying your words cannot attach

agent chat: an agent-to-agent message shows one summary line in a thin frame with a show full toggle that expands it in place (the server writes the line from the message's first meaningful line); your own messages carry your profile icon, else your initials, instead of the you square

agent chat: one top bar with the status light left of the name, waiting on me and one menu; military chat and tasks tabs; arrows only on agent-to-agent messages (up: sent to that agent, down: from it), none on the agent's own or your posts; a quote key on every message replaces the per-card reply boxes, and quoting a question still answers it; every node wears the same color and live state in the drawer, swarm page, org chart, ledger, board and chat

an agent's chat shows its answer live while it works on your message: one draft that grows as it writes (its words only, no tool output), marked writing, replaced by the final answer when the turn ends, and marked stopped mid-answer if the agent stops

drag a swarm node to a new place inside its tier (companies, projects, agents) in the drawer's swarm grid and the swarm page: it lifts and swings like the street view pegman, its neighbours slide aside and it plops into the gap; esc or a drop outside the tier sends it home, a phone starts it with a long press, and the order is saved for every device (GET and PUT /pack/node-order, MCP swarm_node_order and swarm_set_node_order)

every swarm agent's definition file and its codex twin are rewritten from carnivore's current templates each time the agent wakes and for every live agent at each server start, so an old rule text or a hand edit never lingers; agent memory is left alone

heavy background work is now admitted by class: ingest, integrity, tree scans and exports each have their own small budget, interactive traffic is never queued behind them, and a cancelled request keeps its slot until the work really finishes
plugin host routes are mounted before any plugin route and checked against shadowing, and third-party plugin installs get reserved names and an immutable install id for their data and secrets

plugin permissions are shown by risk with a per-permission tick sheet and no tick-all, a plugin that is not built in needs the sheet's consent to be turned on or granted, agents can only turn a plugin off or revoke grants, the session list a plugin reads carries only safe fields, and every permission use is logged per plugin

right-click a swarm node (long press on a phone) for a menu to rename it or set its own color, tile background and shape; the pick is saved for every device and every surface draws it the same, and auto, none or tier default clear it

swarm agent names follow one set of rules on every install: at most 25 characters and never starting with feat, fix or tweak; a task agent is named by its task and a feature agent by its specialty, which is stored, listed and used to send new work to the live specialist instead of spawning a duplicate; any agent can be renamed (agents_lookup still finds it by its old name); task agents show a small hourglass before their name; the naming family is now a swarm setting, off by default

swarm colors are picked for how they look on your theme: each project, company and sysop takes the color most unlike every one already taken, from every in gamut bright color (neons and near whites included, no brown, olive or gray), with separate sets for dark and light themes, so cobalt, argent and riverbed no longer read as three pinks

swarm colors sit 30 degrees apart: only sysop, the companies and projects with a project agent take a hue, on a 30 degree grid, so a project with no agent no longer crowds the wheel and the four similar oranges are gone; an agentless project wears the next free hue and shifts once when it gets its first agent

swarm look settings: pick the agent colors (by project or random), a body shape for sysop, companies, projects and agents (square, circle, hexagon, triangle, diamond, pentagon, octagon, star, shield or cloud) and how each status moves or stays still, with a live preview, saved once for every device

swimlanes cards show a one-line summary, open in the list's detail pane on a click, drag to reorder or change column, show five per cell, and carry per-stage quick actions (top, bottom, pause, mark done, auto-promote, reclassify with a note, archive, collapse, delete with a confirm); a calm green progress bar, column tints, roll-up glyphs and a queued look for unheld in-progress cards

sysop, company and project agents can no longer edit or write any file whatever the permissions setting, and company agents and sysop cannot create sessions, agents or cards; the limits come from the tools carnivore launches them with, not from prompt text

the home screen's attribution card shows a real started age, a running session is no longer listed twice under running and recent, archive and fork refresh attribution, and clicking a missing or unreachable project row explains why it will not open

the home screen's running session cards get the same three-dot menu the conversation sidebar has (rename, restart, fork, mute, new agent and the rest); a dead session keeps its inline restart and remove
the projects table sorts by its column headers (project, running, sleeping, closed, active), a second click flips the direction, and it opens alphabetical
the session listing reads which sessions it owns once per pass instead of once per session, so its datastore connections no longer grow with the session count

the swarm board has a fifth view, columns by project: one column per project with its cards stacked review first, then in progress, todo and done, each card with its state glyph, quick actions and the shared detail pane
the swarm board scrolls down again: with more lanes or rows than fit the window, every board view scrolls to the last one under its sticky header row

the swarm board's timeline view: parent cards as bars with their children nested under them on a 12 hour, 3 day or week scale, the working agent's face on every worked bar and its parent's line, a now line and the shared key
the swarm has no fixed agent limit: a new agent starts when the computer can take it, a project whose agents keep hitting merge conflicts runs at most 3, and the old caps are optional settings

the swimlanes view has an agent chat key that adds a chat column before todo in every lane, showing the lane's agent chat inline with an open full chat key for its drawer; the device remembers the key
third-party plugins can now run in a sandboxed subprocess of their own with a Python SDK, a host that treats every frame as hostile, and a conformance kit that proves each refusal can fail

turning on a project agent in a folder that is not a git repo works from the seat: after the not a git repo answer the confirm becomes git init and turn on, which runs git init, turns the agent on and closes the git init card; a refused card approve stays open and says why on the card

turning on an agent is one click everywhere, with no confirm row: when the project folder is not a git repo the server runs git init itself, then turns the agent on and closes any old git init card; a missing folder, the home folder, a system folder or a folder inside another repo is refused and the reason shows inline
a blueprint automation that fails now raises its failure alert instead of erroring out
a crosstalk card no longer disappears a moment after it appears: the delivery header is now found when the terminal repaints it wrapped over several rows at the pane width (#1309)

a finished automation run with delivery due now raises one alert in the bell (naming the automation, with an open report link) even with no notification destination set up; destinations that tick the type still get it
a new project's own first session no longer stays on an ancestor project (such as the home folder's): creating a project and each boot re-home sessions derived onto a shallower project

a page refresh keeps the right and bottom rails' open state: the widget open in each section and the dragged width or height come back per device, already pushed with no slide, and a widget no longer on the rail comes back closed
a scheduled notification's own text goes to outside destinations only where details are turned on, secret-scrubbed and never by SMS; every other destination gets the fixed line
a session carnivore starts with huddle channels on no longer stops on the loading development channels warning: carnivore answers it once per launch, only when the one channel listed is its own

a session stopped on a startup screen (folder trust, an mcp server, the bypass permissions warning, external imports) now shows its warning and real options on its questions card, and your click presses exactly that option; nothing answers one for you, beast mode included

a type muted everywhere (or here) no longer pops up as a card: cards drawn before the mute list loaded, or already on screen when a mute landed, are taken down, and a failed settings read can no longer let a muted type through. the status lights never change.

a warez page lists every item of the signed catalog with kind chips and featured, newest and oldest sorts; the skills page drops its catalog tab and shows only what is installed, and the old catalog links open warez
a weekly scrooge automation is saved on every install, switched off until you turn it on; deleting it keeps it gone

a widget rail splits into two sections: drop a widget on the top or bottom band (left or right for the bottom rail) in edit layout, open two widgets at once with a draggable divider between them, and the closed rail marks the split at the same line
adding a note to a typed huddle question no longer bounces the list upward: the note field takes focus without scrolling
agents a project agent spawned fold under a collapsed agents sub-heading in their project, so the drawer shows only the agents you launch directly

agents can list every scheduled huddle task across all lists with the new huddle_schedules tool (soonest next fire first, filter by list or paused); the Automations huddle tab and the tool now share one server route, GET /cplugs/huddle/scheduled

an agent can file many projects, archived ones included, under one company on a single approval card that lists every project, and filing an archived project no longer fails with no project with that id
an agent run through the ai gateway now passes its spend cap on to claude as --max-budget-usd instead of silently dropping it
an all huddles widget shows every huddle list under its project head, not tied to the selected session, and can be dropped on either rail or a dashboard

an asleep session can be purged for good: a plan traces every row, file and transcript keyed to it, and the purge runs only with Beast Mode armed and the owner typing the session's name on the approval card
