an automation alert's open report link opens the run's report every time, including a second click after the report was closed
an automation can drop a card on a project's swarm board: it lands in todo, or in progress when you ask it to start right away, with the day or week filled into its title

an automation can launch a saved blueprint: each run starts fresh sessions marked auto in the sidebar, puts each to sleep when its turn ends, and closes the sleeping sessions of runs older than the newest three

an install whose archive file was retired or lost now reports archive_missing by name on the ingest, projection, freshness and corpus status records instead of a bare no such table failure, and switching the backup plugin on no longer builds empty message tables in cloude.db that would hide a restored archive

approval cards for filing a project under a company, setting a company's HQ project and its color family name the company and project instead of showing ids, and the left bar's line between two companies is shorter (inset from both sides) so the big group breaks read as the major breaks

approval cards lead with what they do: a verb and object line (purge session, move project), the name, one to three short consequences, then the paths, plan and full request folded under details; destructive actions approve in red. the approvals pane, its widget and the questions tab now show the type-the-name box a session purge asks for (the inbox dropped it before), the huddle row draws the same card, and a refusal shows inside its own card instead of a line that stayed at the top of the pane

approval cards use plain words above the fold (its terminal closes, it disappears from your sidebar, carnivore now looks in the new folder, remove project from company), company parent, company home project and dialog answers get real cards instead of the generic one, and the style guide shows one card per action kind grouped destructive, changes and calm
automations core: own store, cron schedule with a 15 minute floor, exactly-once claim loop, skip-never-late missed slots, spend gates and boot reconcile; no targets yet

automations grow into a cron: a description and project, a choice for missed runs, retries and a longest run, system actions, a message to a session, commands from your own allowed list in settings, steps in order, a change log of who edited what, and a rotating scheduler log you can tune
automations routes and mcp tools: save, edit, delete, run now, cancel and preview schedules over the api, with approval cards that show the full prompt and refuse unattended agents from agents

automations_list (and GET /automations) can filter by project, session, enabled and target kind, and group_by session returns the sessions tab's project, session and unassigned tree, so session automations can be tested over MCP

claude code mods: one registry that adds or removes a mod folder in the env block of Claude Code's settings files (symlinked account files written once through their real file), an installed-mods inventory, the mods routes and push topic, and mods_list, mod_set_enabled and mod_remove over MCP (no install over MCP)

claude sees asleep sessions and orphaned drawer pins (sessions_list include_asleep, session_status, pin and unpin by session_uuid), and gains tools for what the app's own menus do: rename, wake, theme, unread, mute and interrupt a session, read and answer its open dialog, create and delete a project, dashboards and widget settings, synced preferences, themes, notification pause and app alerts; with beast mode armed every write runs at once except the always-wait set, and claude can turn beast mode off but never on

companies nest: a company can sit under another (up to four levels, never in a cycle), the agents tab draws child companies inside their parent and a project inside the project whose folder holds it, and agents can create, rename, nest, set the hq of and delete companies through new carnivore tools, each waiting for your approval

cron agent form on the Automations page (folder, prompt, read only, edit or no-prompt levels, login, api key, caps) and continue in a session on an agent run; tool patterns may hold spaces, such as Bash(git status)

cron agents run on the server: the installed claude -p under the agent's picked login with a dollar cap, a turn cap counted from the stream, an allow-listed environment and orphan cleanup after a crash

every MCP tool name follows one scheme (family first, verb last, collections are plural _list): 17 tools are renamed, among them automation_commands to automation_commands_get, automation_runs to automation_runs_list, company_set_hue to company_hue_set and huddle_schedules to huddle_schedules_list, and a test refuses a new name that breaks it; agents can also read and set the scheduler pause with automation_scheduler_get and automation_scheduler_set (always the owner's approval)

every sidebar right-click menu now uses one fixed letter per action (rename r, new n, add to a, show path i, copy y, sleep s, wake w, crosstalk x, schedule l, restart h, close k, delete d), the same on an open, asleep or archived row and on project, group and company headings, instead of letters handed out by whichever menu item came first
in a busy session the terminal cards now cover the newest 500 crosstalk messages instead of the oldest 500, so the latest cards are never missing

in the left sidebar, shift+click on a heading (company, nested company, project, group or the companies heading) opens or closes everything underneath it in one go, and the chevron turns into a double chevron while shift is held over a heading
in the side panel, the line between a company's folders and its nested company is inset to the nested company's own level instead of spanning the full width

installing a claude code mod from warez runs claude code's checker on a staged copy, shows the events and calls it found on a consent sheet with a trust tick (and a second tick for a flagged or unreviewed mod), refuses a blocked review, never auto-updates a mod and unregisters it before its files move on uninstall
marking a huddle post read or answering a question no longer makes the row vanish, pop back, then vanish: a read that left before your write never paints the old state back
messaging: bind a session to your own imessage conversation; texts reach it only when no dialog is open, held ones arrive as one dated batch, and a bound session can text you back

one-line installer served from carnivore.ai: curl -fsSL https://carnivore.ai/install.sh | bash installs the missing dependencies and the pinned, checksum-verified Carnivore release, with a copy button on the landing page

opening a widget rail's slide-out resizes the terminal grid to make room (narrower for the side rail, shorter for the bottom rail) instead of covering it; dragging the slide-out bigger shrinks the grid once you let it settle, and closing gives the space back

past agent to agent conversations are browsable: a crosstalk widget for the rail or a dashboard with all, this project and this session views, a crosstalk entry in the session row and project heading menus, and the MCP tool crosstalk_threads_list
preview-install.sh no longer dies silently about 1 run in 8: its awk pipelines read all input so git and hdiutil never take SIGPIPE under pipefail

project move plans show everything even when a check fails, name a missing parent folder, can create it (create_parents), echo the long folder spelling and the transcript spelling behind each move, need the plan's fingerprint to apply, refuse a move across the icloud drive line and never download to read, carry project-scope skill installs, run one at a time, and hand back the exact reverse call
rail keys for changes, huddle and all huddles show a small alert count bubble (changed files, items needing you), capped at 99+ and hidden at zero; each widget's settings can switch it off

remove one skill from a command center cell: a confirm sheet moves the folder to that place's trash (never a delete), refuses a catalog-installed copy and a stale view; POST /skills/remove and the skill_remove MCP tool

restarting, stopping or deleting a session that is mid-work shows an in-use line on the approval card (running agents, open dialog, recent activity), tells the calling agent at once, and always waits for you even in beast mode; a window merely open on a quiet session is a quiet note only
run now works on an automation that is switched off, so you can test it before turning its schedule on; a skipped run now keeps its run now label
scrooge numbers: read-only per-project spend from the stats store, rule-file size and overlap checks, and the seven-lever coverage table, the data layer for the weekly report
scrooge report recipe: spend numbers, rule-file checks and one capped read-only ai pass stored as a report, one notification, and a fix-it route that opens a session with the finding's prompt

session purge now reaches archived rows, an older stopped row that shares a tmux name with a newer one, and rows with no project: it resolves the target against the sessions table by session_uuid, ses_ id, row:<id> or a tmux name carried by exactly one row

sessions and projects carry a short and a long description, and the sessions_roster MCP read tells an agent who is online or around, what each is doing, its project and company family, and which rows are archived so it does not wake one by accident

shift-collapsing a sidebar heading now keeps every heading under it closed, however many there are, so a plain expand afterwards shows them all still collapsed (the saved fold list used to stop at 100 and silently dropped the rest)

skill command center read side: a server matrix of every local skill against every non-archived project and the personal skills folders, its route, the local_skills push topic wired to the existing skill writers, and skills_command_center over MCP

skill copy operation: copy one local skill folder to other projects or the personal skills folders with a dry run, a source digest and generation check, scripts kept as they are, and replace through the trash; POST /skills/copy and the skill_copy MCP tool

the agents drawer's row detail menu has a show archived toggle: on, archived sessions are listed under their projects after the other rows, marked archived, and the drawer search finds them; off (the default), the drawer and its search are unchanged
the agents list now draws the same divider after the groups and after the companies as it does between pinned, layouts and groups, and the line between two companies is a little lighter
the approvals key on the session rail now shows a count bubble for the approvals waiting on you, live from the pushed list, with the same show badge widget option as the other widgets, on by default

the automations page gets tabs: automations, sessions (projects, their sessions and what is scheduled on each) and an optional huddle tab of scheduled huddle items; session and project menus in the drawer get schedule this
the automations page shows its huddle tab whenever the huddle addon is enabled and falls back to the automations tab when it is turned off; the huddle tab switch is gone
the automations page: a menu item with the list of automations, an editor with a live cron preview, run history that names each skip reason, and the scrooge report with one fix-it button per finding
the automations sessions tab labels each session with its tmux name instead of its display name
the catalog knows a new kind, claude code mod: install roots, manifest rules and consent treat it as global-only code that never installs in one click or updates silently
the catalog listing now carries the signed featured order and each item's first published date, and agents can list catalog items over mcp
the catalog toolbar gets kind chips, an available filter (hides anything installed anywhere) and featured, newest and oldest sorts, with featured as the default
the huddle and all huddles widgets in the session rail now carry the huddle's view switch (status, area, claude) and density keys (compact, normal, full)

the huddle mcp steers agents toward posts the owner actually sees: a question posted as an info or answer is refused and pointed at huddle_ask, a plain ask with several question marks must use questions, and every write answer says whether it reaches the owner and why

the left sidebar is a real tree: every level (companies, company, nested company, project, nested project, the agents fold, sessions, a layout's members) steps in by one fixed amount, so rows at the same depth start at the same x and dividers sit at their own level
the menu bar tray lists the next scheduled automation runs and the last results, can pause and resume the whole scheduler, and opens the Automations page; the page gets the same pause switch
the mods page: a menu item (hotkey m) listing Claude Code mods with a catalog or local tag, an on or off switch, remove, and a link to get more on warez

the session view has a side widget rail (changes and files by default) and a bottom rail: widgets slide out over the terminal for the active session, the slide-out can be dragged wider or taller, and edit layout drags widgets in, along, across and out

the sidebar's right-click menus are regrouped with hairline spacers (open, identity, info, schedule and notifications, lifecycle, delete alone), and a session row gains copy session id, which copies the conversation id claude resume takes and is greyed out with a reason until the agent has recorded one
the sidebar's right-click menus gain show path: a session row opens a small popup with its working folder in full, and a project heading shows the project folder, each with a copy button
the skills page gets a command center tab: every local skill against every project and the personal folders, and a copy sheet with a dry run, a scripts list and a stale check
the widget rails' headers and strips carry a quiet accent tint, so a rail panel is easy to tell from the main view and easy to place

warez looks like an app store: a featured strip, new arrivals and latest updates, a packs shelf listed once, and cards with a kind icon and version line; tiles, panels and cards now step off the page ground on every theme, on every page that uses them, and the "catalog order" sort is gone

with show archived on, an archived project now sits under the company it is filed under, its heading marked archived, with its archived sessions under it, instead of every archived session landing in orphaned projects; a company whose projects are all archived is no longer empty

16 themes (calming, claw, codex, corporate_v2, gameboy, green_crt, ice_forge, jagermeister, legacy_apple, legacy_windows, neon_city, neural, pokemon, riot, snes, terminal) left the app bundle and install from the signed catalog as nyedis/<id>; a session, project or global theme that names one is installed on the next refresh pass

a catalog theme that carries code (effects scripts, mascot sprites, stylesheets) is refused at staging unless it is signed under the owner's handle; community themes stay data only, and a first-party theme auto-updates

a click on a sleeping agent shows a wake button with an X to cancel; cozy rows drop the top-right figure and show model effort at the right of line two; the phone drawer reaches a 36px strip at the edge
a huddle item an agent wrote onto another project's list now carries a small "from <project>" tag on its row

a huddle question with one single or yes/no question is answered right in the thread: its context, command with copy button, and option pills draw under the post and one tap answers, no popup; shift-click on a question's answer button, pills or popup header dismisses it, and the agent reads every question as skipped and dismissed

a messaging provider refusal now reaches the agent with its own status, code and the provider's sentence instead of a generic 502, and the owner's messaging log shows that sentence; a provider send_in_doubt or in_progress reads as a send that may have gone (do not resend), never a plain failure
a migrate wizard moves a project or a whole company to another paired computer with a plan, a confirm and live progress, and a move back button on the moved to tag brings a project home
a new resource-push topic, themes, is named after every catalog theme install, update (automatic pass included) and removal, and the theme registry re-reads the theme list on it

a pack tab in settings lists every paired computer with live load, the master, the compute reserve and per-computer restrictions that each computer enforces itself; the master is agreed across computers by revision gossip

a paired computer can mirror a Claude account: the owning computer pushes the fresh access token and expiry, never the refresh token, over the link into a separate relay profile on the target; off until you switch an account on
a pipeline widget shows each pipeline add-on as an ok, behind, failing or off icon with its detail on hover, and the waiting, running and done jobs newest first, pushed live with no polling
a project can switch on a nudge: when an open or working swarm item goes quiet, carnivore wakes the project's idle agent about it, and flags the item to you as stuck if the nudges get no answer

a project or a whole company moves to another paired computer with its code, Swarm agents, huddle threads and cards, and conversations, is verified there before it becomes home, stays on this one as moved away, and can be moved back

a session bound to messaging now shows one small speech-bubble icon instead of a text badge: an arrow shows in, out or both, and a yellow dot marks held texts; the words are in the tooltip, so compact rows stay narrow

a session can finish imessage setup over mcp: messaging_conversations_list shows the provider's routable conversations by name (never a phone number), and messaging_conversation_add registers one only after the owner approves, whatever beast mode says

a session row shows a yellow exclamation in its kebab slot when the session's transcript says an MCP server dropped (an app restart drops them all), with a tooltip naming the servers, and the row menu gains reconnect mcp, which types /mcp reconnect into an idle session only and refuses a busy one; the same action is an authenticated route and an MCP tool
a toast's theme accent now also reads themes installed from the catalog, and a theme that was missing at the first lookup is no longer remembered as having no accent

a widget with views (tasks, bookmarks, automations, huddle) can be dragged out more than once into the drawer's widget area and both session rails, each copy keeping its own view, so this session and all sessions sit side by side; a second drag adds a copy instead of moving the first, and rails saved before keep every placement

a working swarm item shows a steps strip beside its worker lines (3 of 7, now: running tests) that opens into the claiming session's live checklist, and a working session with no claimed item shows its steps under its project bar; pushed, nothing for codex sessions or finished lists

after a verified index refresh the app installs, with no sheet, any moved first-party theme the user has in use (global, session pin or project default) from the signed catalog as nyedis/<id>; pins on deleted themes are tidied at boot and the themes list is pushed to open clients
agents can rename an archived project through project_rename (display name only, the owner still approves); a name another project already carries is still refused

an agent's huddle writes go to its own project's list: a write onto another project's list is refused with a plain warning unless the call passes cross_project, and an allowed crossing is noted on the item's thread
an approval you decided no longer leaves the huddle item or its tab badge unread: the outcome post is born read, and claude's approvals item reads once nothing on it waits

an hourly catch-up save queues restore points for conversations that have none or kept growing, and alerts now warn about a stale or unplugged backup drive, a stale time machine, many unsaved conversations, stuck pipeline plugins and failed summaries

an installed catalog theme's preview art and manifest are read from its /themes/ folder in the themes page, the themes cell, the widget harness and the terminal ui, instead of assuming the bundled path
an installed theme whose script is the signed catalog's own first-party code runs without a consent prompt; a stored never still wins and other user themes still ask
an unpaired install opens a carnivore setup screen with the authenticator code instead of the login form, and it comes back until you pair
approving a permission question no longer says the prompt changed, and its card no longer redraws every few seconds, when claude shows its auto-deny countdown
archiving a project now archives its asleep and other non-running sessions too (a running session stays), and restoring the project brings those sessions back

automations widgets list the schedules aimed at the selected session and, in an all automations widget with the globe mark, the global ones tied to no session, each with its schedule in words, next and last run and an enable switch, pushed live with no polling
bonjour advertises the link port and lists join candidates with a short fid

bookmarks are in the session row menu (bookmark, bookmarks...) and as two widgets, one for the selected session and an all bookmarks one for every session, pushed live; branching from a conversation gone from disk restores it from its newest restore point first (save add-on on)

bookmarks: a compaction point's peek no longer comes up blank; points recorded with only a line number now resolve, and the walk back follows past a missing or looping boundary parent and into the earlier transcript file a resumed conversation came from
catalog theme names split three ways: the 12 bundled and 11 retired ascii names stay refused for everyone, the 18 moving names are usable only by the first-party publisher
computer links table and store for joined computers (schema v85)

dismissing a question on a huddle row now works like closing an info or look: shift-click anywhere on the card, or click its icon, dismisses it, and the icon turns into the close glyph and the card dims while the close is armed

every /compact point shows in a session's bookmarks as an automatic bookmark (archive-box mark, hideable, branch and rewind like any bookmark, pushed live), and the past turns list is now recent turns, folded until you open it
every global widget icon wears a small globe in its lower right corner, on every surface that draws a widget icon, so the global sibling reads apart from its local one
every internal pack identifier of the Swarm (tables, config keys, routes, push topics, folders, catalog keys) is now swarm, migrated once at boot, so Pack can mean the group of paired computers

first-launch theme install skips a deprecated release and a frozen index, the retired-theme pin prune keeps a user's own folder of that name, and a project's .cc.theme read is capped and regular-file only

home analytics can show every computer in the pack: load against the reserve line, cpu, memory, disk, battery and the agents running on each with their cpu and memory, a total per computer and a total overall, pushed live with no polling

huddle posts draw a fenced code block as a command area with an icon-only copy button, and a single question can carry a command shown above its options, which then draw as pills so a handoff can be run and answered without leaving the sidebar
installed first-party catalog items published as example-owner are re-labelled nyedis in place after a verified index refresh, ledger rows and the folder sidecar alike, with no reinstall

changes.details: install.sh gains --new, --join, --agent, --dmg/--sha256, a one-shot gui launch agent, a health and door wait, the tmux guard and coded failures. no secret ever rides argv.
changes.summary: installer: join and new computer flags, coded failures, one-shot launch agent, door client
join protocol and invites for the one command join: messages, keys, macs, rolling wrong code cap
joined state: a computer that joined a pack is marked joined, listens only on itself, and reports joined in health and enrollment status

lineage now records bookmark rewinds, a live /clear that was first seen as a switch, the exact split point of forks, branches and rewinds, compacts and fork points read live from the transcripts on disk, codex parent pointers, and an MCP tool to read it all
link identity for joined computers: derived key, pinned cert checks, mtls contexts, spake2 pin
link multiplexer frames and session for joined computers

new agents are placed on the computer with room left after its owner's reserve, light work stays on its project's home, battery blocks heavy work, a computer over its line puts its own agents in the background priority, and placement_explain says why

on a huddle row the question card now shows the newest open question (it showed the oldest), draws a lone single or yes/no question inline with its first context line, command box and answer pills, and counts older open questions as +N more open

one project's agents can run on several paired computers from the same repository while the home keeps the board, chat and memory: a remote agent's report or question is run by the home as its own action, a forged binding is refused, a spawn stays home unless a computer is named or auto-distribute is on, and one tool refreshes the Pack after a change lands

one running session moves to another paired computer after its turn ends: it sleeps, its conversation is carried over, and it wakes there resumed, refused up front when the other computer has no login for its account

pack a hidden project's folder into one verified archive inside it to save disk space, and unpack it later: a plan first, the originals go to the Trash only after every file is checked, and an archive changed outside carnivore is flagged before it is restored

paired computers carry project code to each other with git bundles or a tar fallback, air-gapped projects never contact GitHub, each project resolves its GitHub account, and a gh login can be carried to a paired computer
pipeline widget job rows name a conversation with no live session by its saved name or its first prompt instead of a short id; live sessions keep the name the sidebar shows
project colors: softer quick swatches, a custom color picker that writes any color, and new projects born with a random soft color not used by sibling projects

projects and companies get a stable uid shared across paired computers, a project can have an active replica on another computer, and a moved-away project refuses to create or wake sessions with 409 project_moved_away and says moved to the computer

projects now show their transport settings (air-gap, the github account in force and its source, the transport rung, publish a private repo), the pack tab has a follow the master switch, and a session or agent on another computer wears a machine badge
publish_batch prepare --from-dir stages first-party themes (effects and mascot kept, effects base vendored) and sign --at-head signs the tree already committed at HEAD (#1501, slice S4)

right-clicking a widget icon in the side or bottom rail now opens a menu for any widget with views or settings, with its views and its settings (checks, choices, and a settings form) in one place; those icons wear a small corner mark, and their tooltips read as name, view, and a line saying right-click for options
session tasks widgets show the agent's own task list, one for the selected session and an all session tasks one grouped per session, pushed live with no polling

session tasks, bookmarks, automations and huddle each merge their selected session and all sessions widgets into one widget with two views: one draggable item, a right-click on its rail icon picks the view (kept per placement on every device), the globe shows on all sessions, and edit layout marks a widget with views by a corner chip; rails saved with the old all sessions ids move to the merged widget on read
the authenticator setup code is served only to a request from this computer and only until you pair; the old qr route and the setup wizard's finish button are gone

the automations sessions tab names each session as the drawer does, lists only running or asleep sessions so no name repeats, and by default shows only projects and sessions that hold an automation, with a show all sessions toggle
the conversation index catch-up skips conversations older than the 180-day retention window, so it no longer re-indexes on every restart what the prune deletes again
the count bubbles on the right rail's widget keys no longer blink when data refreshes: a listing update keeps the count's source held, and a failed approvals re-read keeps the last count
the drawer keeps folds and row density separately for the desktop and the phone; pins and order stay shared
the drawer's hide project, company and sysop agents toggle moved into the view (density) menu as a checkable item, and its standalone key is gone; same stored preference
the eleven ascii themes are removed from the app; anyone using one falls back to carnivore, and the generic ascii rails and density control stay for any theme that asks for them

the example-owner to nyedis re-label now requires the exact installed release to pass the full signature and revocation check, moves the ledger first behind a revision guard, repairs a stale sidecar on the next pass, and never writes its temp file through a link

the files widget has two settings, show the global folder (default on) and which folder is on top (global or project, default global); the file browser's options menu flips the same two, and the browser honors them in the drawer, rail and grid cell

the first-party catalog publisher handle is now nyedis, compared through one normalised helper; example-owner stays reserved and is no longer first party; publishing scripts point at the new catalog repo
the hosted catalog now reserves the handle nyedis (no github login or email claim can take it, look-alikes are refused) and keeps example-owner reserved
the hourly catch-up save keeps 40 percent of each batch for conversations that grew since their last restore point, so live sessions no longer wait behind the backlog of never-saved conversations

the huddle no longer shows claude's approvals: no claude's approvals item, no approval rows, outcome posts or unread dots, and no approve tag in needs you; approvals stay in the approvals queue, the questions card and the alerts, and the old claude's approvals items are removed from every list at start

the left drawer and the right rail's slide-out now share the window: each can only grow until the terminal keeps 60 columns given the other's current width, and both clamp live when the window shrinks

the left sidebar and the right and bottom widget bars can be dragged as wide or tall as you like while the terminal keeps 60 columns, and every bar keeps a small handle so it can always be pulled back; a widget in a box too small for it shows just its icon and name

the left sidebar marks sleeping sessions with a sleep icon, archived sessions with an archive icon and inactive projects with a dashed folder icon instead of words, each with a tooltip and screen reader name; the show archived tick in the view menu now lists every inactive project too
the login and setup screens wear the carnivore palette on a fresh install instead of the old coral fallback
the menu bar app opens the setup screen on first launch, restarts the server once after you pair, and its authenticator window wears the carnivore look

the one-way archive no longer carries .git, and the receiving computer refuses any archive holding a .git path, a link leaving the folder, a hard link or a device file, stops one that expands past a real size ceiling or file count, and caps how much one paired computer can park in the blob inbox
the pack card on home analytics now shows each computer's reserve in force as text (cpu and memory percent) beside its level, and the agents cell separates the count from the cores and memory figures
the pack receiver now refuses a .git or .gitmodules path even when it carries trailing dots or spaces or odd unicode casing, closing a defense-in-depth gap in the archive guard

the pack tab now edits each computer's reserve as one form with the level in force shown live, holds the pack-wide auto-distribute and enhanced placement switches with a model picker, and switches the credential relay on per Claude account

the pipeline widget's backup icon shows the real backup state instead of always reading off: restore points plus the backup health checks, off only when the save add-on is off, behind or failing with the open backup alert named in its hover text
the project color picker is back on the projects page's project level (kebab, color) and in the sidebar project heading's kebab; one stored project color drives the swarm list's project header
the retired backup plugin (the old message archive) is removed from the plugins list; an existing archive file stays readable, but nothing starts the archive ingest any more

the right and bottom widget slide-outs are independent: both can be out at the same time, the right bar always spans the full height and the bottom bar sits between the left sidebar and the right bar; each remembers its own open state on this device

the session pane has ONE bookmark button that opens the bookmarks popup, where a name field and an add key at the top mark the latest turn; the popup list and the bookmarks widgets use icon keys (preview, bookmark, branch, rewind, delete) in place of words, and each bookmark can preview the last 4 chat messages before its point (the count and whether it shows are settings of the bookmarks widget; GET /bookmarks/{id}/preview)
the session_move mcp tool is advertised again: its input schema listed target twice in required, which claude code refused, and the tool builder now keeps every required list free of repeats

the swarm list loses its waiting-to-send section and row mark, the held and not-sent strips, the add box agent select and the reply box session picker; the send key at the bottom right stays for redirecting a list with no running session

the swarm nudge can be switched per agent from its row menu, an idle agent with nothing claimed is nudged to pick up the next open item, and an open item nobody claimed goes to the project's idle agent, one item at a time

the swarm panel's send key now reads tell carnivore and is icon only: it is disabled unless changes are waiting to be told, and shows a small count badge and a tooltip with the count; closed or missing sessions still open the session pick
the tab strip's new agent menu lists projects with an agent open in the current layout first, in tab order, then the other open projects, then inactive ones, with a divider between each group
the theme install gate is now an allow-list: theme.json keys and files are limited to what the catalog publishes, and a first-party effects.js may import only its own vendored effects-base.js
the theme listing marks an installed theme as first party only when its install record is the owner's signed release and its folder still matches the signed digest
the wake confirm on a sleeping agent hides the row's pin and menu while it shows, and screen readers hear the effort label

the yellow mcp exclamation now only shows for a server the running claude lost: drops from before this claude process started, the removals claude writes when it resumes a conversation, and servers that never connected no longer light it
tls link listener and member transport for joined computers, peer link transport seam
a Pack agent running on a relayed login now shows its real status on the paired computer, so messages sent to it are delivered instead of held
a Pack agent woken again on a paired computer keeps running on the relayed login instead of falling back to the computer's own default login
a Pack agent woken on a paired computer starts a fresh conversation when its old one ran under another login, instead of a resume that exits at once
a Playwright smoke test that the carnivore.ai landing page shows the install one-liner, run on the Pack machine the placement picks
a Swarm agent's chat says where the pack placed it and why (placed on <computer>: <reason>), from the reason recorded at spawn; no recorded reason, no line (#1618)

a computer is pegged only when its measured CPU is busy, not when its load average is high (a Mac at load 184 and 42% idle now takes work), and a replica still gets a branch when the home checkout is on a detached head
a computers tab in settings, hosts: add a computer with a code, see and remove linked computers, and join a pack
a connected paired computer that allows hosting agents can now be picked in the run this on step of a new session, and a disconnected or refusing one stays greyed with the reason beside it (#1619)

a crosstalk message to an agent on a paired computer now reaches it (the request path was sent with a doubled prefix and always got a 404), and an agent that is still starting up there holds the message and retries instead of failing it
a folder trusted only in the claude profile a project's sessions run on (Larkspur, say) is now carried to the other computer, so a moved session no longer stops at the folder-trust card there
a forged re-join can no longer overwrite pack settings or cut a working link, and a re-join after one side lost its pair now works (#1530)
a home analytics card that is empty because the stats plugin is paused or turned off now says so, with a link to the plugin settings, instead of promising data that cannot arrive (#1545)

a joined computer no longer restarts for nothing or shows the phone modal, the first-run resume asks for the code again, the join poll stops while several packs wait, and the shell reads the door socket name from the server
a live session card on the projects page shows its model, sub-agent and timer counts and its agent, shell and timer icons again, after the drawer's detailed row moved to its own triage body
a machine over its reserve line now puts the agent bodies it hosts for another computer in the background policy, not only its own agents
a messaging provider card shows whether texts are flowing: the last text in and out, the bridge's own log position and when it said so, and a flowing or stale state, not just connected
a move, replica or credential request to a computer that a restriction refuses now says which restriction refused it instead of a bare 401, and the pack panel shows each computer's memory
a moved-away project on the Projects page now says which computer it moved to by name (studio), not by that computer's install id

a multi-question ask can now be answered whole: the dialog carries every question with its option descriptions, and one new route and mcp tool types every answer into claude in order, checking the screen around each key, and submits once (#1548)
a notification click on a question always lands: an unreadable list or an undecodable ask opens the session, and the question modal closes only after the list stays empty on a settle read (#1541)
a one way computer is now enforced: it can change nothing on the main computer, receives no work, projects or credentials, and the main computer drives it as before

changes.details: Server half: the pn Bonjour key, the pack_name setting, and POST /auth/join/look and POST /computers/join/look run by the Terminal helper.
changes.summary: a pack can advertise an opt-in name, and a computer can look for a pack on a click
a pack or move refusal never prints a hidden shell name even when the shell has no row, and names its agent the way the sidebar does (#1551)
a pinned panel waits 2 seconds before giving up on an agent the listing dropped, and the notes status no longer sits under the pinned-on label
a pinned panel's "pinned on" label is capped at half the panel and the notes bar keeps that half clear, so a long agent name or save message never sits over the toggle (#1551)
a pinned widget panel keeps the agent it was pinned on while you move to other agents, a layout or Home, shows 'pinned on' that agent, and its bar key wears the agent's initial (#1551)
a pinned widget panel never shows another agent's notes while its own agent is still loading, and keeps a stored but stopped agent instead of closing (#1551)

a pinned widget panel's "pinned on" label now reserves a thin strip at the top of the panel it floats over, for every widget, and an unpinned panel reserves nothing; the notes-only half-bar rule is gone (#1551)
a plugin permission granted under its old name (pack, now swarm) still counts after the rename, so the huddle no longer falls back to needs approval
a project migrated or replicated to another computer keeps the folder trust you already gave it, so its sessions there start without the trust prompt; a folder you never trusted still asks
a project move no longer writes Claude's .claude.json; carried folder trust follows the move on Carnivore's own record instead (#1487)

a project moved to another computer no longer stops on the external CLAUDE.md imports prompt: it is answered by rule, yes when the project imports nothing outside its folder, otherwise only as your source computer already answered

a question notification click opens the approvals modal on that item even when the app window had to be recreated, and the modal gives every new empty spell its own settle wait before it closes (#1541)
a question notification click opens the session when the listing is unreadable instead of saying already answered, and the question modal retries its closing read (#1541)

a question whose option has a long wrapped description is read whole instead of served as a mismatch, and notes on the first option of a preview question now pick that option instead of reading as notes only (#1548)

a questions widget lists what waits on you in one place: the open approvals and the huddle items in needs you, oldest first with the session or project and how long each has waited, a click opens the approval inbox on that session or the huddle item, and both sources update live from their pushed topics
a relay profile on a paired computer is marked first-run setup done when a credential arrives, so a Pack agent placed there no longer stops on Claude Code's theme picker

a replica of a git project now ends up with a real checkout on the project's branch and the origin remote recorded, so an agent placed on another computer can commit; an air-gapped project stays offline
a replica that already holds its own commits still gets the home's origin remote recorded on the next carry, so its agent can push
a running terminal shell still blocks packing or moving its folder, and the refusal now names it as the terminal shell of its agent instead of a hidden carnivore_sh name (#1551)

a session moved or migrated to another computer now restarts on the login that can run it there (a relayed login) instead of opening logged out, and says account_not_usable when none can; a newer computer no longer breaks a move to an older one by sending folder trust it does not understand

a session timeline widget draws a session's conversations as bars from oldest to now with compacts, bookmarks, restarts, sleeps and restore points, a hook from each fork or rewind back to its split point, a peek around any mark and branch, rewind and open-a-copy from its menu, on the rail, a dashboard tile and the phone, pushed live; the MCP tool session_timeline_get reads the same answer

a spawn the Pack places on another computer is no longer refused 'system is pegged' by this computer's own load, a remote body, its proxy and the refresh fan-out no longer ask the host for a doubled /api/v1 path (404), and queued spawns are retried again (the retry beat crashed every ten seconds)

a split widget panel pins one section at a time: clicking the edge over one widget pins and lights only that widget, in a new lock color that no theme uses, and the other widget keeps following the active agent
a switch under settings, appearance, motion turns the app's animations off to save gpu (on by default)
a test server on this computer no longer advertises on the local network, so it cannot hide the real computer's key from a join
a tokens used card too short for its chart drops the chart and collapses the empty plot band to nothing, and the chart returns when the card grows or a row above it leaves
a tokens used card too short to draw a chart now shows only its breakdown instead of mounting the chart into a box it cannot fit
a tokens used card whose chart is dropped now collapses the empty plot band, and the chart comes back when the card grows
add a computer over ssh: the agent previews the host key and blockers, the owner approves once, and Carnivore is installed there and joined to the pack
add a computer with a short code over a direct link: invite, list, remove, one way and leave from the owner routes and agent tools
adding a replica of a project on a computer that already shows that project as an imported peer row no longer fails with project_name_taken; only a local project with the same name is refused

agent flow core data (schema v89, huddle.db rung 31): agent_spawn records its parent, a delivered crosstalk message keeps where it landed, huddle writes record the acting session and cross-project source, and an MCP event log of ids only

agents can no longer post a look in the huddle: a look that asked for an answer, tick or push is refused and points to a typed question or a review, and an info can carry notify to mark the item unread and badge the tab; looks already in a thread still show as before

alerts now say who sent them (the add-on, automation or agent, with its glyph), what kind they are (needs you, fyi or question chip), and what to do: the first fix is the main button before snooze and dismiss, re-check now re-runs the check, and the time machine cannot-tell alert explains the likely cause (full disk access or an unplugged disk) with an open privacy settings button; two new routes and mcp tools (alert_check, alert_open_system_settings) back the fixes, and the time machine probe now records why it could not read

an agent can recolor one project or many through the mcp tool project_color_set, a thin adapter over the project update route; one owner approval covers a bulk call and a bad project or color refuses the whole call
an auto-hidden widget bar slides back in about 300 ms after the mouse leaves even when you clicked its pin or a key; only keyboard focus holds it out (#1551)
an empty ranking card on a live metric no longer blames the stats plugin, and a stats plugin waiting for approval says so with a link to its settings (#1545)

answering a whole multi question ask never reports a landed submit as a failure, refuses if the notes box or the free text row does not behave, and the owner's approval card for an agent's batch answer says how many answers go in
backup health: a slow tmutil while a Time Machine backup is running no longer raises a cannot-tell alert, and an unreadable Time Machine only alerts after two passes in a row
between 700 and 1023 px the top menu holds the file editor and notes instead of opening empty, so files and notes stay reachable
bookmarks are core and always available; a conversation's transcript is found on disk (any Claude profile) before a restore point is tried, and that repair stays behind the save add-on
cancelling edit layout puts the drawer zone and both bars back in a single save, so a refused second save no longer leaves a bar changed (#1551)

carried folder trust now actually answers on a normal first launch (waiting for the startup prompt no longer uses up the tries), is stored by real path, applies to worktrees and the swarm path the same way, and is dropped when a project moves away

carried folder trust now follows claude code's own rule exactly, stops at the git root, never reaches a folder inside an existing repo or outside the projects folder, and answers only the plain trust dialog
