a paired computer's deep search and the Pack stats rollup know every folder a conversation recorded, not a window of its transcript: deep search keeps the folders it indexes, a subagent file it cannot place withholds its conversation, a project nested inside an air-gapped one counts as air-gapped, and while any project is air-gapped the rollup sends only stats rows proven outside every air-gapped folder (#1682)

a paired computer's deep search answers from one database snapshot, so a line indexed while the air-gap check ran can never reach it, and its tail read no longer shares the indexer's read key; the Pack stats rollup digest moves only when a project is air-gapped over a key a peer already holds, a newly proven key is re-sent by revision instead of making every peer re-pull, and the importer keeps the digest its pull started from (#1682)

a paired computer's deep search never sees an air-gapped project's conversations or their counts: the filter runs before ranking and paging and reads each conversation's own recorded folder, and while any project is air-gapped a conversation whose folder cannot be proven is withheld from Pack peers (#1682)

a plugin can declare the core features and minimum app version it needs; turning it on is refused when one is missing, turning off a plugin other plugins need asks first, and the plugin pane lists what it needs and who needs it
a plugin card waiting on a grant now shows a needs approval mark and a not active yet status beside its switch; pressing the mark opens the side pane on the permission sheet

a plugin's details pane is tabbed: a fixed strip with its name, state and switch, a reason strip only while it is held or waiting for a grant, then overview, settings, permissions and data tabs; data shows the stored size and purges in two steps while the plugin is off; the plugin list is unchanged
a question whose option description holds its own numbered list is read as the real options again, so it can be answered from the app and phone
a resumed session no longer shows the mcp-dropped warning for servers its new claude never had (claude.ai connectors); a working mcp tool call also clears a drop
a retire script empties the dormant pipeline job tables and deletes the plugin governance files, and docs/pipeline.md replaces the job queue design as the pipeline's current document (#1682)
a send-to copy keeps its code in sync: when either agent finishes a turn its commits go to the other computer, which fast-forwards its checkout only when idle, clean and strictly behind

a session row can show a Carnivore timers icon, an alarm clock in its own violet color, for a session that has automations; a click opens the automations page at that session. It is off by default and turned on per density in settings, sidebar row icons

a session row's Carnivore timers icon now counts the huddle's scheduled items that fire into that session as well as its automations, lists each by name and next fire time in the tooltip, and the Automations page's sessions tab shows those huddle schedules under the session
a session whose mcp server failed to connect (carnivore refused after a server restart, or any other) keeps its yellow ! on the sidebar row, naming each failing server, until it reconnects
a terminal in a side or bottom slide-out now has a clear gap on both sides of its header, so the title no longer touches the left edge and the status dot no longer touches the right

a terminal tab keeps a clear gap on both sides, so the session name no longer touches the left edge and the status marks no longer touch the right; a narrow tab shortens the name with an ellipsis instead

a transcript file bigger than one delivery run's read budget now goes straight back for the next run instead of waiting for the five minute scan, so a rebuild of stats or deep search finishes in minutes and the status no longer says caught up while a big file is half read (E5, #1682)

after an install, each idle claude session still reaching the carnivore MCP over plain http is resumed onto the stdio bridge by itself, one at a time and never a busy one, so it stops losing carnivore tools on the next restart; mcp.bridge_migration turns it off and /mcp-admin/bridge-migration reports it
ai settings, recent calls: a summary strip and spend breakdown, filters, server paging with a count, day groups, readable names, expandable rows and live updates

an agent can ask to reopen an approved huddle item or close an open one with a reason; the request waits in the approvals inbox as one card per item, nothing changes until the owner approves, and the outcome is a line on the item
an allow logins popup (yes or no, cannot be dismissed) asks which of the offered logins this computer accepts, and settings, pack, logins gets a this computer receives list to change it later
an approval dialog with ten or more right-aligned options reads every row again instead of dropping the first nine
answering a question now goes into the outbox like any other change and shows in its countdown; the outbox waits 10 quiet seconds (was 8) and at most 45 (was 30)

chatting with a project's swarm agent no longer counts as an unsent huddle change: the chat item and swarm cards never light tell claude, never queue or re-arm a tell and never send the list to the session that owns its items; your own tasks count as before

claude publishes review boards: task_manager_board_create and task_manager_board_revise write a revision into the boards folder through one locked writer and post a card on the task, which goes to review by default

deep search across computers: a paired computer's answer with a huge number or an unencodable character is dropped on its own and your local results always show; a peer search keeps its slot until its scan ends; a per-block cut redacts before it cuts

deep search becomes a plugin of the core pipeline: the new engine hands it each transcript file's new lines from a cursor kept in deepsearch.db and it writes the same index the live lane writes, marking the cache ready once everything is delivered; registered behind the engine flag, so nothing changes until the flip (#1682)
deep search finds what an agent just said seconds after its turn ends, instead of up to five minutes later

deep search hides secrets: credentials are starred before text is indexed, local hits show without waiting on a slow paired computer, and a paired computer needs the plugin's conversation access to be searched

changes.details: The deep search index moved out of the save pipeline into its own package, src/core/deepsearch. Deep search is now a core plugin: always on, no switch on the Plugins page or the owner route, it no longer needs the save plugin, and a stored off value from an older build is ignored with one log line. The rebuild action stays.
changes.summary: deep search is always on and lives in its own package; no switch, no save dependency (E4b, #1682)

deep search keeps its index in its own cache file built from the live transcripts, user and assistant text only, and rebuilds it by itself if it is deleted; searches keep answering until the new index is complete

deep search now covers paired computers: each searches its own transcripts and the results merge, tagged with the computer, a conversation on both listed once, and a computer that did not answer named in one line

deep search reads the part of its index that is behind (after a purge or a project move) before its write transaction opens, in steps no bigger than one run's byte budget, so a big gap no longer holds the index's write lock and is finished across runs with the same hits (R2, #1682)
drawer sections can be dragged into any order (a finger drags from the section icon; alt plus arrow keys move the focused heading), and the order is the same on every device (#1687)

each copy of the questions widget has a counts switch that shows or hides the number on its sidebar icon and the count inside the widget, and a copy that lists several alert types now wears a deliberate inbox-tray icon instead of the generic one

changes.details: One header for every widget (WidgetHead): 31px for all, the name in the accent with one tracking value, the header draws the separators between option groups and before a new close x. The x hides a singleton or removes a copy at once; it is absent on the terminal and the tabbed terminal, which keep their own head through record flags (ownHead, closable). A show header tick in the widget menu takes one copy's header off on every device. Drawer cards, widget bar slide-outs and the pop-out window wear the same header: the widget icon at the far left opens the copy's menu, a drawer card's gear and pop out key are one group before the close x, and a slide-out's header is off until ticked on from its bar key's edit layout menu. Single-row bars inside widget bodies (the timeline picker and filters, the crosstalk switch and thread back button) moved up into the header. Issue 1698, huddle item 538.
changes.summary: every widget wears one 31px header with a close x and a per copy show header tick, in the drawer, the widget bars and the pop-out too
handoff summaries are gone: no summarize stage, no llm lane, no ai for summaries tab in the log processor settings, and the token readout counts the live label only

holding shift over a browser or page row in the left sidebar turns its kebab into a red x that closes it: a page closes at once, a remote browser still asks first because its cookies and logins go with it; letting go of shift, or leaving the window, brings the kebab back, and only the row under the pointer or with keyboard focus changes, and on the focused row shift with enter, space or delete presses the x
home analytics cards answer at once from a saved answer ledger: right after a restart or a failed refresh they show the last good numbers marked as of when, instead of a blank card (#1682)

home analytics cards answer inside their own time budget: a slow card no longer blanks the others, 7 day activity reads in about a tenth of the time, rolling presets share one answer per minute, and the stats coverage read no longer waits on the transcript manifest (#1682)

home analytics cards paint together in one request, keep the last good numbers when a read fails or comes back stale (marked as of when), paint a saved copy first on a cold tab, and re-read at most once a minute (#1682)

home analytics count every paired computer by default, with a computer filter in the account filters; a conversation moved between computers counts once, and an offline computer keeps its last numbers tagged through its newest hour
huddle accordion: the project bars stacked above the open project sit flush at the top with no gap, like the ones below it

huddle data layer for the Task Manager rebuild: the stored states are todo, open, waiting, review and done (waiting_install, back_burner, done_by_claude, approved and approved_with_note are renamed, a note on done says read the note); a retired state name is still accepted on every input path and every answer says the new one; every task carries a lane (task_manager or swarm, the swarm never ticks or deletes a task_manager task), a perceived ask, a link to the owner's original add box text, its uncleared blockers and a lineage of every state move at GET /items/{id}/lineage; filing from the add box sets each item's perceived ask, and a card split from a card keeps the original ask; a Pack move between two builds speaks the old state names, sets the lane an older build left out and carries lineage, blockers and the original ask; nudge counts and stalls survive the renames; huddle.db walks rungs 34 to 42 behind a verified backup

huddle movement rules for the Task Manager rebuild: an agent's move past an uncleared blocker stops in waiting and the history says so (the owner's own moves are never blocked); a task is born open or todo; a new question folds the older open one as superseded; the owner's answer, submit or cancel question sends the task to open; his reply on a review or done task does not move it, Claude answers below or sends changes back to open; untick goes to open; ticking a repeating task returns it to scheduled; a fire on a waiting task is skipped; release resumes a schedule that came due while parked; the row's remove key asks delete for good, a delete is hard (thread, history, files) and only the owner's, an agent's delete is an approvals-inbox request; the tab badge counts questions plus reviews

launch picker: the collapsed account line no longer names the pane's current account as active when the active account cannot be launched, the restart account choice waits for the profile facts instead of flashing, and the account wiring is covered by tests (#1641)

less idle cpu: the pack machine snapshot is built once every few seconds and shared by every reader, and the plugin status stops rescanning the whole transcript manifest more than once every fifteen seconds
migration backups keep the newest 5 plus the last 3 days, their stray -shm and -wal files go with them, and the database write-ahead log is capped at 64 MiB on disk (#1682)

new and restarted sessions reach the carnivore MCP through a small stdio bridge that waits out a server restart and retries, so a restart or upgrade of the app no longer leaves a session without carnivore tools

no more hover tips that state the obvious: the home, agents and Swarm tabs, the Swarm org chart nodes and zoom keys, close and back and refresh icons, dialog close keys, the terminal key bar's esc, tab, arrows, enter and search, and anything whose tip just repeats its own visible text; tips that say something new (shortcuts, why a control is off, what a click does to your data) stay, and the Swarm tab icon is the alpha-over-two glyph again
pages opened as rows in the browser list now survive a server restart: same row, order and target until you close it

picking a page or remote browser row in the left sidebar now replaces the center screen like picking a session does; the dashboard or terminal that was showing no longer sits behind it, and closing it or pressing back brings that screen back

pipeline review fixes: a plugin that fails on a file backs off on its own and no longer slows the other plugins on a live conversation, live conversations are delivered before a replay, a hung transcript read costs one thread and cannot hold the worker, deep search never opens sub-agent files, a deep search switched off by an older build stays off for paired computers until the owner changes it, and the old job retry and rebuild actions refuse under the new engine (R1, #1682)

changes.details: Plugin manifests gain an optional owns block (strings, styles, assets, tests, migrations, style guide, contributions) and the self-containment rule is specified. The host no longer imports the huddle chat widget kind (it reads a plugin ship list), the drawer search box reads a search mode registry that deepsearch contributes to, and the huddle style guide specimens live in the huddle plugin folder. No behavior change. Issue 1630.
changes.summary: plugins are spec'd as self-contained: owns manifest block, early kinds ship list, search mode registry, huddle specimens in the plugin
pop out on a page or remote browser row opens a new browser tab at the page's address instead of a popup window; the desktop app sends it to your default browser

changes.details: Layered the animations setting rules, moved two flat tests into their folders, guarded the motion helper when the page has no root element, aligned the preview installer with the deploy signature requirement, and updated ratchets and golden bodies.
changes.summary: pre 1.16.1 pipeline: test and stylesheet layering fixes with no user visible change
projects start with no color; pick one or choose no color from the project menu, the edit dialog or the projects page; the show colors switch is gone
reading the huddle no longer claims items for the reader: only an explicit working does, a claim ends when its session starts a new conversation, and the stale read-made claims are cleared

restore points are now the save plugin, off until you turn it on in plugins: it keeps the storage cap, the capture scope and the restore points tab on a session's page, and starting a session after a restore needs the plugin's permission to start sessions

restore points can no longer hold up lifecycle milestones: the save plugin hears each event on its own announcer thread with a bounded queue, and the time machine retire script keeps the save plugin's folder and capture scope while the plugin is on (#1682)
restore the test of the library session delete route (soft by default, purge removes the row) and point the library cleanup docs at the removed scripts toolkit

retired the docs of the removed conversation archive (RETIRED banners and index rows), dropped the dead archive project-info dialog selectors from the modal glow stylesheet and the style guide (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, issue #1680, slice A6)
review boards get their on-disk format: a validated sidecar schema, a folder scanner and command-line tools, with the step 0 and part 1 flowcharts converted into design/boards
right click on the empty space of the left drawer's widget area offers edit layout or done editing, drawn by the screen that is showing, so a mouse click on the item always toggles edit
save pipeline: finished jobs of every kind are deleted after 7 days
send a session to another computer as a move, a copy that continues as a fork while the original keeps running, or a fresh agent, optionally adding the project there first (routes and MCP tools)

sending a session to another computer now needs the owner's sign-in on both routes, a second copy of the same conversation to the same computer no longer crashes, copy and fresh respect a computer that does not host agents, and the menu check no longer stalls the server
settings > ai > routing now lists fal.ai's image, video and audio models, read from fal's own public model listing

settings > mcp server gets two checkboxes, huddle tools for agents (off by default) and swarm tools for agents (on by default); off hides those mcp tools and their instruction lines from every session on this computer, live, and huddle off also stops installing the global huddle skill
settings > notifications no longer has a notification history list; the alerts bell and the answers tab cover it

changes.details: Window half: Settings join form gets look for a pack with yes/no rows (shared with the first-run window), and the alpha gets a pack name field above the computer list.
changes.summary: settings pack computers tab: look for a pack and the alpha's pack name field

settings, pack, work is redesigned: a status strip, placement with its model pickers inline under enhanced placement (defaults shown in the fields), each computer's real reserve and restriction values as chips, a move row that picks the project and the target computer, and two columns on wide screens

settings, pipeline now shows one status line (caught up, behind, stalled or rebuilding) and a rebuild button per plugin; the pipeline and save pipeline widgets and the developer widget's pipeline tab are removed, and a saved dashboard that held them drops them silently

settings, sessions and agents: hold cross-session agent actions is off by default; the mcp server section explains in plain words which carnivore features run on it and warns with the full list when you turn it off; the allowed commands list moved from settings to the automations page

settings: hosts becomes pack with a howling wolf icon and four tabs (computers, work, logins, ssh); every computer listed once with the alpha badge, a this-computer icon, a link icon and segmented cpu, memory and disk meters; master reads alpha everywhere in the pack screens

settings: sidebar rows becomes agent rows and previews the drawer's real row, the sidebar tabs color tab and the wake a sleeping session from a click setting are gone, the motion tab explains itself with a live example, and unread sessions stay awake defaults off with a 60 minute timer

shift+click (or shift+enter, shift+space) on a fold header opens or closes everything nested under it: in the huddle a project bar, a status section or a group; in the left drawer the layouts heading and a layout's row now join the companies, projects and groups that already did

shift+click on any huddle fold header (project bar, status section, group, subsection, flag group) no longer starts a text selection, matching the left menu, so the open-or-close-everything-underneath gesture reads cleanly

src/core/pipeline gains the engine: a dirty set with a per-key minimum interval and exponential backoff, one delivery worker that waits on an event and never polls, a scan thread that only marks files dirty, lifecycle milestones written once each with a retry list, a status snapshot (caught up, behind, stalled, rebuilding) and a per-plugin rebuild; not wired to boot yet, no product change (#1682)

src/core/pipeline gains the plugin contract and a new exactly-once deliver (cursor compare-and-set and the plugin's writes in one transaction, every file read under a wall-time guard) that writes the same plugin_cursors and plugin_meta as the current engine; not wired to boot yet, no product change (#1682)
tapping a link in the terminal on a phone, in the browser or the iphone app, now opens it instead of just scrolling; dragging still scrolls
task manager: a folded project, area or status heading's question, look and info marks skip the completed items hide completed hides (#1720)

task manager: an item typed into the add box shows your person icon even when a session filed it, shift no longer holds the tell on the question answer form (every answer queues), and a folded heading no longer shows unread marks from completed items that hide completed hides (#1720)

task manager: with hide completed on, the list reads send each completed item as a placeholder (id, place and state, no text or thread) instead of the whole item, and the list re-reads when hide completed is turned on or off (#1720)

tests/pipeline gains a fixture corpus and an equivalence harness that runs the current deliver into a scratch stats database and dumps a canonical snapshot, the baseline the new engine is proven against, no product change (#1682)

the Carnivore timers icon on a session row and the automations figure in the stats bar now show how the timers are doing: green when all ran fine, yellow on a skipped or retrying run, red on a failure, gray with an x when switched off; the row icon is shown by default and the status comes from the server

the MCP tools read the same marked session listing as the app, so session_status shows the running subagents and background tasks instead of nothing, and the in-use warning on restart, stop and delete names the agents still running

the Time Machine package, its scripts, the backfill and rechunk module and the restore point read paths of deep search are deleted; deep search answers from the live transcripts cache alone, with partial results while it builds
the agent page sandbox policy moves to one shared sdk module, and plugins may name tools in the task manager family, which the swarm proxy, the agent huddle switch and the company deny list now route
the agent row menu no longer lists crosstalk, bookmark, swarm: nudge when idle, messaging or change agent type, and copy session id is hidden while the agent has no conversation id yet
the agent row menu's move to another computer becomes send to: a computer submenu, then one dialog to move, copy, start a new agent there or move the whole project
the agents drawer has a pack section under browsers listing the paired computers, and the pinned heading no longer shows a status light (#1687)
the beast mode setting is a called-out block with the bolt, what it is for, what it allows and never answers, and the security risk; the bolt button no longer wears a question mark

the bottom of the swarm task list is tidied: the key row is icons only, the remove completed key is just its count at the far left and its confirm says it deletes the checked items for good, the group keys show only in the by group view, hide completed is one eye that shows its state, the add box sits in its own strip with room below it, and the thin needs a decision strip at the top of the list is gone
the close x is gone from page and remote browser rows in the left sidebar (close is still in the row's right-click and kebab menu), pop out stays, and the pin is back right beside the kebab
the conversation index (summaries, last messages, its search and settings routes) is removed on the server; deep search covers finding old conversations

the database is renamed from cloude.db to carnivore.db once, at the first start after an update (backed up first), so there is only ever carnivore.db; the deploy backup no longer creates an empty cloude.db (#1609)
the deep search cache rebuild plans its next slice only when no job is waiting, about 14 times faster (hours down to minutes)
the drawer stats bar has no hover tips, the pack wolf comes first, the token rate sits flush right and the automations figure is gone (#1687)
the drawer stats bar loses its border, keeps the token rate at the right with one decimal at most (4.5M), and shows a wolf with the number of computers in the pack when there is more than one

the hourly save catch-up automation, the many-conversations-have-no-restore-point alert and the summaries-keep-failing alert are removed; the old catch-up row and both alerts are cleaned up once at startup, and the backup health check keeps watching the usb drive, the macos time machine and the pipeline plugins

the huddle answers at once: a tick, an answer and a reply change the row on the click and the answer form closes on the click, the all projects read is about half the size (and gzipped), and the tell button's count clears when the queue sends
the huddle no longer shows a working session's steps line under a project when the session claims no item; the steps strip on a claimed working item stays
the huddle nudge no longer fails for a project whose sessions are all asleep: the sleeping session list read a name field the record never had (#1656)

the huddle review card has three parts: a one-line summary, the description in a fold that starts folded, and what to review and where last; an agent's answer to your question on a review shows under the card

the inbox icon and the inbox itself are gone from the icon rail, the phone strip and the header; the alerts bell and the questions tab cover everything it listed, and a notification click still opens the question popup

the kind checkboxes moved from the top bell to the waiting on you widget: an all check on top and one per kind (approvals, huddle questions, automations that failed), saved for every device, staying open while you check, keyboard included; the bell shows every kind and every alert with no filter

the launch profile is chosen from a custom dropdown with larger icons, a choose account link lets a new agent start on another account and remember it, and the launch profiles settings show the chosen icon

the left stats bar shows how many automations are switched on and a click opens the automations page; clicking the agents, working or waiting-to-be-read figure lists only those agents with every fold open and a loud yellow border on the figure, a second click clears it

the live-point catch-up save for conversations that grew now runs every 30 minutes instead of hourly, and the retired message archive can no longer be switched back on by its config flag or environment variable

the lock on a slide-out widget is now per tab: locking one tab of a section leaves its sibling tabs following the active agent, the locked tab wears a small lock icon at its bottom right in the tab strip, the frame outline shows only while the locked tab is the one showing, the locked agent's title is always drawn in the strip (an ellipsis when tight, gone only with no room) with no hover, an existing per-section lock moves onto its active tab, and the lock color is now a bright neutral from the theme text color instead of pink
the mcp server monitor is now the mcp health plugin, off by default, with an allow or block list of the servers that may raise the yellow ! and optional down and back notifications
the mcp session_create refuses a bad account before the owner is asked and names the launchable ids, and the launch record names the active account when a pinned account was removed (#1641)

the new pipeline engine is now the default: stats and deep search are delivered by one worker that wakes on a file change instead of a job queue, after a rebuild from the transcripts on disk gave the same token, cost and counter totals as the live stats over 21108 files; the only difference is that zero-usage synthetic completion markers are no longer counted as messages; pipeline.engine "old" in config.json is the rollback (E5, #1682)

the new pipeline engine is wired in behind a boot-read config value pipeline.engine (old by default): under new, boot starts only the new engine's worker and scan threads, stats is delivered natively, the watcher's file events and working sessions mark transcript files dirty, lifecycle triggers write one milestone each, the stats rebuild runs on it, and GET /pipeline/status plus the pipeline_status MCP tool report it; under old nothing changes (#1682)

the notes widget's edit | preview toggle and a save disk now sit at the right end of its title row, and in the notes drawer's one head row; the disk is green when saved, yellow while unsaved or saving, red with the reason on an error, and a click saves now or retries; the note gets proper padding
the notification settings no longer list a transcript scan type, and the save pipeline type is now backup health only, because the pipeline raises no alerts (#1682)
the nudge is now its own plugin, off until you turn it on; its minutes, tries, items named and nudge texts are settings in the plugin's side pane, and settings you saved under swarm carry over
the old save pipeline engine, its job queue routes and its three MCP tools are deleted; the pipeline engine is the only one, and restore points hear lifecycle events from it (#1682)
the pack credential relay is now on by default for every Claude account you have not switched off; a computer still receives logins only after its own owner allows it

the pipeline and scheduled tabs show what is running and the queue again, the plugin squares lose their rebuild buttons (rebuild stays in settings, pipeline), the selected tab is the lighter fill, and the chart's run time column is never cut off
the pipeline and search index schema steps (v51 to v55) move into a db_ddl package so the migrations no longer import the save pipeline, behavior unchanged (#1682)

the pipeline plugins' approval governance is gone on the server too: the log processor routes and their three MCP tools are removed, and a paired computer's deep search no longer needs a plugin switch or grant, only the pairing, never a one-way computer and never an air-gapped project

the pipeline plugins' approval screens are removed: no data view, grant, start point or slow lane settings remain, because the stats and deep search plugins are built in and always on (settings, pipeline keeps its status line and rebuild buttons), #1682

the pipeline widget and the developer widget's pipeline tab have their status squares back on top: one per plugin, ok, behind, failing or off by shape, with its backlog, last delivery, last error and runs on hover or focus and a rebuild button beside it; the status line sits beside them and the chart stays below

the pipeline widget and the developer widget's tabs are charts: pipeline shows name, area, run time, how long ago and runs per session and plugin, pushed instead of polled; scheduled shows name, what ran it (run now by the owner's name or by an agent), area, run time, how long ago and the next run, with a global, sessions, both switch

the pipeline widget is back, global and off the surface until placed, drawing the new engine's status line, each plugin's backlog and its rebuild button from the same shared read as settings, pipeline; the developer widget's pipeline tab is back with it

the projects page no longer searches the conversation index or shows a stored summary and last messages, a previous conversation row no longer shows a written summary, and settings no longer has a conversation index tab
the projects page no longer shows restore points: the time machine tab, the restore point count column, the storage footer and the restore buttons are gone; resume stays
the questions modal: next owns Enter and the default look until the last question, then submit answers takes both; Enter in the own-answer field goes on too (#1620)

the questions widget is now called waiting on you and replaces the approvals widget, which is retired: a saved approvals widget in the drawer widget area, a side rail or the home grid becomes a waiting on you copy that lists approvals only, in the same spot

the remote browser is now called a proxy browser wherever its kind is named (row label and tooltip, the screen's label, the open menus), while the left bar's list heading stays browsers; pop out of a proxy browser asks every time whether to pop out the proxy or open the real page in your own browser, with the real page off when there is no address yet or the address only resolves on the computer carnivore runs on, and a short note at the address field says the proxy browser runs on that computer, so localhost is that computer's; and holding shift now shows the red close x on every browser and page row at once, not only the hovered or focused one

the restart and wake dialog uses the launch picker's dropdown and choose account link, starting on the profile the agent was launched with; the always launch this agent under this account box replaces the separate account row
the restart dialog's launched with row names the profile by its label like the list below it, and the choose account link points at its panel only while that panel is open

the retired archive's daily freshness check is removed: its alert, the two freshness routes, the notification type and the check script; any open archive freshness alert is dismissed at boot; per the other operator, 2026-10-12, docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, "the retired conversation archive is removed" (issue #1680, slice A2)

the retired conversation archive no longer feeds live code (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, retired conversation archive removed): the archive_pass automation action is gone, lineage backfill reads only the live transcripts, and a crosstalk fork whose live transcript is missing now fails with 'no unambiguous live transcript' instead of falling back to an archive copy

the retired conversation archive's client screen is deleted: its scripts and stylesheets, the archive route and deep link, the keyboard shortcuts group and the closed sessions panel's view all that opened it (now opens the sessions view); per the other operator, 2026-10-12, docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, "the retired conversation archive is removed" (issue #1680)

the retired conversation archive's config switch, second-database attach and archive integrity pair are removed (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, #1680); an old message_archive key in config.json is ignored, the three gated migration steps only advance the version, and every archive table stays as dormant schema

the retired conversation archive's ingest, projection, restore and script families are removed: the corpus ingesters, message model store, export and projection, transcript restore and the archive split modules, their scripts (including the library census and cleanup toolkit and the history backup proof) and their tests; a crosstalk fork whose live transcript is gone raises the existing no unambiguous live transcript error (slice A5a); per the other operator, 2026-10-12, docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-12, "the retired conversation archive is removed" (issue #1680, slice A5b)

the widget menu no longer ends in a lone divider when a widget has nothing to close

time machine restore points, their settings and routes are removed; bookmarks and deep search cover going back and finding old work

typing in the agents search box or turning on a stats bar count filter opens every group, company, project and layout that holds a match so you can see where each one is nested; clearing the filter puts every fold back as you had it, and your saved folds are never changed

a payload page keeps its page visible on wide boards, and a save you step back to loads into the page
a project's lead session shows a star on its provider icon and a do not disturb session shows a badge, and the session row menu gains make project lead and do not disturb

agents no longer see pack, messaging and ai tools until the computer uses them, a third box hides the app settings tools (off by default), and read only tools say so in the tool list

crosstalk cards get a keep cards until dismissed setting, off by default: when on, cards stay until dismissed and are kept per session while the page is open, so they are still there after a tab switch

deep search hits show the message's own time and an open agent button, a closest bookmark button when a bookmark sits at or after the hit, and a click opens the hit in context with a restore-as-clone footer (#1732)

drag a widget bar's border (the bottom bar's top, the right bar's left, or the auto-hide handle) to snap it to compact, cozy or detailed, or all the way closed into auto-hide; arrow keys step the size (#1728)
holding Shift over a sleeping agent in the drawer no longer swaps its moon for a wake sun, and Shift-click no longer wakes it; the armed wake button, the row menu and wake on click remain

huddle: a task's claim ends the moment it leaves working, a plain session cannot claim a swarm-lane task, a project has one lead session (no automatic successor) that owns unclaimed tasks, and a session can set do not disturb so no new tasks reach it

idle cpu: the task list reader folds only appended transcript lines, the pipeline observer stops rescanning unchanged subagent folders, and the token usage reader no longer opens an unchanged transcript (#1163)
master all now stays on for every session after a page reload or a server restart: it wins back any session the server forgot, and picks up sessions whose listing arrives late (#1765)
messages about joining a pack point at the pack row in the menu, not at settings, and the drawer's pack row reads open pack

messaging: a text whose outcome is unknown (the bridge restarted mid-send) now logs as unconfirmed, in its own color and never offered a resend, instead of failed; earlier rows with the may-have-been-sent note are converted (schema v92)

messaging: the provider card shows whether duplicate-send protection has ever been proven (a retried send answered with the original result, with when) or never seen; the docs state the 120-character refusal-text limit in plain words (schema v92)

moving a project to a computer that only holds a mirror of it (from the pairing link) no longer fails with project_name_taken (#1737)

new experimental plugin task-manager-dev-tools (off by default): claude can scroll your task manager to the top, fold and unfold projects and groups, close an opened task card, and list tasks by status

pack is a drawer menu row directly under dashboards and opens its own page (the old settings pack addresses still land on it); keyboard shortcuts moved from the menu into settings after general; settings > plugins is gone (the gear on a plugin card is the door); the settings rail entries lost their hover tooltips

payload boards: a review page can own its controls and post its state; save keeps numbered saves you can step back through, and send records a round with the state, your note and what changed since the last send

plugin words match what the plugins do: restore points is now conversation backups with a true description, ai summaries is working-on labels (no longer waits on anything), flow chart, nudge and share descriptions are corrected, the dead conversation index plugin is gone, and the usage stats plugin switch now really turns stats collection on and off
project and company cards and the page banner load right-sized cached images made when the picture is saved, instead of the full original (#1749)

project thumbnails on the projects page load instantly: a small cached thumbnail is made when an image is created instead of downloading the full image, and images are cached by the browser between visits (#1742)
review board revision summaries render their markdown (bold, lists) in the answer strip and the round echo, and read as plain words in the one-line bar under the page

scratch boards: any client posts one html page plus up to 10 files in one call (mcp task_manager_scratch_post or a multipart route) with no approval, the page shows them by name inside the sandboxed board, and the owner clears the board for good; a session on this computer may attach files by path, to a scratch post or a huddle_reply

swarm card tools bundle work: swarm_card_start answers the full card and a count of waiting peer messages, swarm_card_finish takes remember, swarm_card_create takes a list of cards, card writes answer short (detail true for the full card) and swarm_card_list pages (#1755)
task manager: a question's reply box no longer shows a cancel question key (replying answers it), and the reply send key stays beside the box as the text grows
task manager: a review card whose link is the task's github issue reads github issue #N instead of open link

task manager: deleting items no longer leaves a list waiting to be told, a tell wakes an asleep project agent before sending (and says so when it will not wake), and the pick a session note names the lists and reopens the picker when clicked
task manager: every project bar has a hairline above and below it, in accordion and normal view (a bar after an open project body had no top edge)

task manager: right-click its widget key to pick which statuses the count badge counts (questions, reviews, open, working, waiting, scheduled); the choice is a plugin setting kept on every device, and the default is still questions plus reviews
task manager: the bottom-left deleted count key shows a trash icon beside the count
task manager: the copy button on a code block inside a review description now copies without folding the card away, and a code block cut by a fold copies its whole text

the file editor's edit | preview toggle, save disk and close key are now the notes header's own controls, and the markdown preview fills the pane inside the page gutter instead of a narrow centered column

the huddle guide answers its core sections by default (about 11,000 characters instead of 44,000), huddle_changes and a single item read send less, and every huddle tool definition is under 5,000 bytes

the nudge is on by default for every project once the plugin is on and never fires on a waiting task; a task is stalled only when the session that owns it sits idle past the timeout, and the stall becomes a question from Carnivore with unstick, park or cancel and no toast

the pack move panel picks the computer once, in the row, and shows checking, refused, moving (step n of 6), done and failed states with a clean footer (#1737)

108 agent tools nobody called are gone from the mcp server, across projects, companies, packs, sessions, swarm, automations, bookmarks, skills and mods; every app route and screen behind them stays, and 15 tools in use or being rewritten were kept

a company's hq project is led by its company agent: set lead with agent on, or the lead retrofit, now promotes an existing session into the company agent and keeps its conversation, and the swarm has a promote route for companies

a page an agent posts becomes a one-page review board; flow pages list under REVIEW; posted pages are copied into boards once

a project you fold on the home screen stays folded after a reload, and keeps its fold when you rename it

a text for an asleep bound session wakes it, waits for its prompt and delivers it once; a failed wake keeps the text held and logged

an agent's own shell lists under terminals in the drawer again without leaking into the home counts, pickers or the other session lists

attach files to a review board (a paperclip key lists them with open and download) and write board notes in a bigger markdown panel pinned top right, built from the notepad editor with a hints overlay

beast mode is now a plugin (the auto answer plugin renamed, your switches kept): a settings grid with a beast off and a beast on box for every kind of prompt it can handle, the switch moved into the account menu, and a bolt right of the crown while it is on; turning the plugin off stops every automatic answer and approval

blockers are real: a task split with huddle_fork parent_waits waits on its forks until none is open or waiting, then goes back to its agent with cleared: its forked tasks are done; an agent's move of a held task stays in waiting and the stop shows in its history; the owner's reply or the agent's huddle_wait_update clears it

closed reviews: a group on each project page lists the review boards whose task is done, newest closed first, while the review board plugin is on

in a widget's tabs, the picked tab now matches the card exactly and the strip's empty space and the other tabs sit clearly darker than the card (lighter only on a theme whose card is already black), with a hairline under them and none under the picked tab
